ה-transaction data שנוצר ב-S/4HANA מועבר גם ל-embedded PP/DS ונשמר ב-SAP liveCache ובטבלאות ה-mapping להבטחת עקביות הנתונים. בדומה, נתוני התכנון שנוצרו ב-embedded PP/DS נשמרים ב-SAP liveCache ונשלחים ל-S/4HANA. ה-transaction data כולל planned orders ו-production orders לייצור-בית, ‏purchase requisitions, ‏purchase orders, ‏scheduling agreement releases לרכש חיצוני, ‏sales orders, אלמנטי forecast, ו-PIRs. ארכיטקטורת הנתונים ב-Figure 1.13.
מערכת ה-SAP Digital Supply Chain דומה ל-embedded PP/DS מבחינה טכנית, אך מריצה רק את תהליכי ה-PP/DS, וכל תהליכי הייצור והלוגיסטיקה האחרים מבוצעים במערכות ה-ERP המחוברות, המשתלבות דרך ה-core interface.

sections.title: Summary
sections.en: 1.3 Summary In this chapter, we introduced the basics of production planning, detailed scheduling, and deployment options, as well as the architecture of the PP/DS component for SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, embedded PP/DS, and the SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA (specifically, SAP S/4HANA Manufactur- ing for planning and scheduling) solutions. We also covered the evolution of the PP/DS architecture in the SAP systems and the embedded PP/DS data architecture in detail. As we discussed in this chapter, the cloud-based SAP IBP system, embedded PP/DS, and SAP Digital Supply Chain PP/DS will eventually replace the on-premise SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system for the demand, supply planning, and PP/DS func- tionalities. In the next chapter, we’ll cover the critical master data objects required to operate embedded PP/DS for executing the PP/DS processes. sections.he:
בפרק זה הצגנו את יסודות ה-production planning, ‏detailed scheduling, ואפשרויות ה-deployment, וכן את הארכיטקטורה של רכיב ה-PP/DS ל-SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, ‏embedded PP/DS, ופתרונות SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA (במיוחד SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing for planning and scheduling). כיסינו גם את אבולוציית ארכיטקטורת ה-PP/DS ואת ארכיטקטורת הנתונים של embedded PP/DS לפרטים.
כפי שדנו, מערכת SAP IBP מבוססת-הענן, ‏embedded PP/DS, ו-SAP Digital Supply Chain PP/DS יחליפו בסופו של דבר את מערכת SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization ה-on-premise לפונקציות ה-demand, ‏supply planning, ו-PP/DS.
בפרק הבא נכסה את אובייקטי ה-master data הקריטיים הנדרשים להפעלת embedded PP/DS לביצוע תהליכי ה-PP/DS.

sections.title: Integration Models
sections.en: 2.1 Integration Models An integration model is an object used to transfer certain master data objects from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS. These integration models use the simplified core inter- face in the SAP S/4HANA system. The core interface is a real-time data exchange frame- work using the queued remote function call (qRFC) communication technology. Typically, there are source and target systems involved in transferring data from an ERP system to the PP/DS system. Because both ERP and PP/DS are part of the same system in SAP S/4HANA, the source and destinations are the same for the integration model. There are two steps involved in transferring the data via the integration model: 1. Create the integration model. The process starts with creation of an integration model where the basic identifiers, such as the integration model name, the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization application name, and the logical systems, are defined. In addition, the selection and filter criteria for the master data objects are defined. 2 Master Data 44 2. Activate the integration model. The second step in transferring the master data to embedded PP/DS using the inte- gration model is the activation of the defined integration model. During the activa- tion, the data defined in the selection criteria for the integration model is packaged into the RFC queues and transferred to embedded PP/DS. We’ll walk through both steps in this section.
sections.he:
‏integration model הוא object המשמש להעברת master data objects מסוימים מ-S/4HANA ל-embedded PP/DS. הוא משתמש ב-core interface המפושט של S/4HANA. ה-core interface הוא framework להחלפת נתונים בזמן-אמת בעזרת טכנולוגיית queued remote function call (qRFC). בד"כ מעורבות מערכות source ו-target בהעברת נתונים מ-ERP ל-PP/DS. מכיוון ש-ERP ו-PP/DS הם חלק מאותה מערכת ב-S/4HANA, ה-source וה-destination זהים.
שני צעדים בהעברת הנתונים דרך ה-integration model:
1. **יצירת ה-integration model** — התהליך מתחיל ביצירה, שבה מוגדרים המזהים הבסיסיים (שם ה-integration model, שם יישום ה-SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, וה-logical systems), וכן קריטריוני הבחירה והסינון ל-master data objects.
2. **הפעלת ה-integration model** — בהפעלה, הנתונים שהוגדרו בקריטריוני הבחירה נארזים ל-RFC queues ומועברים ל-embedded PP/DS.

sections.title: Create the Integration Model
sections.en: 2.1.1 Create the Integration Model The creation of an integration model is executed using Transaction CFM1 via menu path, SAP Menu  Logistics  Central Functions  Supply Chain Planning Interface  Core Interface Advanced Planner and Optimizer  Integration Model  Create. As shown in Figure 2.1, the Model Name, Logical System, and APO Application uniquely identify the integration model. We’ll cover the logical system definition and the tech- nical details in Chapter 3. Note SAP S/4HANA can also be used as the ERP system with the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system. Therefore, the SAP S/4HANA integration model also supports the creation of an integration model for standalone SAP Advanced Planning and Optimi- zation systems. In addition, with SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA, it’s also required to create an integration model for the transfer of data from the source SAP S/4HANA system to SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA, where PP/DS is implemented. We’ll cover the details of SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA in Chapter 9. In this case, the integration model is created with the logical system defined for the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization or the SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA sys- tem, so you’ll see all the master data objects that can be integrated via the core interface in the integration model transaction. After SAP S/4HANA is selected as the logical sys- tem, only the master data objects that still require an integration model in embedded PP/DS are available for selection in the integration model transaction. The material-dependent master data objects (e.g., contracts and purchase info records) and the material-independent master data objects (e.g., setup groups and classes) can also be transferred to embedded PP/DS from SAP S/4HANA using the integration model. After the logical system is entered, and if it’s the one defined for the same SAP S/4HANA system, the system shows only the master data objects that are transferred through the integration model. Other master data objects are transferred to embedded PP/DS via generation reports or by setting the Advanced Planning checkbox in the master data objects (which we’ll discuss throughout this chapter). © 45 2.1 Integration Models Figure 2.1 Creation of Integration Model Definition and Selection Options The material-dependent selection, as shown in Figure 2.2, is relevant for the master data objects listed under Material Dependent Objects, and when one of these objects is selected as part of the integration model, the selection criteria defined under General Selection Options for Materials is considered for the selection. In addition, the object- specific filter is applied. In the example shown in Figure 2.2, the purchase info record (Pur.Info Record) is the data object selected for the integration model, and the filter options specific to the purchase info records are displayed. There is also a checkbox you can use to access additional filter options. After the appropriate selection and filter options are set, the Execute function on the screen is used to perform the data selection per the selection and filter values. 2 Master Data 46 Figure 2.2 Selection and Filter Options in Integration Model Creation In the next screen, as shown in Figure 2.3, the integration model is generated, which then packages the selected data into the model. The Generate IM button is used to cre- ate the integration model, and the Consistency Check button is used to make sure that the packaged data doesn’t have any inconsistencies. Figure 2.3 Integration Model Generation © 47 2.1 Integration Models
sections.he:
יצירת integration model מבוצעת ב-Transaction CFM1 דרך menu path: ‏SAP Menu • Logistics • Central Functions • Supply Chain Planning Interface • Core Interface Advanced Planner and Optimizer • Integration Model • Create.
כפי שב-Figure 2.1, ה-Model Name, ‏Logical System, ו-APO Application מזהים ייחודית את ה-integration model. הגדרת ה-logical system והפרטים הטכניים בפרק 3.
**הערה:** ‏S/4HANA יכול לשמש גם כמערכת ה-ERP עם מערכת SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization. לכן, ה-integration model של S/4HANA תומך גם ביצירת model למערכות SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization עצמאיות. בנוסף, עם SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA, נדרש גם ליצור integration model להעברת נתונים מ-S/4HANA המקורי ל-SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA, שם PP/DS מוטמע (פרק 9). במקרה זה, ה-integration model נוצר עם ה-logical system המוגדר למערכת SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization או SAP Digital Supply Chain — תראו את כל ה-master data objects הניתנים לאינטגרציה דרך ה-core interface. לאחר בחירת S/4HANA כ-logical system, רק ה-master data objects שעדיין דורשים integration model ב-embedded PP/DS זמינים לבחירה.
ניתן להעביר ל-embedded PP/DS גם master data objects תלויי-חומר (כגון contracts ו-purchase info records) וגם בלתי-תלויי-חומר (כגון setup groups ו-classes) בעזרת ה-integration model.
לאחר הזנת ה-logical system, אם הוא זה המוגדר לאותה מערכת S/4HANA, המערכת מציגה רק את ה-master data objects המועברים דרך ה-integration model. אחרים מועברים דרך generation reports או ע"י סימון checkbox ה-Advanced Planning ב-master data objects.
הבחירה תלויית-החומר (Figure 2.2) רלוונטית ל-master data objects תחת Material Dependent Objects; כשאחד נבחר, קריטריוני הבחירה תחת General Selection Options for Materials נלקחים בחשבון, ובנוסף מוחל הסינון הספציפי לאובייקט. בדוגמה (Figure 2.2), ה-purchase info record (Pur.Info Record) הוא האובייקט שנבחר, ואפשרויות הסינון הספציפיות מוצגות. יש גם checkbox לאפשרויות סינון נוספות.
לאחר הגדרת הבחירה והסינון, פונקציית ה-Execute מבצעת את בחירת הנתונים לפי הערכים. במסך הבא (Figure 2.3), נוצר ה-integration model הארוז את הנתונים הנבחרים. כפתור Generate IM יוצר את ה-model, וכפתור Consistency Check מוודא שאין אי-עקביות.

sections.title: Activate the Integration Model
sections.en: 2.1.2 Activate the Integration Model After the integration model is generated, the model needs to be activated. This step will process the data and send it to embedded PP/DS from SAP S/4HANA. This step also maps the data to the PP/DS master data objects. The activation step fetches all the data from SAP S/4HANA and then executes the map- ping logic in the core interface. For example, the purchase info records from SAP S/4HANA are fetched and filled into the corresponding core interface structures. Within embedded PP/DS, when the queue is processed, the data from SAP S/4HANA is mapped against the structures of the external procurement relationships in embedded PP/DS. In addition, the corresponding enhancement spots in SAP S/4HANA and in embedded PP/DS are evaluated and applied during this process. The activation of the integration model is executed from Transaction CFM2 via menu path, SAP Menu  Logistics  Central Functions  Supply Chain Planning Interface  Core Interface Advanced Planner and Optimizer  Integration Model  Activate. As shown in Figure 2.4, the integration model name, the logical system, and the applica- tion are the possible selection options in the integration model activation transaction. Figure 2.4 Activation of Integration Model Selection Screen The Special CIF Settings section of the screen provides additional options specific to material master deactivation and parallel core interface loads. In embedded PP/DS, 2 Master Data 48 there is no integration model for the material masters, so the Log Deactivated Material Masters option isn’t applicable. The Do Not Issue Warning in Case of Parallel CIF Load option is also not relevant for the SAP S/4HANA system as there are no integration model–based data transfers executed for the transaction data. The Parallelized Transfer section, as shown in Figure 2.4, is used to optimize the perfor- mance of the data selection from SAP S/4HANA and the processing of data in embed- ded PP/DS. This can be used when the data to be transferred via one integration model is huge, and executing this in a single threaded process would take a longer time to pro- cess. Activating parallel processing and entering the number of processes that can be used by the system will execute multiple threads for selecting SAP S/4HANA data and also process the queues in parallel within embedded PP/DS. Out of the master data and transaction data objects that are supported by the core interface framework, only the external procurement relationships (info records, con- tracts, and scheduling agreements) objects are relevant for parallel processing in embedded PP/DS. Note The SAP S/4HANA system can also be used as the ERP system along with a standalone SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system, or the SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA. Therefore, certain options, such as the special core interface settings, are still present in the SAP S/4HANA system to support the data transfer to a standalone SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system and SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA via the core interface. After the selection criteria for the integration model are entered, click the Execute but- ton. In the next screen, the details of the integration model are displayed, as shown in Figure 2.5. An integration model can be activated and deactivated any number of times, so the previous status and the new status that will be executed upon clicking the Start action are shown in the screen. Based on the selection, all the relevant integration models are listed in the left side of the screen, and when you select a specific integration model, the details are loaded on the right side of the screen. A consistency check can be executed by using the Check button in this screen. To set the status of the integration model (whether activate or deactivate), you use the Active/Inactive button. Tip In addition to creating and activating the integration model, Transaction CFM4 can be used to display it as well. Transaction CFM5 can be used to search for the integration model that a particular master data object is part of. In addition, Transaction CFM7 is used to delete integration models. © 49
sections.he:
לאחר יצירת ה-integration model, יש להפעילו. צעד זה מעבד את הנתונים ושולח אותם ל-embedded PP/DS מ-S/4HANA, וגם ממפה אותם ל-master data objects של PP/DS.
ההפעלה שולפת את כל הנתונים מ-S/4HANA ומבצעת את לוגיקת ה-mapping ב-core interface. למשל, ה-purchase info records נשלפים וממולאים למבני ה-core interface המתאימים. בתוך embedded PP/DS, בעיבוד ה-queue, הנתונים ממופים מול מבני ה-external procurement relationships. בנוסף, ה-enhancement spots המתאימים ב-S/4HANA וב-embedded PP/DS מוערכים ומוחלים.
ההפעלה מבוצעת מ-Transaction CFM2 דרך menu path: ‏SAP Menu • Logistics • Central Functions • Supply Chain Planning Interface • Core Interface Advanced Planner and Optimizer • Integration Model • Activate. כפי שב-Figure 2.4, שם ה-integration model, ה-logical system, וה-application הם אפשרויות הבחירה.
סעיף ה-Special CIF Settings מספק אפשרויות ספציפיות ל-deactivation של material master ול-parallel core interface loads. ב-embedded PP/DS אין integration model ל-material masters, ולכן Log Deactivated Material Masters אינו ישים. גם Do Not Issue Warning in Case of Parallel CIF Load אינו רלוונטי כי אין העברות מבוססות-integration model ל-transaction data.
סעיף ה-Parallelized Transfer (Figure 2.4) ממטב את ביצועי בחירת הנתונים מ-S/4HANA והעיבוד ב-embedded PP/DS — שימושי כשהנתונים להעברה דרך integration model אחד עצומים וביצוע single-threaded ייקח זמן רב. הפעלת עיבוד מקבילי והזנת מספר התהליכים יבצעו threads מרובים. מבין האובייקטים הנתמכים ע"י ה-core interface, רק ה-external procurement relationships (info records, ‏contracts, ו-scheduling agreements) רלוונטיים לעיבוד מקבילי ב-embedded PP/DS.
**הערה:** ‏S/4HANA יכול לשמש כ-ERP גם לצד מערכת SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization עצמאית או SAP Digital Supply Chain Management, edition for SAP S/4HANA. לכן אפשרויות כגון ה-special core interface settings עדיין נוכחות לתמיכה בהעברת נתונים אליהן דרך ה-core interface.
לאחר הזנת הקריטריונים, לחצו Execute. במסך הבא מוצגים פרטי ה-integration model (Figure 2.5). ניתן להפעיל ולהשבית integration model כל מספר פעמים, כך שהסטטוס הקודם והחדש (שיבוצע בלחיצת Start) מוצגים. כל ה-models הרלוונטיים מוצגים משמאל; בבחירת model ספציפי, הפרטים נטענים מימין. ניתן להריץ consistency check בכפתור Check. לקביעת הסטטוס (activate/deactivate), משתמשים בכפתור Active/Inactive.
**טיפ:** מעבר ליצירה והפעלה, ‏Transaction CFM4 מציג את ה-integration model. ‏Transaction CFM5 מחפש באיזה integration model נמצא master data object מסוים. ‏Transaction CFM7 מוחק integration models.

sections.title: Locations
sections.en: 2.2 Locations Figure 2.5 Activation of the Integration Model: Details Screen All the master data objects transferred from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS are assigned to model 000 and version 000, which are the active model and version in the embedded PP/DS system. We’ll cover the details of the model and version in Chapter 3, along with the technical settings required to work with the integration model. The technical monitoring of the integration models will be discussed in Chapter 9. 2.2 Locations In this section, we’ll cover the different location master data types relevant for embed- ded PP/DS and how this data is transferred into embedded PP/DS from SAP S/4HANA. In addition, we’ll cover the PP/DS settings that need to be maintained in the location master data. In embedded PP/DS, the definition of locations includes plants, material requirements planning (MRP) areas, vendors, customers, and shipping/receiving points. The struc- ture of these data objects isn’t the same in SAP S/4HANA because plants and MRP areas are customizing data, whereas vendors and customers are created as master data. The PP/DS location master doesn’t differentiate between SAP S/4HANA classification of the data, such as customizing or master data, and treats the location as a master data object in embedded PP/DS. ABAP program /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION is delivered in the SAP S/4HANA system to transfer the location data from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS. You can use ABAP program /SAPAPO/UPD_LOC_SP_PL to update the location data in embedded PP/DS when changes are performed to the corresponding data in SAP S/4HANA. In ABAP program /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION, the selection of relevant location data (e.g., plants, MRP areas, shipping points, and business partners representing cus- tomers and vendors) is entered as shown in Figure 2.6. When this report is executed, the data is fetched, processed, and sent to embedded PP/DS. Fields such as Create for Standard Addresses, Create for Std & Delivery Adrs, and Enable Adv. SR aren’t relevant 2 Master Data 50 for embedded PP/DS. These fields are leveraged by other solutions such as embedded transportation management in the SAP S/4HANA system. Figure 2.6 Creating PP/DS Locations for Business Partners, Plants, MRP Areas, and Shipping/ Receiving Points The locations transferred from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS can be edited in embedded PP/DS to enhance the location master with PP/DS data such as calendars and resources. The following enhancement options are also available for the integra- tion of location master data:  BAdI /SAPAPO/LOC_CREATE Create business partner locations on saving a business partner.  BAdI /SAPAPO/LOC_DETAILS Change the location details. In the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system, the customer master data is transferred from the ERP system to SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization as a cus- tomer location (location type 1010), and the vendors are transferred as a vendor loca- tion (location type 1011). With SAP S/4HANA, the business partner master data object © 51 2.2 Locations replaces the vendor and customer master data. Therefore, in embedded PP/DS, loca- tion types 1010 and 1011 are replaced by location type 1021, representing the business partner master data object. Although a plant is an organizational structure data object created in the Customizing of SAP S/4HANA, it’s transferred to embedded PP/DS as a master data element. As shown in Figure 2.7, the basic information of the plant is defined in the SAP S/4HANA system. Figure 2.7 Definition of a Plant in SAP S/4HANA Customizing After the report for transferring the plant location is executed, the plant location of location type 1001 (production plant) is created in embedded PP/DS. The basic data items, such as name, address, time zone, and regions, are transferred to the location master data. The PP/DS data is maintained in the PP/DS transaction for the location master. The location master can be accessed from Transaction /SAPAPO/LOC3 or via menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Location  Location. The Loca- tion and Location Type are entered, as shown in Figure 2.8. Select the Change button to change and add additional PP/DS information to the location master. 2 Master Data 52 Figure 2.8 PP/DS Location Master Data: Initial Screen As shown in Figure 2.9, the general data settings, including the administrative data such as Created and Changed, are in the General tab. The basic data transferred from SAP S/4HANA is updated in the Address tab. Figure 2.9 Location Master in Embedded PP/DS © 53 2.2 Locations Note In embedded PP/DS, all the master data and transaction data items are assigned to a supply chain model and version. Versions can be created to simulate any planning- relevant parameters. 000 is the active model, and 000 version is the active version. The master and transaction data integrated into embedded PP/DS from SAP S/4HANA is always assigned to the 000 version. For maintaining the PP/DS calendars, click on the Calendar tab and maintain the Pro- duction Calendar for scheduling the production activities and the Display Calendar (PPDS) for controlling the display of the periodic views in PP/DS planning tools such as the production planning table. Tip For creating PP/DS planning calendars, use Transaction /SAPAPO/CALENDAR. The handling resources in the location master are used by the goods receipt (GR) and goods issue (GI) processing operations. To support GR/GI processing times assigned in the product masters, the handling resources must be assigned in the location master. To maintain the resources, click on the Resources tab, and maintain the handling resources as shown in Figure 2.10. Resource Inbound is used in scheduling the GR activ- ities when GR processing is assigned in the material master, and Resource Outbound is used in scheduling GI activities. Figure 2.10 PP/DS Location Master: Handling Resource Assignment 2 Master Data 54 The business partner master data is created in SAP S/4HANA, and depending on the role of the business partner, the role-specific data is added in SAP S/4HANA. Depending on whether the business partner is a vendor or customer, the same entity acts as a ven- dor and customer. In embedded PP/DS, the location mater data is used in transaction data objects. For example, the plant location data is used in in-house manufacturing orders such as planned orders and production orders, and the vendor location master data and customer location master data are used in the purchasing documents and sales documents, respectively. The context for the transaction data is enhanced with the location master data details in embedded PP/DS.
sections.he:
כל ה-master data objects המועברים מ-S/4HANA ל-embedded PP/DS מוקצים ל-model 000 ו-version 000 (ה-model וה-version הפעילים). פרטי ה-model וה-version בפרק 3, יחד עם ההגדרות הטכניות. הניטור הטכני של ה-integration models בפרק 9.
בסעיף זה נכסה את סוגי location master data השונים הרלוונטיים ל-embedded PP/DS וכיצד הם מועברים מ-S/4HANA, וכן את הגדרות ה-PP/DS לתחזוקה ב-location master data.
ב-embedded PP/DS, הגדרת ה-locations כוללת plants, ‏material requirements planning (MRP) areas, ‏vendors, ‏customers, ו-shipping/receiving points. מבנה אובייקטים אלו אינו זהה ב-S/4HANA, כי plants ו-MRP areas הם customizing data, בעוד vendors ו-customers נוצרים כ-master data. ה-PP/DS location master אינו מבחין בסיווג S/4HANA (customizing או master data) ומטפל ב-location כ-master data object.
תוכנית ABAP‏ /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION מסופקת ב-S/4HANA להעברת נתוני ה-location. ניתן להשתמש בתוכנית /SAPAPO/UPD_LOC_SP_PL לעדכון נתוני ה-location ב-embedded PP/DS בשינויים. בתוכנית /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION, נבחרים נתוני ה-location הרלוונטיים (plants, ‏MRP areas, ‏shipping points, ו-business partners המייצגים customers ו-vendors) (Figure 2.6). שדות כגון Create for Standard Addresses, ‏Create for Std & Delivery Adrs, ו-Enable Adv. SR אינם רלוונטיים ל-embedded PP/DS — ממונפים ע"י פתרונות אחרים כגון embedded transportation management.
ה-locations המועברים ניתנים לעריכה ב-embedded PP/DS להעשרת ה-location master בנתוני PP/DS כגון calendars ו-resources. אפשרויות enhancement:
• **BAdI /SAPAPO/LOC_CREATE** — יצירת business partner locations בשמירת business partner.
• **BAdI /SAPAPO/LOC_DETAILS** — שינוי פרטי ה-location.
ב-SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, ה-customer master מועבר כ-customer location (location type 1010), וה-vendors כ-vendor location (location type 1011). עם S/4HANA, ה-business partner master data object מחליף את ה-vendor וה-customer. לכן ב-embedded PP/DS, סוגי 1010 ו-1011 מוחלפים בסוג 1021, המייצג את ה-business partner.
אף ש-plant הוא organizational structure object שנוצר ב-Customizing של S/4HANA, הוא מועבר ל-embedded PP/DS כ-master data element. כפי שב-Figure 2.7, המידע הבסיסי של ה-plant מוגדר ב-S/4HANA. לאחר הרצת הדוח, נוצר plant location מסוג 1001 (production plant) ב-embedded PP/DS. נתוני בסיס (שם, כתובת, ‏time zone, ‏regions) מועברים. נתוני ה-PP/DS מתוחזקים בטרנזקציית ה-PP/DS ל-location master. ה-location master נגיש מ-Transaction /SAPAPO/LOC3 או menu path: ‏Logistics • Advanced Planning • Master Data • Location • Location. מזינים את ה-Location וה-Location Type (Figure 2.8). בחרו Change להוספת מידע PP/DS.
כפי שב-Figure 2.9, הגדרות הנתונים הכלליות (כולל administrative data כגון Created ו-Changed) בלשונית General. נתוני הבסיס מ-S/4HANA מעודכנים בלשונית Address.
**הערה:** ב-embedded PP/DS, כל ה-master ו-transaction data מוקצים ל-supply chain model ו-version. ניתן ליצור versions לסימולציה. ‏000 הוא ה-model הפעיל, ו-version 000 הוא ה-version הפעיל. הנתונים המשולבים מ-S/4HANA תמיד מוקצים ל-version 000.
לתחזוקת PP/DS calendars, לחצו על לשונית Calendar ותחזקו את ה-Production Calendar לתזמון פעילויות הייצור ואת ה-Display Calendar (PPDS) לשליטה בתצוגות התקופתיות בכלי תכנון PP/DS (כגון production planning table).
**טיפ:** ליצירת PP/DS planning calendars, השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CALENDAR.
ה-handling resources ב-location master משמשים את פעולות ה-goods receipt (GR) וה-goods issue (GI). לתמיכה בזמני עיבוד GR/GI שהוקצו ב-product masters, יש להקצות handling resources ב-location master. לתחזוקה, לחצו על לשונית Resources (Figure 2.10). ‏Resource Inbound משמש בתזמון פעילויות ה-GR כשעיבוד GR מוקצה ב-material master, ו-Resource Outbound משמש בתזמון פעילויות GI.
ה-business partner נוצר ב-S/4HANA, ולפי ה-role, נתונים ספציפיים-role מתווספים. לפי אם הוא vendor או customer, אותה ישות פועלת כ-vendor וכ-customer. ב-embedded PP/DS, ה-location master משמש ב-transaction data objects. למשל, נתוני plant location משמשים ב-in-house manufacturing orders (planned orders ו-production orders), ונתוני vendor/customer location משמשים במסמכי הרכש והמכירות בהתאמה. ההקשר ל-transaction data מועשר בפרטי ה-location master.

sections.title: Product Master
sections.en: 2.3 Product Master In this section, we’ll cover the details of the product master in PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA and how the material master maintained in the SAP S/4HANA system is transferred to embedded PP/DS. In the SAP S/4HANA system, the material master holds the informa- tion about the materials that a company manufactures, procures, and stores in its premises. Depending on the usage of the material in the company, different material types are defined. Based on the type of material, such as raw material, semifinished material, or finished product, the relevant information is stored in the material master data.
sections.he: בסעיף זה נכסה את ה-product master ב-PP/DS ב-S/4HANA וכיצד ה-material master המתוחזק ב-S/4HANA מועבר ל-embedded PP/DS. ב-S/4HANA, ה-material master מחזיק מידע על החומרים שחברה מייצרת, רוכשת, ומאחסנת. לפי השימוש בחומר, מוגדרים material types שונים. לפי הסוג (raw material, ‏semifinished material, או finished product), המידע הרלוונטי נשמר ב-material master.

sections.title: Activation of Advanced Planning for Materials
sections.en: 2.3.1 Activation of Advanced Planning for Materials In the PP/DS component of SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, the material master created in the ERP system must be transferred to the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system via the core interface. In addition, the integration model is required to transfer the material master to the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimiza- tion system. Change pointers are also implemented to send the material master changes to the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system when a change is made in the ERP system. The material master data in SAP Advanced Planning and Opti- mization is called the product master, and any product master data from the PP/DS component of SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization is directly maintained in the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system. Due to the presence of the core interface layer between the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization and ERP sys- tems, there are challenges in monitoring the queues for any errors and correcting them to ensure the data consistency between the ERP and SAP Advanced Planning and Opti- mization systems. In embedded PP/DS, there is no need to create an integration model for the material master. As PP/DS is part of the SAP S/4HANA core, the material master created in SAP S/4HANA is available for PP/DS by activating the material for advanced planning. There is a new view in the SAP S/4HANA material master where the PP/DS-specific master © 55 2.3 Product Master data can be maintained. Therefore, the maintenance of the material master is only pos- sible from the ERP side transaction within the SAP S/4HANA system, and the PP/DS product master is a display-only view. As shown in Figure 2.11, from the material master Transaction MM01 (Create Material) or Transaction MM02 (Change Material), navigate to the Advanced Planning tab, and check the Advanced Planning checkbox on the material master. This checkbox immedi- ately makes the material master available for PP/DS planning upon saving the material master. In addition, activating Advanced Planning will populate the mandatory fields, such as the PP Plng Procedure in the material master. Once you activate the Advanced Planning checkbox and press (Enter), you’ll see that the Not relevant for planning field is changed to Active for planning. You can activate a material for advanced planning, but it can be deactivated if planning of the material is no longer required in PP/DS. In this case, the material is still integrated to embedded PP/DS, but no planning or changes are possible in PP/DS. Figure 2.11 Activation of Advanced Planning in SAP S/4HANA Material Master Any additional PP/DS master data that is relevant for specific planning scenarios within PP/DS can be maintained in this Advanced Planning tab. As shown in Figure 2.12, the PP/DS data is stored in SAP S/4HANA material master table MARC. The PP/DS data- base tables (e.g., table /SAPAPAO/MATLOC) are just a view of the data stored in table MARC, and they don’t persist the data. 2 Master Data 56 Figure 2.12 PP/DS Fields in SAP S/4HANA Material Master: Table MARC The activation of advanced planning in the material master assigns the material to the active PP/DS model and version. The product master can be displayed in the PP/DS Transaction /SAPAPO/MAT1. This is a display-only view, and no data maintenance is possible in the PP/DS transaction. All the basic MRP and advanced planning data objects maintained in the material master are visible in the PP/DS product master, as shown in Figure 2.13. Figure 2.13 PP/DS Product Master Data in SAP S/4HANA © 57 2.3 Product Master Note Direct creation of material in embedded PP/DS isn’t possible for simulation purposes. Materials are always created and maintained in the ERP transaction and must be acti- vated for advanced planning. Materials are created and assigned to a plant in SAP S/4HANA, and the same assign- ment is available for the PP/DS product master data. Therefore, the location master data of the plant must be integrated before activating the material for advanced plan- ning. If an advanced planned material is assigned to an MRP area within the plant, the material can be planned in the MRP area in PP/DS as well. However, the MRP area should be integrated as a PP/DS location prior to activation of advanced planning.
sections.he:
ברכיב ה-PP/DS של SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization, ה-material master שנוצר ב-ERP חייב להיות מועבר למערכת דרך ה-core interface, ונדרש integration model. גם change pointers ממומשים לשליחת שינויי ה-material master. ה-material master ב-SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization נקרא product master, וכל product master מהרכיב מתוחזק ישירות שם. בשל שכבת ה-core interface, יש אתגרים בניטור ה-queues לשגיאות ובתיקונן להבטחת עקביות.
ב-embedded PP/DS, אין צורך ליצור integration model ל-material master. מכיוון ש-PP/DS חלק מליבת S/4HANA, ה-material master שנוצר ב-S/4HANA זמין ל-PP/DS ע"י הפעלת החומר ל-advanced planning. יש view חדש ב-material master שבו ניתן לתחזק את ה-master data הספציפי ל-PP/DS. לכן, תחזוקת ה-material master אפשרית רק מטרנזקציית ה-ERP, וה-PP/DS product master הוא view לתצוגה-בלבד.
כפי שב-Figure 2.11, מ-Transaction MM01 (Create Material) או MM02 (Change Material), נווטו ללשונית Advanced Planning וסמנו את checkbox ה-Advanced Planning. ה-checkbox הופך את ה-material master לזמין לתכנון PP/DS מיד בשמירה. בנוסף, הפעלת Advanced Planning תאכלס שדות חובה כגון PP Plng Procedure.
לאחר סימון Advanced Planning ולחיצת Enter, השדה Not relevant for planning משתנה ל-Active for planning. ניתן להפעיל חומר ל-advanced planning, אך ניתן להשביתו אם תכנון אינו נדרש עוד. במקרה זה, החומר עדיין משולב ב-embedded PP/DS, אך אין תכנון או שינויים אפשריים.
כל PP/DS master data נוסף הרלוונטי לתרחישים ספציפיים מתוחזק בלשונית Advanced Planning. כפי שב-Figure 2.12, נתוני ה-PP/DS נשמרים בטבלת material master‏ MARC. טבלאות ה-PP/DS (כגון /SAPAPO/MATLOC) הן רק view של הנתונים בטבלת MARC ואינן מקיימות (persist) נתונים.
הפעלת advanced planning מקצה את החומר ל-PP/DS model ו-version הפעילים. ה-product master ניתן לתצוגה ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/MAT1 — view לתצוגה-בלבד. כל אובייקטי ה-MRP וה-advanced planning הבסיסיים גלויים ב-product master (Figure 2.13).
**הערה:** יצירה ישירה של חומר ב-embedded PP/DS אינה אפשרית לסימולציה. חומרים תמיד נוצרים בטרנזקציית ה-ERP וחייבים להיות מופעלים ל-advanced planning.
חומרים נוצרים ומוקצים ל-plant ב-S/4HANA, ואותה הקצאה זמינה ל-product master. לכן יש לשלב את ה-location master של ה-plant לפני הפעלת החומר. אם חומר מוקצה ל-MRP area בתוך ה-plant, ניתן לתכננו ב-MRP area ב-PP/DS גם. אך ה-MRP area צריך להיות משולב כ-PP/DS location לפני ההפעלה.

sections.title: Deactivation of Advanced Planning for Materials
sections.en: 2.3.2 Deactivation of Advanced Planning for Materials When a material is activated for advanced planning by setting the Advanced Planning indicator in the material master, and the material master is saved, in the PP/DS side, the material and the plant combination is created as a pegging area. Internally, the sys- tem generated a Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for the material/plant combination called a peg key, which identifies the pegging area and saves it in SAP liveCache. SAP liveCache is object-based in-memory storage within the SAP HANA database where the embedded PP/DS data is replicated, so that the access to such data is faster. All the transaction data transferred from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS is linked with the material/plant with the peg key. Apart from the transaction data, the peg key is also linked with the material-dependent master data such as the in-house source of supplies and external procurement relationships. When other transaction and master data is present in embedded PP/DS for a material, deactivation and removal of the Advanced Planning indicator will result in orphaned transactions and master data still being present in embedded PP/DS and in SAP live- Cache. To avoid this inconsistent and orphaned data being present in embedded PP/DS, from the SAP S/4HANA 2020 release, the removal of the Advanced Planning indicator can’t be performed when dependent transaction data is present in embedded PP/DS. A new field called Planning Status was also introduced to control the activation and deac- tivation of materials for PP/DS, while the material remains integrated with PP/DS. To uncheck the Advanced Planning indicator in the material master, follow these steps: 1. Deactivate the material for advanced planning As shown in Figure 2.14, click on the Swap Planning Status button, which will change the status of the material from Active for planning to Marked for deactivation. After deactivation of the advanced planning relevancy, save the material master. 2 Master Data 58 Figure 2.14 Marking Materials for Deactivation of Advanced Planning 2. Check for the presence of dependent data Click on the Where-Used Check button on the Advanced Planning tab in the material master, as shown in Figure 2.15. This will execute a where-used list for this material and search through all dependent master data and transaction data in PP/DS. If there is dependent master and transaction data in PP/DS, you’ll see a message, as shown in Figure 2.15, where references were found for a material in a plant. When there are references in other master data objects found by the system, the Advanced Planning checkbox on the screen remains noneditable. In this case, exit the material master transaction. 3. Identify dependent data for PP/DS materials To identify dependent objects, execute Transaction WUF (Where-Used List), and select the Object Type 1 as Adv. Planning Location Product. The selection fields to enter the Product Number (material number) and the Location (plant) are then dis- played, as shown in Figure 2.16. Enter the product number and the location 2, and click on the Execute 3 button. In the resulting screen, you’ll see the result of the where-used analysis. Click on the material number under the Obj. Name section 4. This will load the list of objects 5 on the right side of the screen. In the example demonstrated in Figure 2.16, only orders are present in PP/DS for this material, so the LC Orders (SAP liveCache orders) tab is displayed. If other objects are present in PP/DS for this material, the corre- sponding objects such as PDSs will also be listed as tabs in the object list section. © 59 2.3 Product Master Clicking on the corresponding object will display the transaction or master data details in a table 6. Figure 2.15 PP/DS Where-Used Check for Advanced Planning Materials Figure 2.16 Identification of the Dependent Data for Material/Plant in PP/DS 2 Master Data 60 4. Delete material-dependent data in PP/DS Once the dependent transaction and master data objects are identified, several transactions and programs need to be executed to delete all such data objects. Table 2.1 shows the transactions and reports that can be used to delete the commonly used transaction and master data objects. 5. Remove the Advanced Planning indicator Go to the Advanced Planning tab of the material master in change mode. Click on the Where-Used Check button 1, as shown in Figure 2.17. As no dependent data exists in PP/DS, the Advanced Planning indicator 2 becomes editable. Remove the Advanced Planning checkbox, and save the material master. This will completely delete the material from PP/DS so that it can’t be accessed anymore from PP/DS. Tip After the materials are set Marked for Deactivation, execute report /SAPAPO/PPDS_ PPSKZ_RESET from Transaction SE38 or Transaction SA38 to execute a mass check for the where-used list and the dependency details. When this report is executed without simulation mode, if there are no dependencies identified, the system will uncheck the Advanced Planning indicator for such materials. Navigating the details of the report logs will take you to the where-used list details dis- played in Transaction WUF. Object Transaction/Report to Delete the Data Planned orders Use heuristics SAP_INAC_05 to delete inactive planned orders or use the report /SAPAPO/OM_ DELETE_INCON_ORDERS for orders which are not deleted by the heuristics Planned independent requirements Transaction /SAPAPO/MD74 Stock elements Report /SAPAPO/DELETE_STOCK Sales orders Report /SAPAPO/SDORDER_DEL PDS (output is the inactive material) Transaction /SAPAPO/CULL_RTO_DEL PDS (the inactive material is the input) Retransfer the PDS using Transaction CURTOADV_ CREATE Transportation lanes Transaction /SAPAPO/TL1 and delete the material assignment to the transportation lane External procurement relationships Transaction /SAPAPO/PWBSRC2 Table 2.1 Delete Material-Dependent Data © 61 2.3 Product Master Figure 2.17 Deactivation of the Advanced Planning Indicator in the Material Master
sections.he:
כשחומר מופעל ל-advanced planning ע"י סימון ה-Advanced Planning indicator ושמירת ה-material master, בצד ה-PP/DS נוצר שילוב החומר/plant כ-pegging area. פנימית, המערכת מייצרת Global Unique Identifier (GUID) לשילוב החומר/plant בשם peg key, המזהה את ה-pegging area ושומר אותו ב-SAP liveCache. ‏SAP liveCache הוא אחסון in-memory מבוסס-object בתוך מסד SAP HANA שבו נתוני ה-embedded PP/DS משוכפלים לגישה מהירה.
כל ה-transaction data המועבר מ-S/4HANA ל-embedded PP/DS מקושר לחומר/plant עם ה-peg key. מעבר ל-transaction data, ה-peg key מקושר גם ל-master data תלוי-חומר כגון in-house source of supplies ו-external procurement relationships.
כשקיימים transaction ו-master data ב-embedded PP/DS לחומר, השבתה והסרת ה-Advanced Planning indicator יגרמו לנתונים יתומים. כדי להימנע מכך, מגרסת S/4HANA 2020, הסרת ה-indicator אינה אפשרית כשקיים transaction data תלוי ב-embedded PP/DS. שדה חדש בשם Planning Status הוצג לשליטה בהפעלה ובהשבתה, בעוד החומר נשאר משולב.
לביטול סימון ה-Advanced Planning indicator:
1. **השבתת החומר ל-advanced planning** — כפי שב-Figure 2.14, לחצו על Swap Planning Status, שישנה את הסטטוס מ-Active for planning ל-Marked for deactivation. לאחר ההשבתה, שמרו את ה-material master.
2. **בדיקת קיום נתונים תלויים** — לחצו על Where-Used Check בלשונית Advanced Planning (Figure 2.15). זה מריץ where-used list וחיפוש בכל ה-master ו-transaction data התלויים ב-PP/DS. אם קיימים, תופיע הודעה (Figure 2.15). כשנמצאות הפניות, ה-checkbox נשאר לא-ניתן-לעריכה. צאו מהטרנזקציה.
3. **זיהוי נתונים תלויים** — הריצו Transaction WUF (Where-Used List) ובחרו Object Type 1 = Adv. Planning Location Product. שדות הבחירה ל-Product Number (material number) ו-Location (plant) מוצגים (Figure 2.16). הזינו אותם ולחצו Execute. בתוצאה, לחצו על מספר החומר תחת Obj. Name — תיטען רשימת ה-objects מימין. בדוגמה (Figure 2.16), רק orders קיימים, ולכן לשונית LC Orders (SAP liveCache orders) מוצגת. אם קיימים objects אחרים (כגון PDSs), הם מופיעים כלשוניות. לחיצה על האובייקט מציגה את הפרטים בטבלה.
4. **מחיקת נתונים תלויי-חומר** — לאחר הזיהוי, יש להריץ מספר טרנזקציות ותוכניות למחיקת כל האובייקטים. ‏Table 2.1 מציג את אלו לנפוצים.
5. **הסרת ה-Advanced Planning indicator** — בלשונית Advanced Planning במצב change, לחצו Where-Used Check (Figure 2.17). מכיוון שאין נתונים תלויים, ה-indicator הופך לניתן-לעריכה. הסירו את ה-checkbox ושמרו — זה מוחק לחלוטין את החומר מ-PP/DS.
**טיפ:** לאחר סימון Marked for Deactivation, הריצו דוח /SAPAPO/PPDS_PPSKZ_RESET מ-Transaction SE38 או SA38 לבדיקה המונית של ה-where-used list והתלויות. בהרצה ללא simulation mode, אם אין תלויות, המערכת מסירה את ה-indicator. ניווט בפרטי לוגי הדוח מוביל לפרטי ה-where-used list ב-Transaction WUF.

**Table 2.1 — מחיקת נתונים תלויי-חומר:**

| Object | Transaction/Report למחיקה |
|---|---|
| Planned orders | heuristic SAP_INAC_05 למחיקת planned orders לא-פעילים, או דוח /SAPAPO/OM_DELETE_INCON_ORDERS ל-orders שלא נמחקו |
| Planned independent requirements | Transaction /SAPAPO/MD74 |
| Stock elements | Report /SAPAPO/DELETE_STOCK |
| Sales orders | Report /SAPAPO/SDORDER_DEL |
| PDS (output הוא החומר הלא-פעיל) | Transaction /SAPAPO/CULL_RTO_DEL |
| PDS (החומר הלא-פעיל הוא input) | העברה-מחדש של ה-PDS דרך Transaction CURTOADV_CREATE |
| Transportation lanes | Transaction /SAPAPO/TL1 ומחיקת הקצאת החומר ל-transportation lane |
| External procurement relationships | Transaction /SAPAPO/PWBSRC2 |

sections.title: Advanced Planning Settings Specific to the Material Requirements
sections.en: 2.3.3 Advanced Planning Settings Specific to the Material Requirements Planning Area In the SAP S/4HANA material master, you can assign the materials to specific MRP areas. Typically, MRP areas are created to separate the planning of specific storage loca- tions from the plant. When MRP areas are created in the SAP S/4HANA system and assigned to the material master, if advanced planning is activated for the material, the system automatically activates the Advanced Planning indicator the MRP area level as well. Warning When MRP areas are assigned to materials that are activated for advanced planning, the system automatically activates the advanced planning for the material in the MRP area as well. So, it’s mandatory to integrate the MRP areas as locations to PP/DS using program /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION before assigning advanced planning material to the MRP areas. If the MRP area location isn’t integrated to PP/DS, an error will be raised during the assignment of MRP areas to the materials. As shown in Figure 2.18, navigate to the MRP 1 view 1 of the material master, and click on the MRP Areas button 2 on the bottom of the screen. Then, navigate to the MPR area 2 Master Data 62 by double-clicking on the corresponding MRP Area 3. PP/DS-specific settings can be maintained within the Advanced Planning tab 4 of the MRP area. Figure 2.18 Advanced Planning View in the MRP Area Although you can set the Advanced Planning status to Marked for deactivation in the MRP area level, you can’t remove the Advanced Planning checkbox from the MRP area. When the Advanced Planning checkbox is unchecked in the material master at the plant level, the Advanced Planning flag in the MRP area is also reset. Tip For mass copying of PP/DS fields in the advanced planning view from the plant level to the MRP area level, use program /SAPAPO/COPY_PLANT_TO_MRPAREA. This will only copy the PP/DS-relevant fields available in database table MDMA.
sections.he:
ב-material master של S/4HANA, ניתן להקצות חומרים ל-MRP areas ספציפיים. בד"כ MRP areas נוצרים להפרדת תכנון storage locations ספציפיים מה-plant. כשנוצרים MRP areas ומוקצים ל-material master, אם advanced planning מופעל לחומר, המערכת מפעילה אוטומטית את ה-Advanced Planning indicator גם ברמת ה-MRP area.
**אזהרה:** כש-MRP areas מוקצים לחומרים מופעלי advanced planning, המערכת מפעילה אוטומטית את ה-advanced planning גם ברמת ה-MRP area. לכן חובה לשלב את ה-MRP areas כ-locations ל-PP/DS בעזרת תוכנית /SAPAPO/CREATE_LOCATION לפני הקצאת חומר advanced planning ל-MRP areas. אם ה-location לא משולב, תיווצר שגיאה.
כפי שב-Figure 2.18, נווטו ל-view‏ MRP 1 של ה-material master, ולחצו על MRP Areas בתחתית. אז נווטו ל-MRP area בלחיצה כפולה על ה-MRP Area. הגדרות ספציפיות-PP/DS מתוחזקות בלשונית Advanced Planning של ה-MRP area.
אף שניתן לקבוע Advanced Planning status ל-Marked for deactivation ברמת ה-MRP area, לא ניתן להסיר את ה-checkbox מה-MRP area. כשה-checkbox מוסר ב-material master ברמת ה-plant, ה-flag ב-MRP area גם מאופס.
**טיפ:** להעתקה המונית של שדות PP/DS מרמת ה-plant לרמת ה-MRP area, השתמשו בתוכנית /SAPAPO/COPY_PLANT_TO_MRPAREA. זה מעתיק רק שדות רלוונטיים-PP/DS בטבלת MDMA.

sections.title: Flexible Integration of Material to Embedded PP/DS
sections.en: 2.3.4 Flexible Integration of Material to Embedded PP/DS In the SAP S/4HANA material master, the concept of flexible integration is introduced from SAP S/4HANA release 2020. This provides flexibility for how a material is inte- grated into PP/DS by allowing you to choose the way the material is handled in PP/DS for planning and scheduling. For example, if you want to plan the material in a plan- ning system such as SAP Integrated Business Planning for Supply Chain (SAP IBP) and integrate the planning results to SAP S/4HANA and to embedded PP/DS, and you want embedded PP/DS to only perform scheduling, but not any planning, the flexible inte- gration options can be leveraged for such requirements. © 63 2.3 Product Master In the SAP S/4HANA material master under the Advanced Planning tab shown in Figure 2.19, the Scope Limitation field determines how the transaction data is integrated to PP/DS and what actions are possible within PP/DS when such scope limitation is defined. The Scope Profile field determines the list heuristics that are allowed to be executed in PP/DS with specific scope limitations. Figure 2.19 Scope Limitations in the Material Master for PP/DS Integration The scope profile is maintained under the SAP IMG Customizing menu path SPRO  Advanced Planning  Detailed Scheduling  Maintain Scope Profile. As shown in Figure 2.20, the default Scope Profile SAP_PPDS01 is delivered in the standard system. Select the scope profile 1 and navigate to the Allowed Heuristics Algorithms folder to display the list of heuristics algorithms 2 which are allowed to be executed for the materials, when the materials are assigned with this scope profile. You can copy the SAP_PPDS01 scope profile to another profile to add or remove heuristics algorithms which are allowed for your scope profile. The scope limitation can only be set when activating the Advanced Planning checkbox in the material master. Once the material is activated for advanced planning and saved, the Scope Limitation field becomes noneditable. So, to set a scope limitation or to change an already-set scope limitation, you must remove the Advanced Planning indi- cator, as described earlier in Section 2.3.2, and set the advanced planning again to make the Scope Limitation field editable. 2 Master Data 64 Figure 2.20 Scope Profile Configuration Settings There are four scope limitation options available. A blank value in this field means there are no limitations for integration of the transactional data from SAP S/4HANA to PP/DS and also no restrictions on the interactive and background planning/scheduling functions and heuristics. The details on these scope limitations are described here:  PP/DS Display Only With this scope limitation, all the in-house procurement orders (e.g., planned orders, production orders, and process orders) and external procurement orders (e.g., pur- chase requisitions, stock transfer requisitions, purchase orders, and stock transfer orders) are integrated to PP/DS. But those will be only in display mode in PP/DS, so they can’t be changed or deleted in PP/DS. In addition, no order creation is possible in PP/DS for the materials with the PP/DS display only scope limitation. No planning functions can be executed in PP/DS using any of the planning and scheduling tools within PP/DS. In addition, no heuristics execution is possible in PP/DS © 65 2.3 Product Master for planning or scheduling. This can be useful when materials planning is performed in external systems, no scheduling is required in PP/DS, and the orders need to be integrated to PP/DS for visibility purposes. As the execution of PP/DS heuristics isn’t allowed for this scope limitation, the Scope Profile field isn’t relevant, and no entry is allowed for the Scope Profile field.  PP/DS Restricted for Inhouse Only With this scope limitation option, external procurement orders are integrated to PP/DS as display-only orders. These external procurement orders can’t be changed or deleted in PP/DS, and no external procurement order creation is possible in PP/DS. The system can only execute the heuristics that are listed under the scope profile assigned to the material master for PP/DS interactive planning tools such as the product view (Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3) and scheduling tools such as the detailed scheduling planning board (Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS0), as well as in background planning runs. The in-house procurement orders can be created, changed, and deleted in PP/DS interactively or via automatic planning. When there is a scope limitation that restricts the functionality within PP/DS, a warning message is raised in interactive planning tools such as the product view (Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3) to make you aware of the scope limitation, as shown in Figure 2.21. In background planning runs, warning and error logs are generated if a material can’t be planned or scheduled using a specific heuristic because it’s not part of the scope profile configuration. Figure 2.21 Warning on Scope Limitation in PP/DS Interactive Planning Tools This scope limitation can be applicable in scenarios where a mix of in-house and external procurement is possible for certain materials. The sourcing decision is 2 Master Data 66 determined in an external planning system, and you integrate the external procure- ment orders to PP/DS. Within PP/DS, you want the system to respect the sourcing decisions for external procurement. In addition, PP/DS needs to cover any un-covered demand with in-house procurement orders and schedule the in-house procurement orders with a restriction of the allowed heuristics for such materials.  PP/DS Restricted With this scope limitation option, you can create, change, and delete external and in-house procurement orders in PP/DS. For heuristics execution in PP/DS, you can only execute the heuristics that are listed in the scope profile. This scope limitation can be leveraged in scenarios where the planning is executed in external planning systems, but further planning functions—such as fixed peg- ging heuristics and scheduling heuristics—are to be executed within PP/DS. In such cases, those specific heuristics are assigned to the scope profile.  PP/DS Entire scope for Inhouse only This scope limitation option behaves exactly like PP/DS Restricted for In-house Only, but there are no limitations on the list of heuristics that can be executed in PP/DS. So, the scope profile isn’t available to be filled with this scope limitation option. Tip When a material is present in multiple plants, program /SAPAPO/SCOPE_LIMITATION_ LIST can be used to list the scope limitation and scope profile of the material across plants and corresponding MRP areas.
sections.he:
ב-material master, מושג ה-flexible integration הוצג מגרסת S/4HANA 2020. הוא מספק גמישות באופן שילוב חומר ל-PP/DS ע"י בחירת אופן הטיפול בו לתכנון ותזמון. למשל, אם רוצים לתכנן את החומר ב-SAP Integrated Business Planning for Supply Chain (SAP IBP) ולשלב את התוצאות ל-S/4HANA ול-embedded PP/DS, ורוצים ש-embedded PP/DS יבצע רק scheduling ולא planning, ניתן למנף את אפשרויות ה-flexible integration.
בלשונית Advanced Planning (Figure 2.19), שדה ה-Scope Limitation קובע כיצד ה-transaction data משולב ל-PP/DS ואילו פעולות אפשריות. שדה ה-Scope Profile קובע אילו heuristics מותר להריץ ב-PP/DS עם scope limitations ספציפיות.
ה-scope profile מתוחזק תחת SAP IMG: ‏SPRO • Advanced Planning • Detailed Scheduling • Maintain Scope Profile. כפי שב-Figure 2.20, ה-Scope Profile ברירת-המחדל SAP_PPDS01 מסופק. בחרו את ה-profile ונווטו לתיקיית Allowed Heuristics Algorithms להצגת ה-heuristics המותרים. ניתן להעתיק את SAP_PPDS01 ל-profile אחר להוספה/הסרה של heuristics.
ה-scope limitation ניתן לקביעה רק בהפעלת ה-Advanced Planning checkbox. לאחר ההפעלה והשמירה, שדה ה-Scope Limitation הופך לא-ניתן-לעריכה. כדי לקבוע/לשנות, יש להסיר את ה-indicator (סעיף 2.3.2) ולהפעיל שוב.
ארבע אפשרויות scope limitation. ערך ריק = אין הגבלות על שילוב ה-transactional data ואין הגבלות על פונקציות תכנון/תזמון ו-heuristics. הפרטים:
• **PP/DS Display Only** — כל ה-in-house procurement orders (planned orders, ‏production orders, ‏process orders) וה-external procurement orders (purchase requisitions, ‏stock transfer requisitions, ‏purchase orders, ‏stock transfer orders) משולבים ל-PP/DS, אך רק במצב תצוגה — לא ניתן לשנותם/למחקם, ואין יצירת orders. אין פונקציות תכנון או heuristics. שימושי כשתכנון מבוצע במערכות חיצוניות, אין צורך ב-scheduling ב-PP/DS, וה-orders משולבים לנראות. מכיוון שאין heuristics, שדה ה-Scope Profile אינו רלוונטי ואין הזנה מותרת.
• **PP/DS Restricted for Inhouse Only** — ‏external procurement orders משולבים כתצוגה-בלבד (לא ניתן לשנות/למחוק/ליצור). המערכת יכולה להריץ רק את ה-heuristics ב-scope profile לכלי תכנון אינטראקטיביים (product view — Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3) וכלי scheduling (detailed scheduling planning board — Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS0), וב-background runs. ה-in-house procurement orders ניתנים ליצירה/שינוי/מחיקה אינטראקטיבית או דרך תכנון אוטומטי. כשיש scope limitation המגביל, הודעת warning מופיעה בכלים אינטראקטיביים (Figure 2.21). ב-background runs נוצרים לוגי warning ו-error. ישים בתרחישים עם תמהיל in-house ו-external — החלטת ה-sourcing במערכת חיצונית, ‏PP/DS מכבד אותה ל-external ומכסה ביקוש לא-מכוסה עם in-house orders ומתזמן אותם בהגבלת ה-heuristics.
• **PP/DS Restricted** — ניתן ליצור/לשנות/למחוק external ו-in-house procurement orders. ל-heuristics, ניתן להריץ רק את אלו ב-scope profile. ישים כשהתכנון במערכות חיצוניות, אך פונקציות נוספות (fixed pegging heuristics ו-scheduling heuristics) מבוצעות ב-PP/DS — מוקצות ל-scope profile.
• **PP/DS Entire scope for Inhouse only** — מתנהג בדיוק כמו PP/DS Restricted for In-house Only, אך אין הגבלות על רשימת ה-heuristics. לכן ה-scope profile אינו זמין למילוי.
**טיפ:** כשחומר קיים ב-plants מרובים, ניתן להשתמש בתוכנית /SAPAPO/SCOPE_LIMITATION_LIST לרשימת ה-scope limitation וה-scope profile של החומר על-פני plants ו-MRP areas.

sections.title: Work Centers and Resources
sections.en: 2.4 Work Centers and Resources In this section, we’ll cover resource and work center data in SAP S/4HANA and how that data is integrated into PP/DS. We’ll also discuss the specifics of PP/DS resource master data. Resources and work centers represent the machines, tools, and labor resources that are used to manufacture products. In industries that follow continuous or process manu- facturing (e.g., the chemical industry), the term resource is used to represent the pro- duction resources; in discrete manufacturing scenarios, the production resources are called work centers. Work centers and resources hold basic information about their usage in the production process, capacity definition, and scheduling data. In SAP S/4HANA, the data related to the activity types, which are used to derive the cost of the resource usage, plays a crucial role. In embedded PP/DS, the resource master data maintenance is simplified by eliminat- ing the need to create an integration model for transferring the work centers and resources to PP/DS. © 67 2.4 Work Centers and Resources
sections.he:
בסעיף זה נכסה נתוני resource ו-work center ב-S/4HANA וכיצד הם משולבים ל-PP/DS, וכן את הספציפיקות של PP/DS resource master data.
‏resources ו-work centers מייצגים את המכונות, הכלים, ומשאבי העבודה לייצור מוצרים. בתעשיות continuous/process manufacturing (למשל כימיה), המונח resource מייצג את משאבי הייצור; ב-discrete manufacturing, נקראים work centers. הם מחזיקים מידע בסיסי על השימוש בייצור, הגדרת קיבולת, ונתוני scheduling. ב-S/4HANA, הנתונים הקשורים ל-activity types (לגזירת עלות שימוש ה-resource) ממלאים תפקיד חיוני. ב-embedded PP/DS, תחזוקת ה-resource master מפושטת ע"י ביטול הצורך ב-integration model להעברת work centers ו-resources.

sections.title: Work Centers
sections.en: 2.4.1 Work Centers Work centers are created in SAP S/4HANA by executing Transaction CR01 and are changed by executing Transaction CR02. After you execute Transaction CR01, enter a Plant, Work Center name, and Category, and then press (Enter) to arrive at the screen shown in Figure 2.22. In the Basic Data tab of the work center master data, select the Advanced Planning indicator. Figure 2.22 Activation of Advanced Planning in the SAP S/4HANA Work Center After the Advanced Planning indicator is selected, the resource is transferred to embed- ded PP/DS. In embedded PP/DS, the following four resource types are supported:  Single activity resource Only one activity can be performed in this resource at a given time. The available capacity is defined only as a dimension of time.  Multi-activity resource Multiple activities can be performed in this resource in parallel. The available capac- ity is defined as the time dimension, along with the number of individual capacities available. 2 Master Data 68  Production line Line resources are typically used in rate-based manufacturing such as automotive assembly lines.  Calendar resources These resources don’t hold any capacity, but they are used for determining the sched- ule of the activity performed in these resources. The handling resources that are assigned to the location master data to schedule the GR/GI processing times (inbound and outbound handling resources) are created as calendar resources. Although there is no need to schedule these handling activities based on any capaci- ties, a resource is still required in PP/DS to determine the schedule of those activities. The PP/DS properties (e.g., resource type, category, validity of the resource time streams, etc.) are defaulted from the customizing maintained in Transaction CFC9 under the Initial Data Transfer and Change Transfer for Resource section, as shown in Figure 2.23. Figure 2.23 Default Values for PP/DS Resource Transfer The default values for the PP/DS resource properties, such as the resource type, cate- gory, and validity of the resource time stream, can be overwritten in the work center master data in SAP S/4HANA. You can use the APO Resource button in the capacity header of the work center master data from Transaction CR01 or Transaction CR02 to define the work center–specific PP/DS resource properties, as shown in Figure 2.24. Resource Cat. (resource category) is a descriptive field for denoting the usage of the resource and doesn’t have a functional significance for scheduling. The time stream validity is determined by the fields Days - (days in past) and Days + (days in future), and the same is used to create the SAP liveCache time stream in PP/DS. © 69 2.4 Work Centers and Resources Figure 2.24 PP/DS Resource Properties in the SAP S/4HANA Work Center Note In the SAP S/4HANA work center, you’ll still see fields and resource types relevant to the standalone PP/DS component of SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization sce- nario. In a side-by-side SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization and SAP S/4HANA system, these resource types are still relevant, so they are still present but not relevant for embedded PP/DS. In the PPO Capacity Constraints tab, the relevant parameters for the Production Plan- ning Optimizer are maintained. The Production Planning Optimizer was introduced in SAP S/4HANA 2020 release and aids in achieving an optimal production plan. We’ll cover the details and functionality of the Production Planning Optimizer in Chapter 5, Section 5.8. After the work center is transferred to embedded PP/DS by setting the Advanced Plan- ning checkbox, the resource is available for maintenance of additional data in the PP/DS transaction. Execute Transaction /SAPAPO/RES01 to access the PP/DS resource master data. You can also follow SAP menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Resource  Resource, to access the resource master. Because the resources are created in PP/DS, they are assigned to planning version 000. There is also a version-independent resource that is created in PP/DS. Certain pieces of PP/DS resource data, such as the classification of resources for characteristics- dependent planning (CDP), are maintained in the version-independent resource data. 2 Master Data 70 As shown in Figure 2.25, you can enter the Resource and the Location in the initial screen. In the Model and Plng Version section, enter the Planning Version “000” for the active version of the resource, or check the Model-Independent Selection checkbox to access the model-independent version of the resource. Click the Change Resources but- ton or the Display Resources button to change or display the resource details, respec- tively. Figure 2.25 Resource Master in PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA: Initial Screen Tip When the work centers are transferred to embedded PP/DS, the work center name is prefixed with the letter “W”, and the suffix of the location and the capacity category is added. For example, work center S4PPDS_W created in plant 0001 with capacity cate- gory 001 is created as WS4PPDS_W_0001_001 in PP/DS. In the details of the PP/DS resource, the resource and basic information is displayed in list form, when the Model-Independent Selection checkbox is set and the Planning Ver- sion is also set in the selection screen shown in Figure 2.25, the resource master data in version 000 and also the version-independent resource master are listed (see Figure 2.26 1) and the details are available in the individual tabs 2. Under the PP/DS Bucket Cap. tab, there is an option to set the PP/DS bucket capacity, which is used for planning capacity at a daily or shift-wise buckets, but that isn’t valid for embedded PP/DS. The only bucket capacity supported in SAP S/4HANA is the block planning scenario bucket, which is set when the resource is enabled for block planning. We’ll cover more details about block planning in Chapter 8, Section 8.3.2, when discussing advanced PP/DS fea- tures. © 71 2.4 Work Centers and Resources Figure 2.26 PP/DS Resource Master Data: Details In the ExternalCap. tab, you can view the source of the capacity definition. If the External Capacity checkbox is selected, the capacity defined in the SAP S/4HANA work center is considered for the capacity definition. If the capacity definition needs to be maintained in embedded PP/DS, the External Capacity checkbox should not be selected. The downtimes or nonworking times due to planned or repair maintenance of the resources can be directly maintained in the Downtimes tab of the resource master. In addition, when an SAP S/4HANA plant maintenance order can be integrated into PP/DS and a work center is assigned to the maintenance order, the maintenance duration is entered automatically as downtime in the PP/DS resource master. Specific fields such as the Setup Matrix shown in Figure 2.26 can be changed in the PP/DS resource master. Other settings for the resource are only maintained in the SAP S/4HANA work center under the APO Resource view under the capacity header, as shown earlier in Figure 2.24. Warning Clicking on the overview/details or (Ctrl)+(F8) in the resource displays the resource details in an overview list that enables you to change values for fields that aren’t edit- able in the detailed screen of the PP/DS resource master. Changing values here can cre- ate conflicts with the SAP S/4HANA work center master data, so don’t change any values in the overview option for fields available in the SAP S/4HANA work center APO Resource view. 2 Master Data 72

בלשונית PPO Capacity Constraints, מתוחזקים הפרמטרים ל-Production Planning Optimizer (הוצג ב-S/4HANA 2020, מסייע בהשגת production plan אופטימלי; פרטים בפרק 5, סעיף 5.8).

כפי שב-Figure 2.25, הזינו את ה-Resource וה-Location. בסעיף Model and Plng Version, הזינו Planning Version "000" ל-version הפעיל, או סמנו Model-Independent Selection ל-version הבלתי-תלוי-model. לחצו Change/Display Resources.

sections.title: Resources
sections.en: 2.4.2 Resources In production planning for process industries in SAP S/4HANA (in SAP ERP, known as PP-PI) with process industry scenarios where continuous flow, processing, and storage vessels are required to be modeled in the master data, resources are created instead of work centers. One of the main differences between the resources and work centers is the category of the work center or the resource. In work center creation, you have the options to assign categories such as Machine, Labor, or Production Line. In resources, you have categories such as Processing Unit, Storage Resources, and the combination of both, depending on the resource category. In this section, we’ll see examples of the Processing Unit and Storage Resource categories. Resources are created in the SAP S/4HANA system using Transaction CRC1 or via the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Production – Process  Master Data  Resources  Resource  Create. In the initial screen for resource creation, enter the Plant and a name for the Resource. Select the Resource category as 0015 – Proc. unit/Stor . res., as shown in Figure 2.27. Figure 2.27 Resource Creation in Production Planning for Process Industries: Initial Screen In the next screen, fill in all required fields such as the Person Responsible and the Usage. The Stor. Loc. Res., which represents the storage location, is assigned to the resource, as shown in Figure 2.28. For resources that can store materials, the inventory available in this assigned storage location is leveraged by PP/DS in the tank planning functionality. We’ll cover the details of tank planning in Chapter 8, Section 8.5. © 73 2.4 Work Centers and Resources For making the resource available in PP/DS, activate the Advanced Planning checkbox. Figure 2.28 Resource Creation in SAP S/4HANA Navigate to the Capacities tab, and click on the Capacity header. In the capacity header, click on the APO Resource button. As shown in Figure 2.29, navigate to the Storage Characteristics tab to enter the PP/DS storage properties of the resource. Activation of the Storage Characteristics checkbox defines the resource as a resource with storage capacity apart from the production capacity. For example, the production capacity indicates that the resource has an availability of 24 hours, and the storage capacity indicates that the resource can also store a maximum of 10,000 gallons of liq- uids. As shown in Figure 2.29, enter the Storage Dimension, which is typically mass or vol- ume. Also enter a unit of measurement for the storage capacity (Stock Unit), along with the Min Production Qty (minimum production quantity, which must be filled for the 2 Master Data 74 storage resource) and the Maximum Stock Level of the storage resource. The Set Remaining Fill Level to Zero checkbox helps in ensuring product purity of the materials stored in the storage resource. For example, if Liquid 1 is to be filled in the storage resource, and that resource has Liquid 2 in storage already, with this flag set, the system sets the resource’s fill level to 0 and raises an alert in PP/DS to inform the scheduler that the resource contains another product. But if there is a small remaining quantity of the product in the storage resource that is under a certain value, the system is allowed to set the resource’s fill level to 0, and this value is maintained in the Threshold (Set Zero) field. When the Allow Multiple Products checkbox is switched on, the system allows multiple materials to be stored in the storage container at the same time. There- fore, this flag and Set Remaining Fill Level to Zero are mutually exclusive. Figure 2.29 Maintenance of Storage Characteristics in the Resource Master Data in SAP S/4HANA In the table under Time-Dependent Storage Data, Min. Production Qty, Maximum Stock Level, and Threshold (Set Zero) can be maintained in a time-phased manner. For exam- ple, if the maximum storage can be 10,000 gallons in the colder months, and the max- imum storage can only be 8,000 gallons in the warmer months, it can be achieved by the time-dependent storage data settings shown in Figure 2.29. Resources that aren’t storage relevant are created with the Processing Unit resource category, and only the capacity details are maintained in the capacity header of the resource master in the SAP S/4HANA system. © 75
