sections.title: Sources of Supply
sections.en: 2.5 Sources of Supply 2.5 Sources of Supply In this section, we’ll cover the various sources of supply supported in the SAP S/4HANA system and how these can be transferred to PP/DS for their usage in planning. The sources of supply in embedded PP/DS refers to how the material will be produced or procured. For in-house production of products, the sources of supply in SAP S/4HANA include bills of material (BOMs), routings, and production versions, which combine the BOM and routing for a specific product. In addition, for the process industries, the mas- ter recipe is the in-house source of supply that comprises the manufacturing steps in the form of operations and phases in production and the BOM. Materials that are procured externally from suppliers and materials transferred between plants, which are the external procurement sources of supplies in ERP sys- tems, include purchase info records, scheduling agreements, and contracts.
sections.he:
בסעיף זה נכסה את ה-sources of supply השונים הנתמכים ב-S/4HANA וכיצד להעבירם ל-PP/DS לשימוש בתכנון.
ה-sources of supply ב-embedded PP/DS מתייחס לאופן שבו החומר ייוצר או יירכש. לייצור-בית, ה-sources of supply ב-S/4HANA כוללים bills of material (BOMs), ‏routings, ו-production versions (המשלבים BOM ו-routing למוצר ספציפי). בנוסף, ל-process industries, ה-master recipe הוא ה-in-house source of supply הכולל את צעדי הייצור בצורת operations ו-phases וה-BOM.
חומרים הנרכשים חיצונית מספקים וחומרים המועברים בין plants — ה-external procurement sources of supplies ב-ERP — כוללים purchase info records, ‏scheduling agreements, ו-contracts.

sections.title: Production Data Structure
sections.en: 2.5.1 Production Data Structure For the in-house sources of supply in embedded PP/DS, the source of supply is called a production data structure (PDS), which contains all the basic, material, and scheduling information as defined in SAP S/4HANA BOMs, routings, and production versions. As shown in Figure 2.30, the validity of dates, lot sizes for which this production version can be used, and the BOM and routing information are maintained in the production version master data. Figure 2.30 Production Version Master Data in SAP S/4HANA
sections.he: ל-in-house sources of supply ב-embedded PP/DS, ה-source נקרא production data structure (PDS), המכיל את כל המידע הבסיסי, החומרי, וה-scheduling כפי שמוגדר ב-BOMs, ‏routings, ו-production versions של S/4HANA. כפי שב-Figure 2.30, תוקף התאריכים, ה-lot sizes שעבורם ניתן להשתמש ב-production version, ומידע ה-BOM וה-routing מתוחזקים ב-production version master data.

sections.title: Transfer of Routing to PP/DS as Production Data Structures
sections.en: 2.5.2 Transfer of Routing to PP/DS as Production Data Structures Execute Transaction CURTOADV_CREATE to create the PDSs in embedded PP/DS by processing SAP S/4HANA master data. You can also navigate to SAP menu path, Logis- tics  Production  Master Data  PDS for Advanced Planning  PDS Transfer (PP/DS), to execute the transfer. 2 Master Data 76 The material for which the PDS is being transferred must be flagged for advanced plan- ning. If multiple material components are part of the BOM, only the material compo- nents flagged for advanced planning will be created as the components in the PDS data in embedded PP/DS. Similarly, the operations to which the work centers are assigned to the routing opera- tions must be flagged for advanced planning. Standard value key—the scheduling and capacity requirements formula—should be maintained in the work center data. The routing operation must also have a nonzero activity time calculated during the sched- uling, and the control key assigned to the operation should allow scheduling. Note In SAP S/4HANA, it’s mandatory to have production versions for the consideration of BOMs and routings in the MRP run and source of supply determination. You can use report CS_BOM_PRODVER_MIGRATION02 to create production versions in an auto- mated manner. The selection screen of the PDS transfer is shown in Figure 2.31. The PDS must be avail- able in the PP/DS active version, so enter the value “000” for Pl. Version in APO, and then enter the selection options for which you need to transfer the PDS to embedded PP/DS under Selection Criteria. PDSs are also used to manage the component requirements in the subcontracting sce- narios, where a product is manufactured completely or partly by a third-party vendor, and the plant sends the components to the vendor to complete the manufacturing pro- cess. In these cases, a production version for manufacturing is linked to the purchase info records or scheduling agreements, and the corresponding PDSs also can be created in embedded PP/DS. You can define the relevance of the PDS for the subcontracting scenario in the PDS Type section of the selection screen. You can see more options for the PDS transfer by scrolling down the screen, as shown in Figure 2.32. You can use the Extended Consistency Check checkbox to ensure the con- sistency of the PDS data in embedded PP/DS. Because this performance-intensive option does a lot of checks and validations, don’t use the Extended Consistency Check setting for transferring the PDS data periodically. © 77 2.5 Sources of Supply Figure 2.31 PDS Transfer to PP/DS: Selection Screen Figure 2.32 PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA: PDS Transfer Options When errors are generated in embedded PP/DS during the PDS transfer, the changes in master data aren’t transferred from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS. However, the PDS will continue to be used in the PP/DS planning. If you want to avoid this situation, select the Lock PDS in error case checkbox in the options. This will lock the PDS and avoid its usage in planning until the PDS integration is successfully completed. 2 Master Data 78 Checking the Absolute Transfer checkbox to perform a complete transfer of the PDS data to PP/DS will regenerate the PDS based on the date from SAP S/4HANA. Conversely, the Change Transfer option is used for sending the changes made to SAP S/4HANA mas- ter data, such as BOMs, routings, and production versions, after the PDS is transferred to PP/DS. The transfer mode Absolute Transfer (Delta Mode) will create PDSs in PP/DS for newly created production versions in SAP S/4HANA, for example, if there are 10 PDSs that are already created in a plant for existing production versions and 3 new production ver- sions created in the SAP S/4HANA system. When executing the PDS creation via Trans- action CURTOADV_CREATE, with Plant as the only selection option and with the transfer mode Absolute Transfer (Delta Mode), this will only create the three new PDSs. With the transfer mode Absolute Transfer, it will send all 13 production versions to PP/DS for PDS generation. Tip Use Transaction CURTOADV_CRT_FOCUS for creating PDSs corresponding to order or work breakdown structure (WBS) BOMs in SAP S/4HANA. Because the WBS and order BOMs are specific to the sales order documents and WBS elements in the project sys- tem, a separate transaction is provided for selecting the order and WBS BOMs. The PDS transfer can be executed in interactive mode using Transaction /SAPAPO/ CURTOADV_CREATE or can be scheduled as a background job with a selection variant defined for this transaction. The transfer logs are displayed immediately in the interac- tive mode, and the transfer log can be viewed from the application logs in background mode via Transaction SLG1 by entering “CIF” in the Object field. In embedded PP/DS, Transaction /SAPAPO/CURTO_SIMU is used to select and display the PDS data. As shown in Figure 2.33, after executing the transaction, you enter the Product Number, Location, and Planning Version in the selection screen to filter the PDS selection. Additional selections are also possible by providing an Order Number in embedded PP/DS where the PDS is used. In addition, for the PDSs that have a specific account assignment, such as a sales order, the Special Stock and Account Assignment Element fields can be used for selection with the sales document number. These sales documents should be transferred before the PDSs are generated with reference to them. Click the Execute button to display the list of PDSs selected per the selection criteria provided. In the next screen, the list of PDSs is displayed, as shown in Figure 2.34. To view the details, double-click on the corresponding PDS in the list. In the list view on the first section of the screen, the basic details from the SAP S/4HANA production version are displayed. The validity dates and lot sizes are copied from the production version data. © 79 2.5 Sources of Supply Figure 2.33 PP/DS PDS Selection Screen Figure 2.34 PDS Display in PP/DS 2 Master Data 80 The PDS details are shown in multiple sections and tabs, as shown in Figure 2.34:  Components All the material components that are transferred from the BOM linked to the pro- duction version are shown here. The header of the BOM is listed as an output com- ponent, and the components of the BOM are listed as input components.  Operations The operations that are relevant to PP/DS are transferred to this tab of the PDS. For master recipes, the operations and the phases under the operations are also listed here.  Activities One operation can contain multiple activities, such as the setup, production, and tear-down activities. The activities for all the operations are listed in this tab. The lot size dependency of the operation and also the base quantity defined in the opera- tion in the routing are transferred to the individual activities in the PDS. The dura- tion of the activities is calculated by the standard values for the activities defined in the routing operations.  Activity Relatshps The activities belonging to different operations form relationships in the PDS based on the relationships defined in the routing operations. For example, activities fol- lowing a sequence will have an end-start relationship. The relationships of all the operations activities are listed in this tab.  Sequence Groups When parallel sequences are maintained in the routing, the sequence group infor- mation is listed in the Sequence Groups tab. The created modes are shown under the activities. The mode is the object in the PDS that holds the actual duration of the activity. As shown in Figure 2.35, the setup, prod- uct and teardown activities have their own modes, and the duration of the modes are calculated according to the SAP S/4HANA work center formula and the standard values maintained in the SAP S/4HANA routing. The calculated value in the routings can be checked by executing the scheduling in the routing. During the PDS transfer to PP/DS, similar calculations are performed to determine the mode durations in the PDS. The mode durations are calculated with seconds as the unit of measure for the time. For checking the scheduling result of the routing in Transaction CA03, in the menu bar, select Extras  Scheduling  Schedule. The mapping of the operation durations based on the routing scheduling and the cor- responding values in the PDS modes is shown in Figure 2.35. For example, the 10 min duration 1 for the produce activity (displayed as Edit in Figure 2.35 2) of the operation 0010 3 is shown as 600 seconds of mode duration 4 in the PDS under the Produce activity 5. © 81 2.5 Sources of Supply Figure 2.35 Mapping of Mode Durations in PP/DS PDS from SAP S/4HANA Routings Tip When work centers in SAP S/4HANA are assigned with a class of type 019 with the same characteristics value, and if the routing operation is also assigned with the same class and the same characteristics value, during the PDS transfer all such work centers are created as alternative modes under the activity. For example, work centers WC1, WC2, and WC3 have class C1 and characteristics CHR1 with value of V1, and the routing operation is also assigned with Class CI with value V1 for the CHR1 characteristics. In this case, the PDS in PP/DS will have three alternative modes with WC1, WC2, and WC3 as possible resources under the activities generated from the routing operation. In embedded PP/DS, the PDS is only available for display, meaning the information can’t be changed. For the data that originates from the SAP S/4HANA master data (e.g., BOM, routing, and production version), the source of truth is the SAP S/4HANA master data, which can’t be changed in the PDS. However, some of the PP/DS PDS data can be maintained in Transaction PDS_MAINT in SAP S/4HANA. Procurement priority of the PDS for the source of supply selection during the planning run or the costs associated with the individual PDSs can be main- tained in Transaction PDS_MAINT. After such PP/DS PDS data is maintained via the maintenance transaction, the PDS needs to be retransferred to embedded PP/DS using Transaction CURTOADV_CREATE to reflect the changes there. 2 Master Data 82 Tip When PDSs are copied into inactive planning versions (000 is the active planning ver- sion to which the PDS is integrated from SAP S/4HANA), Transaction /SAPAPO/CURTO_ EDIT can be used to edit the PDS.
sections.he:
הריצו Transaction CURTOADV_CREATE ליצירת PDSs ב-embedded PP/DS ע"י עיבוד master data של S/4HANA. ניתן גם menu path: ‏Logistics • Production • Master Data • PDS for Advanced Planning • PDS Transfer (PP/DS).
החומר שעבורו ה-PDS מועבר חייב להיות מסומן ל-advanced planning. אם מרכיבי חומר מרובים חלק מה-BOM, רק המסומנים ל-advanced planning ייווצרו כ-components ב-PDS. בדומה, ה-operations שאליהן ה-work centers מוקצים בפעולות ה-routing חייבות להיות מסומנות. ה-standard value key (נוסחת ה-scheduling ו-capacity requirements) צריך להיות מתוחזק בנתוני ה-work center. פעולת ה-routing חייבת גם זמן activity לא-אפס המחושב בעת ה-scheduling, וה-control key המוקצה צריך לאפשר scheduling.
**הערה:** ב-S/4HANA, חובה production versions להתחשבות ב-BOMs ו-routings בריצת ה-MRP ובקביעת ה-source of supply. ניתן להשתמש בדוח CS_BOM_PRODVER_MIGRATION02 ליצירת production versions אוטומטית.
מסך הבחירה של ה-PDS transfer ב-Figure 2.31. ה-PDS חייב להיות זמין ב-PP/DS active version, לכן הזינו "000" ל-Pl. Version in APO, ואז את אפשרויות הבחירה תחת Selection Criteria.
‏PDSs משמשים גם לניהול דרישות רכיבים ב-subcontracting, שבו מוצר מיוצר במלואו/חלקית ע"י vendor צד-שלישי, וה-plant שולח את הרכיבים. במקרים אלו, ‏production version לייצור מקושר ל-purchase info records או scheduling agreements, וה-PDSs המתאימים נוצרים. ניתן להגדיר את רלוונטיות ה-PDS ל-subcontracting בסעיף PDS Type.
ניתן לראות אפשרויות נוספות בגלילה (Figure 2.32). ה-Extended Consistency Check checkbox מבטיח עקביות נתוני ה-PDS. מכיוון שאפשרות זו עתירת-ביצועים ומבצעת בדיקות רבות, אל תשתמשו בה להעברת PDS תקופתית.
כשנוצרות שגיאות ב-embedded PP/DS בעת ה-transfer, שינויי ה-master data אינם מועברים, אך ה-PDS ימשיך לשמש בתכנון. כדי להימנע, סמנו Lock PDS in error case — נועל את ה-PDS ומונע שימושו עד השלמת האינטגרציה.
סימון Absolute Transfer לביצוע העברה מלאה יחדש את ה-PDS לפי הנתונים מ-S/4HANA. ה-Change Transfer משמש לשליחת שינויי ה-master data (BOMs, ‏routings, ‏production versions) לאחר ההעברה.
מצב ההעברה Absolute Transfer (Delta Mode) ייצור PDSs ל-production versions חדשים שנוצרו. למשל, אם 10 PDSs כבר נוצרו ב-plant ו-3 production versions חדשים נוצרו, הרצת CURTOADV_CREATE עם Plant כאפשרות יחידה ומצב Absolute Transfer (Delta Mode) תיצור רק את ה-3 החדשים. עם Absolute Transfer, יישלחו כל 13.
**טיפ:** השתמשו ב-Transaction CURTOADV_CRT_FOCUS ליצירת PDSs המתאימים ל-order או work breakdown structure (WBS) BOMs. מכיוון ש-WBS ו-order BOMs ספציפיים למסמכי sales order ו-WBS elements ב-project system, מסופקת טרנזקציה נפרדת.
ה-PDS transfer ניתן לביצוע אינטראקטיבי ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CURTOADV_CREATE או כ-background job עם selection variant. לוגי ההעברה מוצגים מיד במצב אינטראקטיבי, ובמצב background ניתן לצפות מ-application logs דרך Transaction SLG1 בהזנת "CIF" בשדה Object.
ב-embedded PP/DS, ‏Transaction /SAPAPO/CURTO_SIMU משמש לבחירה והצגה של נתוני PDS. כפי שב-Figure 2.33, הזינו Product Number, ‏Location, ו-Planning Version. בחירות נוספות אפשריות ע"י Order Number. בנוסף, ל-PDSs עם account assignment ספציפי (כגון sales order), שדות ה-Special Stock ו-Account Assignment Element. מסמכי sales אלו צריכים להיות מועברים לפני יצירת ה-PDSs בהפניה אליהם. לחצו Execute.
במסך הבא, רשימת ה-PDSs מוצגת (Figure 2.34). לפרטים, לחיצה כפולה. ב-list view, פרטי ה-production version הבסיסיים מוצגים. תאריכי התוקף וה-lot sizes מועתקים מנתוני ה-production version. פרטי ה-PDS בלשוניות:
• **Components** — כל מרכיבי החומר מה-BOM. ה-header של ה-BOM כ-output component, וה-components כ-input components.
• **Operations** — הפעולות הרלוונטיות ל-PP/DS. ל-master recipes, גם ה-operations וה-phases.
• **Activities** — operation יכול להכיל activities מרובות (setup, ‏production, ‏tear-down). תלות ה-lot size וה-base quantity מועברות ל-activities. משך ה-activities מחושב לפי ה-standard values.
• **Activity Relatshps** — ה-activities מ-operations שונות יוצרות relationships לפי ה-routing. למשל, רצף יוצר end-start relationship.
• **Sequence Groups** — כשמתוחזקים parallel sequences ב-routing, מידע ה-sequence group מוצג.
ה-modes מוצגים תחת ה-activities. ה-mode הוא ה-object ב-PDS המחזיק את משך ה-activity בפועל. כפי שב-Figure 2.35, ל-setup, ‏product, ו-teardown activities יש modes משלהם, והמשכים מחושבים לפי נוסחת ה-work center של S/4HANA וה-standard values ב-routing. המשכים מחושבים בשניות. לבדיקת תוצאת ה-scheduling של ה-routing ב-Transaction CA03, בתפריט: ‏Extras • Scheduling • Schedule.
מיפוי משכי הפעולות מ-routing scheduling לערכי ה-PDS modes ב-Figure 2.35. למשל, 10 דקות לפעולת ה-produce (Edit) של operation 0010 מוצגות כ-600 שניות mode duration ב-PDS תחת ה-Produce activity.
**טיפ:** כש-work centers ב-S/4HANA מוקצים ל-class מסוג 019 עם אותו ערך characteristics, ואם פעולת ה-routing גם מוקצית לאותו class וערך, בעת ה-transfer כל ה-work centers נוצרים כ-alternative modes תחת ה-activity. למשל, ‏WC1, ‏WC2, ו-WC3 עם class C1 ו-characteristics CHR1 בערך V1, ופעולת ה-routing מוקצית גם ל-Class C1 בערך V1 — ה-PDS יכיל שלושה alternative modes עם WC1/WC2/WC3.
ב-embedded PP/DS, ה-PDS זמין לתצוגה בלבד — המידע אינו ניתן לשינוי. לנתונים שמקורם ב-master data של S/4HANA (BOM, ‏routing, ‏production version), ה-source of truth הוא ה-master data של S/4HANA.
אולם חלק מנתוני ה-PP/DS PDS ניתנים לתחזוקה ב-Transaction PDS_MAINT ב-S/4HANA — ‏procurement priority לבחירת source בריצת התכנון, או עלויות. לאחר התחזוקה, יש להעביר-מחדש את ה-PDS דרך Transaction CURTOADV_CREATE.
**טיפ:** כש-PDSs מועתקים ל-planning versions לא-פעילים (000 הוא הפעיל), ‏Transaction /SAPAPO/CURTO_EDIT משמש לעריכת ה-PDS.

sections.title: Transfer of Master Recipes as Production Data Structures to PP/DS
sections.en: 2.5.3 Transfer of Master Recipes as Production Data Structures to PP/DS When production planning for process industries recipes is used in the SAP S/4HANA system for process manufacturing scenarios, the overall process of transferring the production version from SAP S/4HANA to a PDS in PP/DS remains similar to the trans- fer of routings to PP/DS as PDSs. But for the determination of the activities under the operations, a different method is used. The structure of the production planning for process industries master recipe is shown in Figure 2.36. Master recipes are created in the SAP S/4HANA system using Transaction C201. Unlike the routings, in master recipes, the operations have phases under them. For example, in a scenario where a chemical reaction operation of a manufacturing process is involved, and that operation requires 30 min of setup time to clean the reac- tor vessel and 1 hour of reaction time per 100 KG of materials, the recipe will have an operation 1 for Chemical Reaction under which phases 2 will be created. The first phase is for the clean-up/setup time, and the second phase is created for the actual chemical reaction process. Figure 2.36 Structure of a Master Recipe in SAP S/4HANA For the PDS transfer to PP/DS, the setup phase will be identified by the assignment of a setup group to the phase of the master recipe. Phases with a setup group will become setup activities under the operation in the PDS, and other phases will be transferred as product activities. Apart from the setup group assignment to the phase in the master © 83 2.5 Sources of Supply recipe, it’s also required to have a finish-start (FS) relationship between the setup and produce phases in the master recipe. The setup group needs to be integrated to PP/DS before the transfer of the PDS. Maintenance and integration of setup groups will be covered in Section 2.8. In the example shown in Figure 2.37, phase 0020 is assigned with a setup group 1 and has a FS relationship 2 with the phase 0030. The mapping of this phase as a setup activity in the PDS is also shown in Figure 2.37. The phase with the setup group assigned is created as a setup activity 3, and the duration of the setup activity is set as 30 min (1,800 sec 4). Figure 2.37 Mapping of the Setup Phase to the Setup Activity between Master Recipe and PDS
sections.he:
כש-production planning for process industries recipes משמשים ב-S/4HANA, התהליך הכולל של העברת ה-production version ל-PDS דומה להעברת routings. אך לקביעת ה-activities תחת ה-operations, משמשת שיטה שונה.
מבנה ה-master recipe ב-Figure 2.36. ‏master recipes נוצרים ב-S/4HANA ב-Transaction C201. בשונה מ-routings, ב-master recipes יש phases תחת ה-operations. למשל, בתרחיש עם chemical reaction operation הדורש 30 דקות setup לניקוי הריאקטור ושעה reaction ל-100 KG, ל-recipe תהיה operation ל-Chemical Reaction שתחתיה phases. ה-phase הראשון לזמן clean-up/setup, והשני לתהליך ה-chemical reaction.
ל-PDS transfer, ה-setup phase יזוהה ע"י הקצאת setup group ל-phase של ה-master recipe. ‏phases עם setup group יהפכו ל-setup activities תחת ה-operation ב-PDS, ואחרים ל-product activities. מעבר להקצאת ה-setup group, נדרשת גם finish-start (FS) relationship בין ה-setup ל-produce phases. ה-setup group צריך להיות משולב ל-PP/DS לפני ה-transfer (תחזוקה ואינטגרציה בסעיף 2.8). בדוגמה (Figure 2.37), ‏phase 0020 מוקצה ל-setup group ויש לו FS relationship עם phase 0030. ה-phase עם ה-setup group נוצר כ-setup activity, ומשך ה-setup נקבע ל-30 דקות (1,800 שניות).

sections.title: External Procurement Sources of Supply
sections.en: 2.5.4 External Procurement Sources of Supply In SAP S/4HANA, the sources of supply for external procurement include the following:  Purchase info records Purchase info records in the SAP S/4HANA system represent the purchasing relation- ship of a material with its supplier. The purchase info record contains the informa- tion-specific procurement lead times, quantity restrictions, and pricing conditions, which are valid for the material and the vendor. The info records are defined at the purchasing organization level and can also have plant-level information. In addition, the info records can be classified as standard info records or subcontracting info records, among other types. 2 Master Data 84  Scheduling agreements Scheduling agreements are documents created at the plant level for procurement of material vendors on an agreed schedule. After the scheduling agreement is in place, the schedule line releases can be manually created, or the system can create sched- ule line releases via planning runs.  Contracts Contracts or outline agreements are documents created with a negotiated value or quantity of a material and follow-on purchasing documents such as purchase orders or schedule lines created to initiate the procurement. In embedded PP/DS, the purchase info records, contracts, and scheduling agreements are supported as external procurement relationships, which can be used by PP/DS planning to determine the source of supply. The transfer of the external procurement relationships to embedded PP/DS requires creation and activation of integration mod- els as of SAP S/4HANA 1909. As discussed in Section 2.2, an integration model is created using Transaction CFM1. You’ll arrive at the Create Integration Model screen, as shown in Figure 2.38. Enter a name for the integration model in the Model Name field, and enter the Logical System and APO Application fields. The logical system in embedded PP/DS is the same as the logical system defined as the SAP S/4HANA system, as this is a self-system integration model generation. Figure 2.38 Creating the Integration Model for External Procurement Sources of Supply © 85 2.5 Sources of Supply You may choose to create multiple integration models based on the plants or other fil- tering criteria (for object-specific selection, click the button) to manage the volume and to trigger retransfers periodically to embedded PP/DS. Under Material Dependent Objects, select the checkboxes for the relevant source of supplies. In the General Selection Options for Materials, enter the selection criteria with which the sources should be selected. In the Selection of Source of Supply section, select the Material-Dependent Source of Supply Selection checkbox to filter out the source of supplies per the selection entered in the General Selection Options for Mate- rials section. Click on the Execute button to trigger the selection for the integration model. In the next screen, as shown in Figure 2.39, the sources of supplies are selected, and you can navigate to the selected sources by clicking on the count of the selected sources under the No. Filter Objs column. Click on the Generate IM button to complete the gen- eration of the integration model. Figure 2.39 Integration Model Generation in SAP S/4HANA After the integration model is generated, use Transaction CFM2 to activate the integra- tion model (refer to Section 2.1.2). After entering the integration model details in the initial screen of Transaction CFM2, change the status of the integration model from Inactive to Active by clicking the X in the New Status box or by clicking on the Active/ Inactive button, as shown in Figure 2.40 1. After the status is set as Active 2, click on the Start button to start the transfer of data to embedded PP/DS. Queue failures may occur during this integration model activation. In interactive mode, where you execute the activation of the integration model as explained in this section, the queue errors are displayed on the screen. In background mode, the queues should be analyzed from the queue monitor to troubleshoot the errors and reprocess them. It’s also possible to activate the integration model in background mode by using ABAP program RIMODAC2. We’ll cover queue monitoring and troubleshooting in Chapter 10 for administration of embedded PP/DS. 2 Master Data 86 Figure 2.40 Activation of the Integration Model for External Sources of Supply After the integration model is activated, and the queues are successfully processed, the external sources of supplies are available for PP/DS planning. These sources are called external procurement relationships in embedded PP/DS and can be accessed using Transaction /SAPAPO/PWBSRC1 or from SAP menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  External Procurement Relationship  Display. The Change External Procurement Relationships screen appears, as shown in Figure 2.41. In the left part of the screen, the procurement relations are listed per the selection criteria and are grouped by the type of procurement relationship. Double-click on the item number of any procurement relationship to display the details of the specific source. In the General Data section, the organizational data (Purchasing Org., Dest. Loc. [plant]) and the basic information (validity dates and source/destination locations) are displayed. The Source Loc. is the location of the vendor, and the Dest. Loc. is the location of the receiving plant. Figure 2.41 External Procurement Relationships in PP/DS © 87 2.5 Sources of Supply You can click on the Display<->Change button to make the sources editable. To over- write the planned delivery time sent from SAP S/4HANA, the Plnd Del. Time is an edit- able field, and the source can be made active or inactive by selecting the Ext. proc. relationship active checkbox under the Settings section. As you can see in Figure 2.41, there is an Assigned Transportation Lanes sequence in the sources. Transportation lanes are master data generated by the system during the transfer of external procurement sources to embedded PP/DS and are assigned to the corresponding products. The procurement parameters also can be maintained at the transportation lane, and a mode of transport can be assigned to the transportation lane to ensure that the exact dates are calculated during planning for the procurement and transportation of materials from the vendor to the receiving plants. You can execute Transaction /SAPAPO/TL1 to display or change the transportation lanes. In the selection screen of this transaction, enter the Model Name “000”, which is the active PP/DS model, and all the transportation lanes integrated via the source of supply integration model are always created in the 000 model. In addition, enter the Start Location and Dest. Location, as shown in Figure 2.42. Figure 2.42 Transportation Lanes in PP/DS: Selection Screen Choose Display or Change, depending on the action you want to perform, and the details of the transportation lane are displayed in the next screen. As shown in Figure 2.43, the products and the procurement relationships using the same transportation lanes are listed in the top section of the screen 1. Selecting one of the sources will dis- play the details of the procurement on the right side of the screen; in change mode, the information specific to PP/DS can be edited and isn’t transferred back to SAP S/4HANA. A means of transport, such as rail, truck, or air, and the corresponding data can be maintained by creating a new means of transport under the Means of Transport sec- tion 2, where the means of transport common to all products in the transportation lane are located. You can also define multiple means of transport and assign specific means to specific products 3. 2 Master Data 88 Figure 2.43 Details of Transportation Lanes in PP/DS
sections.he:
ב-S/4HANA, ה-sources of supply ל-external procurement כוללים:
• **Purchase info records** — מייצגים את יחסי הרכש של חומר עם הספק. מכילים procurement lead times ספציפיים, הגבלות כמות, ו-pricing conditions התקפים לחומר ולספק. מוגדרים ברמת ה-purchasing organization ויכולים גם מידע ברמת ה-plant. ניתנים לסיווג כ-standard info records או subcontracting info records, בין השאר.
• **Scheduling agreements** — מסמכים שנוצרים ברמת ה-plant לרכש מספקי חומר ב-schedule מוסכם. לאחר ה-scheduling agreement, ניתן ליצור schedule line releases ידנית או דרך ריצות תכנון.
• **Contracts** — או outline agreements — מסמכים שנוצרים עם ערך/כמות מוסכמים, ומסמכי רכש המשך (purchase orders או schedule lines) להתנעת הרכש.
ב-embedded PP/DS, ‏purchase info records, ‏contracts, ו-scheduling agreements נתמכים כ-external procurement relationships, שיכולים לשמש את תכנון ה-PP/DS לקביעת ה-source of supply. ההעברה דורשת יצירה והפעלה של integration models מגרסת S/4HANA 1909 (Transaction CFM1, סעיף 2.2).
תגיעו למסך Create Integration Model (Figure 2.38). הזינו שם ב-Model Name, ואת ה-Logical System ו-APO Application. ה-logical system ב-embedded PP/DS זהה לזה המוגדר כמערכת S/4HANA (זוהי self-system integration model generation).
ניתן ליצור integration models מרובים לפי plants או קריטריונים אחרים לניהול הנפח ולהפעלת retransfers תקופתיים. תחת Material Dependent Objects, סמנו את ה-sources הרלוונטיים. ב-General Selection Options for Materials, הזינו קריטריונים. בסעיף Selection of Source of Supply, סמנו Material-Dependent Source of Supply Selection לסינון. לחצו Execute. במסך הבא (Figure 2.39), ה-sources נבחרים; ניתן לנווט אליהם בלחיצה על המספר תחת No. Filter Objs. לחצו Generate IM.
לאחר היצירה, השתמשו ב-Transaction CFM2 להפעלה (סעיף 2.1.2). לאחר הזנת הפרטים, שנו את הסטטוס מ-Inactive ל-Active ע"י לחיצה על ה-X ב-New Status או על Active/Inactive (Figure 2.40). לאחר Active, לחצו Start להתחלת ההעברה.
כשלי queue עשויים להתרחש בהפעלה. במצב אינטראקטיבי, שגיאות ה-queue מוצגות על המסך. במצב background, יש לנתח את ה-queues מ-queue monitor. ניתן גם להפעיל במצב background בעזרת תוכנית ABAP‏ RIMODAC2. ניטור וטיפול בפרק 10.
לאחר ההפעלה ועיבוד מוצלח, ה-external sources זמינים לתכנון PP/DS. הם נקראים external procurement relationships ונגישים ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/PWBSRC1 או menu path: ‏Logistics • Advanced Planning • Master Data • External Procurement Relationship • Display.
מסך Change External Procurement Relationships מופיע (Figure 2.41). משמאל, יחסי הרכש מוצגים ומקובצים לפי סוג. לחיצה כפולה על מספר פריט מציגה את הפרטים. בסעיף General Data, הנתונים הארגוניים (Purchasing Org., ‏Dest. Loc. [plant]) והבסיסיים (תאריכי תוקף ומיקומי source/destination). ה-Source Loc. הוא מיקום ה-vendor, וה-Dest. Loc. הוא ה-plant המקבל.
ניתן ללחוץ Display<->Change לעריכה. לדריסת ה-planned delivery time מ-S/4HANA, ה-Plnd Del. Time ניתן לעריכה, וניתן להפעיל/להשבית את ה-source ע"י Ext. proc. relationship active checkbox.
כפי שב-Figure 2.41, יש Assigned Transportation Lanes. ‏transportation lanes הם master data שנוצרים ע"י המערכת בעת ההעברה ומוקצים למוצרים. ניתן לתחזק פרמטרי רכש ב-transportation lane, ולהקצות mode of transport להבטחת חישוב תאריכים מדויקים בתכנון להעברת חומרים מה-vendor ל-plants.

Location (Figure 2.42). בחרו Display/Change. בפרטים (Figure 2.43), המוצרים ויחסי הרכש המשתמשים באותם lanes מוצגים למעלה; בחירת source מציגה את הפרטים מימין; במצב change, המידע הספציפי ל-PP/DS ניתן לעריכה ואינו מועבר חזרה ל-S/4HANA. ‏means of transport (rail, ‏truck, ‏air) ניתן לתחזק תחת Means of Transport. ניתן להגדיר means מרובים ולהקצות ספציפיים למוצרים ספציפיים.

sections.title: Classes and Characteristics
sections.en: 2.6 Classes and Characteristics In this section, we’ll discuss the usage of classes and characteristics in embedded PP/DS as well as how the classes and characteristics are maintained in the system. A character- istic denotes a specific attribute of a product, such as color, capacity, usage, and so on. Characteristics that define a set of attributes of a product are grouped under a class. In PP/DS planning, there are two ways to use the classification system:  Characteristics-dependent planning (CDP) CDP is used in in-house manufacturing processes to match the characteristics of the demand element, such as sales order or dependent demand, to a supply element that has the same characteristics value assignment (also called characteristics valua- tion). The CDP scenario supports both make-to-stock (MTS) and make-to-order (MTO) planning scenarios.  Variant configuration (VC) VC is used for complex configurable products mainly in MTO scenarios where the specification of the product in the sales order drives the manufacturing processes. Either in CDP or VC scenarios, the classes and characteristics play the major role in transferring the configuration of the product from the demand level to the manufac- turing level. Class types are defined in the SAP S/4HANA system to allow them to be © 89 2.6 Classes and Characteristics used in a specific scenario. We’ll cover the configuration schema (CDP versus VC) of the PP/DS system in Chapter 3 when we discuss configuration. You can execute Transaction CT04 to create, change, and delete characteristics master data, as shown in Figure 2.44. Figure 2.44 Maintenance of Characteristics Master Data The Basic data fields, such as the Description and Status of the class, are maintained in the Basic data tab, and the allowed values for this characteristic can be maintained in the Values tab. For complex configuration scenarios, a cross-reference to a specific table reference can be done in the Addnl data tab. Classes are created using Transaction CL01 and can be maintained from Transaction CL02. The characteristics are assigned to the class. Class of type 300 is used in VC scenarios, and the same is available for PP/DS in the VC scenario. There is no need to create an integration model for making the class of type 300 to be available for PP/DS. The class assignment to the material in the VC scenario is done in the SAP S/4HANA material master in the classification view, and the same can be displayed in embedded PP/DS when the material is marked for advanced plan- ning. As shown in Figure 2.45, you can display the product master data in embedded PP/DS using Transaction /SAPAPO/MAT1. 2 Master Data 90 Figure 2.45 Display of Classification Data in the PP/DS Product Master From the Classification tab, click on the Classes button to display the classes assigned to the material master, which is visible to PP/DS. Here, you can see Class Type 300. When the configuration schema is set to CDP in embedded PP/DS, class types 023 (batch class) and 300 (variant class) need to be integrated into embedded PP/DS. This will create a new class with type 400 (CDP class) with the same class name in embedded PP/DS. To integrate the classes of type 023 and 300 using an integration model, follow these steps: 1. Define an organizational area in the Customizing Transaction O1CL. In this transac- tion, select the entry for MARA, and select the Organizational Areas folder, as shown in Figure 2.46. Make entries for the relevant class types, and enter an organizational area (in the O column). Organizational area can be any character with one-character length. This organizational area is the selection criteria available for the integration model generation for transferring the class data to PP/DS for CDP. 2. As shown in Figure 2.47, enter the organizational area information in the class mas- ter data, which needs to be transferred to PP/DS for CDP. This can be performed from the transaction for class maintenance—Transaction CL02. Enter the Organizational area under the Basic data tab. In addition, enter the organizational area in the Char. (characteristics assignment) tab in the class master data as well. © 91 2.6 Classes and Characteristics Figure 2.46 Creation of Organizational Areas for Classes Figure 2.47 Maintenance of Organizational Area Data in Class Master Data 2 Master Data 92 3. Create an integration model with the selection of classes and characteristics, and then activate the integration model. First, access the Create Integration Model screen by executing Transaction CFM1, as shown in Figure 2.48. 4. Select Classes/Charact under Material Independent Objects, and in the object-specific selection, enter the Org.area ind, which is assigned to the classes. Activate the inte- gration model to transfer the classes to embedded PP/DS (Section 2.1.2). Figure 2.48 Integration Model Creation for CDP Classes After the integration model is activated, it will create a class of type 400 (CDP class) in embedded PP/DS with the same class name.
sections.he:
בסעיף זה נדון בשימוש ב-classes ו-characteristics ב-embedded PP/DS וכיצד הם מתוחזקים. ‏characteristic מציין תכונה ספציפית של מוצר (color, ‏capacity, ‏usage וכו'). ‏characteristics המגדירות סט תכונות מקובצות תחת class.
בתכנון PP/DS, שתי דרכים להשתמש ב-classification system:
• **Characteristics-dependent planning (CDP)** — משמש בייצור-בית להתאמת ה-characteristics של אלמנט הביקוש (sales order או dependent demand) ל-supply element בעל אותו ערך characteristics (characteristics valuation). תומך ב-make-to-stock (MTS) וב-make-to-order (MTO).
• **Variant configuration (VC)** — למוצרים configurable מורכבים בעיקר ב-MTO, שבו מפרט המוצר ב-sales order מניע את הייצור.
ב-CDP או VC, ה-classes וה-characteristics ממלאים תפקיד מרכזי בהעברת התצורה מרמת הביקוש לרמת הייצור. ‏Class types מוגדרים ב-S/4HANA לאפשר שימושם בתרחיש ספציפי. סכמת התצורה (CDP מול VC) בפרק 3.
הריצו Transaction CT04 ליצירה/שינוי/מחיקה של characteristics master data (Figure 2.44). שדות ה-Basic data (Description, ‏Status) בלשונית Basic data, והערכים המותרים בלשונית Values. לתרחישי תצורה מורכבים, ניתן cross-reference ל-table reference בלשונית Addnl data.
‏classes נוצרים ב-Transaction CL01 ומתוחזקים ב-CL02. ה-characteristics מוקצים ל-class.
‏class מסוג 300 משמש ב-VC, וזמין ל-PP/DS ב-VC. אין צורך ב-integration model להפיכת class 300 זמין. הקצאת ה-class לחומר ב-VC נעשית ב-classification view של ה-material master, וניתן להציג ב-embedded PP/DS כשהחומר מסומן ל-advanced planning (Transaction /SAPAPO/MAT1, Figure 2.45).
מלשונית Classification, לחצו על Classes להצגת ה-classes המוקצים, הגלויים ל-PP/DS. כאן רואים Class Type 300. כשסכמת התצורה היא CDP, יש לשלב class types 023 (batch class) ו-300 (variant class) — זה ייצור class חדש מסוג 400 (CDP class) באותו שם.
לשילוב classes 023 ו-300 דרך integration model:
1. הגדירו organizational area ב-Customizing Transaction O1CL. בחרו את הרשומה ל-MARA, ובחרו תיקיית Organizational Areas (Figure 2.46). הזינו רשומות ל-class types הרלוונטיים ו-organizational area (בעמודה O) — תו באורך תו אחד. זהו קריטריון הבחירה ל-integration model להעברת נתוני ה-class ל-CDP.
2. הזינו את ה-organizational area בנתוני ה-class master הדורשים העברה (Transaction CL02, Figure 2.47). הזינו ב-Basic data tab וגם בלשונית Char. (characteristics assignment).
3. צרו integration model עם בחירת classes ו-characteristics, ואז הפעילו (Transaction CFM1, Figure 2.48).
4. בחרו Classes/Charact תחת Material Independent Objects, וב-object-specific selection הזינו את ה-Org.area ind המוקצה. הפעילו (סעיף 2.1.2).
לאחר ההפעלה, ייווצר class מסוג 400 (CDP class) באותו שם.

sections.title: Quota Arrangements
sections.en: 2.7 Quota Arrangements Quota arrangements are used to allocate the demand quantities to multiple receipts using different sources of supplies in a predefined ratio. This can be for both in-house manufacturing sources of supplies for in-house manufacturing and external procure- ment sources of supply for external procurement. When multiple sources of supplies are available, the quota arrangement master data is used to determine what portion of the demand is fulfilled by which source. For the in- © 93 2.7 Quota Arrangements house production scenario, the quota can allocate the demand quantities between available PDSs. For example, if there are two manufacturing lines represented by two different PDSs in PP/DS, and if you want to allocate 70% of the demand to line 1 and 30% of the demand to line 2, this can be achieved by setting up the quota arrangement master data. Similarly for external procurement, where there are multiple vendors sup- plying the same material and you want to split the demand between these available vendors in a certain percentage allocation, quota arrangement can help. In addition, if there are stock transfer scenarios, such as two plants that can supply the material to one plant, and you want to allocate the demand to the supplying plants in certain per- centages, the quota arrangement can be leveraged by assigning the percentage alloca- tion between the transportation lanes of these locations. In the embedded PP/DS system, the quota arrangement master data is created using Transaction /SAPAPO/SCC_TQ1 or the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Quota Arrangement  Quota Arrangement. As shown in Figure 2.49, in the initial screen of the quota arrangement, enter the Model “000” (000 is the active supply chain model in the embedded PP/DS system), and the Location in which you want to create the quota arrangement. Under the Version section, you have the option to select between Version-Independent and Version-Dependent quota arrangement. When the Version-Independent option is selected, it will be appli- cable for all planning versions (active planning version 000 and any other inactive planning versions). When the version-dependent quota arrangement is maintained, that will be given preference for consideration of the quota master data when planning is executed in the specific planning version. As shown in Figure 2.49, in this example, we’ve selected the Version-Dependent option and entered the active planning version (Plng version) “000”. Figure 2.49 Embedded PP/DS Quota Arrangement: Initial Screen 2 Master Data 94 Under Quota Arrangement Direction, there are two options available namely Inbound Quota Arrangements and Outbound Quota Arrngmnts. The PP/DS planning algorithm (heuristics) for quota arrangement–based planning only supports inbound quota arrangement, so we’ll cover the details of the setup of inbound quota arrangement. We’ll cover the details of the quota arrangement planning heuristics in Chapter 5, Sec- tion 5.3.6. Click on the Change button to navigate to the next screen. In the next screen, as shown in Figure 2.50, there are two main sections on the screen: the quota management header (Quota Ar.Headers 1). Click on the New button 2, which will open the side pane 3, where you have options to enter one material, enter all products in the location, or select multiple products using the Mass Selection option. Then, under the Validity Period section 4, you enter the end date until which the quota arrangement is valid. Under the Parameters section 5, setting Allow Reqmt Splitting (allow requirements splitting) will allow single requirement elements in the planning to be split and sourced from multiple sources per the quota arrangement. If you want the demand to be aggregated in a certain period, for example, a day, week, or month, and then the quota is applied on this cumulated quantity, you can set an appro- priate value in the Rqmts Grouping. In the example shown in Figure 2.50, the value is set with W, meaning the requirements are grouped at a weekly level. Figure 2.50 Embedded PP/DS Quota Arrangement Header © 95 2.7 Quota Arrangements When the requirements are split to be fulfilled by different sources under the maintained quota arrangement, the Min. Split Quantity (minimum split quantity) field ensures that the split demand quantity isn’t less than the value maintained here. Click on the Copy and Close button 6 to copy the entered values to the Quota Ar. Headers section. After the header is entered, as shown in Figure 2.51, select the header line 1, and click on the New button 2 under the Quota Arr. Item section. This opens the items side pane 3. In our example, we want the quota arrangement based on transportation lanes. Loca- tions PPS3 and PPS4 will supply the material demand in the location PPS2 for the mate- rial S4HANA_PPDS_004 by a 70% to 30% split. To achieve this, select the Quota Arr. for Location 4, and enter the location from which the material will be sourced. Similarly, it’s possible to set the quota arrangement based on external procurement relation- ships or in-house sources of supply. Figure 2.51 Embedded PP/DS Quota Arrangement Item Maintenance Scroll down on the side pane, and at the bottom of the screen, you’ll see the Parameters section 5, as shown in Figure 2.51. Here, in the Quota Arrangement field, enter the per- centage of the demand that this source (in our example, 70% for location PPS3) is expected to fulfill. During the planning run, once the system determines the demand split, it uses the planning algorithm of the Heuristics assigned to the quota item to plan 2 Master Data 96 and create the procurement proposals such as planned orders, purchase requisitions, or stock transfer requisitions. Once the required settings are maintained, click on the Copy and Close button 6 to copy the entry to the quota item. Repeat the same process for the other source location, and save the quota arrangement master data. Warning Under the quota item, don’t enter the quota heuristics (SAP_PP_Q001). The quota heu- ristics need to be assigned to the product in the material master, and a planning heu- ristic, such as SAP_PP_002 – Standard Lots, needs to be assigned in the item.
sections.he:
‏quota arrangements משמשים להקצאת כמויות הביקוש למספר receipts בעזרת sources שונים ביחס מוגדר-מראש. זה ל-in-house manufacturing sources ול-external procurement sources.
כשזמינים sources מרובים, ה-quota arrangement קובע איזה חלק מהביקוש מסופק ע"י איזה source. לתרחיש ייצור-בית, ה-quota יכול להקצות בין PDSs זמינים. למשל, אם שני קווי ייצור מיוצגים ע"י שני PDSs, ורוצים להקצות 70% לקו 1 ו-30% לקו 2. בדומה ל-external procurement עם vendors מרובים. בנוסף, בתרחישי stock transfer (שני plants מספקים לאחד), ה-quota arrangement ממנף ע"י הקצאת אחוז בין ה-transportation lanes.
ב-embedded PP/DS, ה-quota arrangement נוצר ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/SCC_TQ1 או menu path: ‏Logistics • Advanced Planning • Master Data • Quota Arrangement • Quota Arrangement.
כפי שב-Figure 2.49, במסך הראשוני, הזינו Model "000" (ה-active supply chain model) ואת ה-Location. תחת Version, בחרו Version-Independent או Version-Dependent. ‏Version-Independent ישים לכל ה-versions; ‏version-dependent מקבל עדיפות בתכנון ב-version ספציפי. בדוגמה נבחר Version-Dependent עם Plng version "000".
תחת Quota Arrangement Direction, שתי אפשרויות: ‏Inbound Quota Arrangements ו-Outbound Quota Arrngmnts. ה-heuristics של quota arrangement תומך רק ב-inbound, לכן נכסה את ה-inbound (פרטי ה-heuristics בפרק 5, סעיף 5.3.6). לחצו Change.
במסך הבא (Figure 2.50), שני סעיפים: ה-Quota Ar.Headers. לחצו New — נפתח side pane עם אפשרויות להזין חומר אחד, כל המוצרים ב-location, או Mass Selection. תחת Validity Period, הזינו תאריך סיום. תחת Parameters, סימון Allow Reqmt Splitting יאפשר לפצל אלמנטי דרישה בודדים ולתקצרם ממספר sources. אם רוצים לצבור ביקוש בתקופה (יום/שבוע/חודש), הזינו ב-Rqmts Grouping (בדוגמה W = שבועי).
כשהדרישות מפוצלות, ה-Min. Split Quantity מבטיח שהכמות המפוצלת לא תהיה פחות מהערך. לחצו Copy and Close.
לאחר ה-header (Figure 2.51), בחרו את שורת ה-header ולחצו New תחת Quota Arr. Item — נפתח items side pane. בדוגמה, ‏quota מבוסס transportation lanes: locations PPS3 ו-PPS4 יספקו את הביקוש ב-PPS2 לחומר S4HANA_PPDS_004 בפיצול 70%/30%. בחרו Quota Arr. for Location והזינו את ה-location שממנו יתוקצר. בדומה ניתן לפי external procurement relationships או in-house sources.
גללו ב-side pane לסעיף Parameters (Figure 2.51). בשדה Quota Arrangement, הזינו את אחוז הביקוש (70% ל-PPS3). בריצת התכנון, לאחר קביעת הפיצול, המערכת משתמשת ב-Heuristics המוקצה ל-quota item ליצירת ה-procurement proposals (planned orders, ‏purchase requisitions, ‏stock transfer requisitions). לחצו Copy and Close. חזרו ל-source השני, ושמרו.
**אזהרה:** תחת ה-quota item, אל תזינו את ה-quota heuristics (SAP_PP_Q001). ה-quota heuristics צריך להיות מוקצה למוצר ב-material master, ו-planning heuristic כגון SAP_PP_002 – Standard Lots ב-item.

sections.title: Setup Matrix
sections.en: 2.8 Setup Matrix Setup matrix master data is the definition of the changeover duration and cost between different operations executed on the same resource. The changeover duration and cost are typically based on the characteristics of the product being produced in the relevant operation. In this section, we’ll cover the details of the static setup matrix and the PP/DS generated setup matrix, which are based on the characteristics assigned to the products. In embedded PP/DS, the setup matrix is used to determine the changeover time between two operations on a resource. For example, if black paint and white paint are being packaged on the same packing line, and after a production order is executed for packing black paint, the packaging line needs a thorough cleaning before the white paint order is started. If this cleaning process takes 30 minutes (min), the changeover time from the black paint order to white paint order is 30 min. There can also be more complex changeover situations. In the preceding example, apart from the color transition, if there are multiple sizes of packed products being packed, for example, 50 grams (g), 100 g, and 500 g packaging, and they have their own changeover time to unload and reload the packaging materials to the lines, it makes the possible combinations of transitions complex. The changeover of 50 g black to 100 g black may just take 5 min because only the packaging material needs to be changed, whereas the changeover from 50 g black to 100 g white will take 30 min for cleaning and 5 min for loading the new packaging material. In addition, if the cleaning and the loading of packaging material is performed in parallel, the changeover will be 30 mins, but if these tasks are done sequentially, the changeover will be 35 min (30 min for cleaning and 5 min for loading). These possible combinations for changeovers are typ- ically maintained in a matrix. To address such simple and complex transitions in the embedded PP/DS solution, there are two setup matrix options provided:  Conventional setup matrix (static setup groups)  Generated setup matrix (dynamic setup groups) © 97 2.8 Setup Matrix
sections.he:
‏setup matrix master data היא הגדרת משך וה-cost של ה-changeover בין operations שונות המבוצעות על אותו resource. המשך והעלות בד"כ מבוססים על ה-characteristics של המוצר. בסעיף זה נכסה את ה-static setup matrix ואת ה-PP/DS generated setup matrix המבוסס על ה-characteristics.
ב-embedded PP/DS, ה-setup matrix קובע את זמן ה-changeover בין שתי operations על resource. למשל, אם black paint ו-white paint ארוזים על אותו packing line, ולאחר production order ל-black, הקו צריך ניקוי יסודי לפני white. אם הניקוי לוקח 30 דקות, זמן ה-changeover מ-black ל-white הוא 30 דקות.
יכולים להיות מצבי changeover מורכבים יותר. בנוסף למעבר צבע, אם יש גדלי אריזה מרובים (50 גרם, 100 גרם, 500 גרם) עם זמני changeover משלהם, השילובים מורכבים. ‏changeover מ-50g שחור ל-100g שחור עשוי לקחת 5 דקות (רק חומר אריזה), בעוד מ-50g שחור ל-100g לבן ייקח 30 דקות ניקוי + 5 דקות טעינה. אם הניקוי והטעינה במקביל, ה-changeover 30 דקות; אם ברצף, 35 דקות. שילובים אלו מתוחזקים ב-matrix.
לטיפול במעברים פשוטים ומורכבים, שתי אפשרויות setup matrix:
• Conventional setup matrix (static setup groups)
• Generated setup matrix (dynamic setup groups)

sections.title: Static Setup Matrix
sections.en: 2.8.1 Static Setup Matrix In the static setup matrix, the setup groups are the conditions for the changeovers. For example, all black paint products are in setup group Black, and all white paint products are in setup group White. These groups are assigned in the corresponding operation within the routing. If there are some exceptions within the group, for example, if the packet size needs to be transitioned from 50 g to 500 g, which takes an additional 15 min of changeover time, setup keys with the setup groups can help with that. The setup groups and setup keys are created in the SAP S/4HANA system and assigned to the routing operations. The setup groups and setup keys need to be transferred to the embedded PP/DS system via an integration model. Then, the transfer of routing from SAP S/4HANA to the embedded PP/DS PDS will assign the corresponding setup groups to the PDS operations and activities. To create the setup groups and keys in the SAP S/4HANA system, follow the IMG menu path, SPRO  Production  Capacity Requirements  Planning  Master Data  Routing Data  Define Setup Parameters. Within this Customizing node, click on the Setup group cate- gory option. Click on the New Entries button. As shown in Figure 2.52 ,enter the setup group names, and press (Enter). Select the setup group name, and double-click on the Setup group key. Click on the New Entries button, and enter the setup key values. Similarly, enter the setup group and keys for all required transition scenarios. Figure 2.52 Configuration of Setup Groups and Keys in SAP S/4HANA 2 Master Data 98 Create an integration model for the setup groups via Transaction CFM1, and activate the integration model via Transaction CFM2. This will make the setup group and keys available in PP/DS. Warning The setup keys should have different names from the setup groups, and the same setup key name can’t be used across multiple setup groups. Violating this will cause core interface queue failures during the integration model activation. Assign the setup groups and keys in the routing operation, as shown in Figure 2.53. Double-click on the operation 1, and scroll down to find the setup group and setup key fields 2. the transfer of the corresponding production version to embedded PP/DS will also transfer the setup group and key information to the PDS. When a setup key is also assigned to the routing operation 3 along with the setup group, the setup key is shown in the PDS 4. When only the setup group is assigned to the routing operation 5, the setup group is displayed in the PDS 6. Figure 2.53 Assignment and Transfer of Operations with Setup Groups Now the setup group and keys are available in embedded PP/DS, and the PDS are assigned with the setup groups and keys. The next step is to create the setup matrix in embedded PP/DS, where we’ll define the actual changeover durations between these setup groups and keys. To create the setup matrix, execute Transaction /SAPAPO/ CDPSC7 or use the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Maintain Setup Matrix. © 99 2.8 Setup Matrix As shown in the selection screen in Figure 2.54, enter the location in which you want to create the setup matrix and execute the transaction. In the next screen, you’ll see a list of existing setup matrices in the location. Here, click on the New Entries button and enter the Location, the name of the setup matrix (Setup Mtrx), and a description for the setup matrix (Descriptn). Save the transaction, and click on the back button ((F3)). Now you’ll see the newly created setup matrix in the list. Figure 2.54 Creation of a Setup Matrix in Embedded PP/DS Double-click on the setup matrix, and you’ll see the next screen as shown in Figure 2.55 where you can maintain the actual changeover duration. Click on the New Entries but- ton. In the table, the S. (setup transition type) column shows the three possible transi- tion type examples and their three possible values, as shown in Figure 2.55 and listed here:  Blank: Standard setup transition When the transition is between setup groups, this option needs to be selected. For example, if changing over from the BLACK to WHITE setup group takes 30 mins, it can be maintained here 1. The setup keys aren’t relevant in this transition type.  E: Exception setup transition From the standard transition, if an exception needs to be made based on the setup key, it can be maintained here. For example, if BLACK to WHITE takes 30 mins, but BLACK 100 g product to WHITE 50 g product takes 45 mins, it can be maintained with this transition type using the setup key assigned 2.  I: Setup transition without changing setup key If a group of products (routing operations) are assigned with the BLACK setup group 2 Master Data 100 and changing over between any BLACK product takes 5 min of transition, you’ll maintain a standard setup transition of 5 min from setup group BLACK to setup group BLACK with 5 min setup time 3. Within the same BLACK group of products, from black product 1 to black product 2 requires 10 min of changeover. In this case, you’ll maintain an exception setup transition using the setup keys assigned to prod- uct 1 and product 2 with a setup time of 10 min 4. When these is no changeover time required when an order for black product 1 is followed by an order for the same black product 1, and any other products with the group with no changing setup keys are scheduled one after another, you can use the setup transition without changing the setup key option with 0 setup time 5. Figure 2.55 Maintenance of the Setup Matrix in PP/DS
sections.he:
ב-static setup matrix, ה-setup groups הם התנאים ל-changeovers. למשל, כל ה-black paint ב-setup group Black, וכל ה-white ב-setup group White, מוקצים בפעולה המתאימה ב-routing. אם יש חריגים בקבוצה (מעבר מ-50g ל-500g שלוקח 15 דקות נוספות), ‏setup keys עם ה-setup groups מסייעים.
ה-setup groups וה-setup keys נוצרים ב-S/4HANA ומוקצים לפעולות ה-routing, ומועברים ל-embedded PP/DS דרך integration model. אז העברת ה-routing ל-PDS תקצה את ה-setup groups לפעולות וה-activities.
ליצירה ב-S/4HANA: ‏SPRO • Production • Capacity Requirements • Planning • Master Data • Routing Data • Define Setup Parameters. בצומת זה, לחצו על Setup group category. לחצו New Entries (Figure 2.52), הזינו שמות setup group, ולחצו Enter. בחרו את השם, ולחצו כפולה על Setup group key. לחצו New Entries והזינו ערכי setup key. בדומה לכל תרחישי המעבר.
צרו integration model ל-setup groups ב-Transaction CFM1, והפעילו ב-CFM2 — זה הופך את ה-setup groups וה-keys זמינים ב-PP/DS.
**אזהרה:** ה-setup keys צריכים שמות שונים מה-setup groups, ואותו שם setup key לא יכול לשמש ב-setup groups מרובים. הפרה תגרום לכשלי core interface queue בהפעלה.
הקצו את ה-setup groups וה-keys בפעולת ה-routing (Figure 2.53). לחיצה כפולה על הפעולה, וגללו ל-setup group ו-setup key. ההעברה תעביר גם את מידע ה-setup group וה-key ל-PDS. כש-setup key מוקצה גם לפעולה יחד עם ה-group, ה-key מוצג ב-PDS. כשרק ה-group מוקצה, ה-group מוצג.
כעת ה-setup group וה-keys זמינים, וה-PDS מוקצים. הצעד הבא — יצירת ה-setup matrix ב-embedded PP/DS להגדרת המשכים בפועל. הריצו Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPSC7 או menu path: ‏Logistics • Advanced Planning • Master Data • Setup Group/Setup Matrix • Maintain Setup Matrix.
כפי שב-Figure 2.54, הזינו את ה-location והריצו. תראו רשימת ה-setup matrices הקיימים. לחצו New Entries והזינו Location, שם (Setup Mtrx), ותיאור (Descriptn). שמרו ולחצו back (F3). תראו את ה-matrix החדש.
לחיצה כפולה על ה-matrix (Figure 2.55) לתחזוקת המשכים. לחצו New Entries. בטבלה, עמודת ה-S. (setup transition type) מציגה שלושה ערכים:
• **ריק: Standard setup transition** — למעבר בין setup groups. למשל, ‏BLACK ל-WHITE = 30 דקות. ה-setup keys אינם רלוונטיים.
• **E: Exception setup transition** — חריג מהסטנדרט לפי setup key. למשל, ‏BLACK ל-WHITE = 30 דקות, אך BLACK 100g ל-WHITE 50g = 45 דקות.
• **I: Setup transition without changing setup key** — אם קבוצת מוצרים מוקצית ל-BLACK ומעבר בין כל BLACK לוקח 5 דקות, תתחזקו standard setup transition של 5 דקות מ-BLACK ל-BLACK. בתוך ה-BLACK, מ-black product 1 ל-black product 2 דורש 10 דקות — תתחזקו exception setup transition עם ה-setup keys. כשאין צורך ב-changeover (אותו מוצר ברצף), השתמשו ב-setup transition without changing setup key עם 0.

sections.title: Generated Setup Matrix
sections.en: 2.8.2 Generated Setup Matrix When a complex changeover is needed due to the combination of characteristics of the products being manufactured on the same production lines, generating setup groups and setup keys for all the possible transition combinations would be a tedious task. For example, in the food industry, the characteristics of a product include kosher versus nonkosher products, products containing allergens versus nonallergen-containing products, different flavors of the food being produced, or different packaging sizes. Cre- ating setup groups and keys for the preceding mentioned possible combinations (e.g., changeover from kosher-allergen-savory 10 oz pack to kosher-nonallergen-savory 10 oz pack takes 30 min of changeover time) and assigning them in the master recipe phases would be almost an impossible task. © 101 2.8 Setup Matrix To handle such requirements in embedded PP/DS, you can use the generated setup matrix. The generated setup matrix works based on the classification of the product itself, and the system generates the combinations for the changeovers. There is no need to assign the setup groups to the routings or master recipe operations, as the sys- tem reads the classification data of the material to determine the setup group dynami- cally and derives the changeover (setup) times from the setup matrix. We’ll consider an example of products requiring setup time determination based on two characteristics: color and pack size. COLOR has the characteristics values of BLACK, WHITE, and RED. PCKSIZE (pack size) has the values of 50, 100, and 500 g. Each of these characteristics will have 9 possible transitions, and, as shown in Figure 2.56, both char- acteristics will form a possibility of 81 combinations. Figure 2.56 Possible Setup Transitions Based on Characteristics In PP/DS, we’ll achieve the same matrix by following these steps: 1. Create the classification and integrate to PP/DS Create characteristics/class of type material class (001), assign them to the material master in SAP S/4HANA, and integrate the class and characteristics to embedded PP/DS via the integration model. In this example, we’ve created class S4PPDSCOLORPCKSIZE with two characteristics (char.)—S4PPDSCOLOR and S4PPDSPCKSIZE—and assigned it to the material master. Various combinations of such characteristic values can be assigned to the material masters of products falling under the combination of differ- ent characteristic values. Figure 2.57 shows an example material called S4HANA_ PPDS_001, which is assigned the value Black for color and the value 50 Grams for packaging size. COLOR Char Matrix (3 X 3) = 9 combinations BLACK BLACK BLACK WHITE BLACK RED WHITE BLACK WHITE WHITE WHITE RED RED BLACK RED WHITE RED RED PCKSIZE Char Matrix (3 X 3) = 9 combinations 50 100 50 100 50 500 100 50 100 100 100 500 500 50 500 100 500 500 ……. ……. (9 X 9) = 81 combinations ……. BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 BLACK-100 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 WHITE-500 BLACK-500 BLACK-500 BLACK-50 RED-100 RED-100 RED-50 RED-50 RED-500 RED-500 WHITE-100 WHITE-50 WHITE-500 WHITE-100 WHITE-50 WHITE-500 COLOR-PCKSIZE Matrix 50 100 500 Characteristics 2-PCKSIZE BLACK WHITE RED Characteristics 1-COLOR ……. 2 Master Data 102 Figure 2.57 Assigning the Material Class to the SAP S/4HANA Material Master 2. Define the characteristic value matrix in PP/DS In this step, we’ll create two small characteristics value matrices for the possible combination of colors and packaging sizes. To create the characteristic value matri- ces, use Transaction /SAPAPO/CHARMAT or SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Generate Setup Matrices  Maintain Setup Matrices for Characteristic Values. In the initial screen of the transaction, click on the execute (F8) button to see the list of available characteristic value matrices in the system on the next screen. Click on the New Entry button. As shown in Figure 2.58 1, enter a name for the characteristic value matrix (Char. Value Matrix), a description (Setup Matrix Descr.), and the char- acteristics on which the matrix is being created. In our example, we’re creating the matrix for the nine possible combinations for the characteristic S4PPDSCOLOR. Save and click the back button (F3) on the screen. Here, you’ll see the newly created char- acteristic value matrix S4PPDSCOLORVALMAT. Double-click on the Char. Value Matrix name, and you’ll see the next screen. Here, click on the Generate Setup Tran- sitions button 2. This will generate all the possible combinations of the characteris- © 103 2.8 Setup Matrix tic values 3 of the characteristic S4PPDSCOLOR. Enter the changeover (setup) times here, as shown in Figure 2.58 4. Figure 2.58 Creation of Characteristics Value Matrix in PP/DS Similarly, create a characteristics value matrix for all required characteristics. In our example, we’ve created another value matrix named S4PPDSPCKSIZEVM as well. Warning In embedded PP/DS, up to six characteristics combinations are supported for the gen- erated setup matrix. The larger the number of characteristics and the values under them, the larger the possible combination. This will require more space in SAP live- Cache to store the generated setup matrix. 3. Maintain rules for generating the setup group Unlike the manual creation of setup group creation in the static setup group config- uration, in embedded PP/DS, the generated setup matrix process can generate the setup groups with the possible combinations of setup characteristics. In this step, we’ll define the characteristics what will be part of the setup group generation. To create the rules for the setup group generation, you can use Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_GRPRULE or the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced 2 Master Data 104 Planning  Master Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Generate Setup Matrices  Maintain Rules for Generating Setup Groups. In the initial screen 1 shown in Figure 2.59, enter the location in which you want to maintain the rule, and execute. In the next screen, you’ll see all the existing rules. Click on the New Entry button. In the detail screen 2, enter the Location in which you want to create the setup group rule and a name for the rule in Setup Group Gen- eration Rule. Under Settings 3, enter the Class Type (in our example, material class 001). In Generation Type, you can select Generation from Characteristics Values (in this case, the system will generate the setup groups based on the characteristics val- ues maintained in the characteristics master data) or Generation via BAdI (in this case, you can implement your own custom ABAP coding logic for the generation of setup groups). Figure 2.59 Setup Group Rule Generation in PP/DS © 105 2.8 Setup Matrix In the Prefix field, you can maintain any characters that should be prefixed to the generated setup groups (e.g., CP – color pack size, will generate the setup group names starting with the characters “CP”). In the Separator field, you can maintain a character to serve as the separator (e.g., -); in this case, the setup group will be created as characteristic value X “-” characteristic value Y (BLACK-500). You also can maintain the characteristics 4 on which you want the setup groups to be generated. In our example, we’ll assign two characteristics: S4PPDSCOLOR and S4PPDSPCKSIZE 5. You can assign up to six characteristics for the setup group gen- eration. 4. Maintain rules for generating setup matrices Now that we’ve created the characteristics value matrix and the rule for generating the setup groups, we’ll define the rules for generation of the setup matrix. To create the setup group generation rules, you can use Transaction /SAPAPO/MATRULE or the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Generate Setup Matrices  Maintain Rules for Generating Setup Matrices. In the initial screen of the transaction, enter the location in which you want to gen- erate the rule for the generation of the setup matrix (rule). In the next screen, you’ll see the list of existing rules; to create a new rule, click on the New Entry button. As shown in Figure 2.60 , enter the Location in which the rule is generated, enter a name in the Setup Matrix field for the setup matrix on which this rule will be applied (here, S4PPDSCOLOR_PCK). Under Settings 1, enter the setup group rule (SetupGrp Rule), which we’ve created in the preceding step (S4PPDSGENRULE1). The Type of For- mula field determines how the setup times are determined: the Determine Cost and Duration Using Formula value derives the setup duration from the characteristics value matrix, where we’ve defined the changeover (setup) duration; the Determine Duration and Costs Using BAdI allows you to define your custom ABAP-based logic by implementing the logic in the BAdI (/SAPAPO/CDPS_MATGEN) enhancement. The Formula: Durat. (formula for duration calculation) field has two values: The Total value will add up all the times for the individual characteristics value transi- tion (e.g., if black to white transition is 60 mins, and transition from 100 g to 50 g is 10 mins, then the setup time between Black 100 g to White 50 g will be calculated as 70 mins). The Maximum value considers the maximum among the setup times between the possible changeover times and then sets the maximum of that as the setup time for the transition of the combination (e.g., if black to white transition is 60 mins, and transition from 100 g to 50 g is 10 mins, then the setup time between Black 100 g to White 50 g will be calculated as 60 mins, which is the maximum com- paring 60 mins and 10 mins). Under the Characteristics Value Matrices 2 section, enter the characteristics value matrices that must be part of the generated setup matrix. 2 Master Data 106 Figure 2.60 Maintenance of Setup Matrix Generation Rule 5. Generate and display the setup matrix The next step is the generation of the setup matrix for all the possible characteristics value combinations based on the rule for the setup groups generation and the rule for the setup matrix generation. To generate the setup matrix, use Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_MATGEN or the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Generate Setup Matrices  Gen- erate Setup Matrices. In this transaction, as shown in Figure 2.61 1, you can enter the Location and the Setup Matrix name (in our example, PPS2 and S4PPDSCOLOR_PCK, respectively, which we maintained in the preceding step). The Flagged Setup Matrices checkbox will generate (for a new matrix) or regenerate (for an existing setup matrix) if there are any changes made to the characteristic value matrix or in the generation rules. Clicking on the execute button will generate the setup matrix. If the generation is successful, you’ll see a success message 2. The generated setup matrix can be displayed from Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_ SETUP or under the SAP Easy Access menu path, Logistics  Advanced Planning  Mas- ter Data  Setup Group/Setup Matrix  Display Setup Matrix. In the initial screen of this transaction 3, enter the Location and the Setup Matrix name, and execute the transaction. The generated setup matrix based on the characteristics value matrix and the rules is displayed in the next screen 4. © 107 2.8 Setup Matrix Figure 2.61 Generation of Setup Matrix in PP/DS 6. Assign the setup matrix to the PP/DS resource In this step, we’ll assign the setup matrix to the resource master data in PP/DS. As shown in Figure 2.62, in the resource master data Transaction /SAPAPO/RES01, nav- igate to the Time-Cont. Capacity tab. In the Setup Matrix field, enter the setup matrix, which is applicable for the changeover duration calculation for the orders/ operations executed on the resource. Figure 2.62 Assignment of Setup Matrix to the Resource Master Data 2 Master Data 108 With SAP S/4HANA routings, when there is a setup time maintained in the routing operation (see Figure 2.63 1), and a corresponding setup formula is maintained in the work center master data 2, the generated PDS in PP/DS will have a setup activity. The setup activity in the PDS is identified with the activity type (Act. Type) 3. If the resource corresponding to the SAP S/4HANA work center is assigned with the generated setup matrix, in the PDS, the setup activity and all the other activities belonging to the same operation will have the indicator Setup group from the characteristics value assign- ment (Setup Grp) 4 set with value X. Figure 2.63 Setup Activity with Generated Setup Matrix and SAP S/4HANA Routings When master recipes are used in the SAP S/4HANA system, as shown in Figure 2.64, there should be a dedicated setup phase 1 created under the operation 2. In addition, when a setup activity is present in the PDS, it must be followed by a produce activity in the PDS. This produce activity is represented by another phase 3 in the master recipe operation. The setup phase and the produce phase should have a relationship 4 defined in the master recipe. In this example, the 0020-setup phase and the 0030-produce phase are related with a FS (finish start relationship) 5. When the resource in PP/DS is assigned with a setup matrix and in the recipe under the operation using the same resource, the first phase will be transferred to the PP/DS PDS as a setup activity, as shown in Figure 2.64. The setup activity in the PDS is identified with the activity type (Act. Type) 6. If the resource corresponding to the SAP S/4HANA work center is assigned with the generated setup matrix, in the PDS, the setup activity and all the other activities belonging to the same operation will have the Setup Grp 7 indicator set from the characteristics value assignment (with value X, as shown in Figure 2.64). © 109
sections.he:
כשנדרש changeover מורכב בשל שילוב ה-characteristics של המוצרים על אותם קווים, יצירת setup groups ו-keys לכל השילובים תהיה מטלה מייגעת. למשל, בתעשיית המזון: ‏kosher מול nonkosher, ‏allergen מול nonallergen, טעמים שונים, או גדלי אריזה. יצירת setup groups ו-keys לשילובים (changeover מ-kosher-allergen-savory 10oz ל-kosher-nonallergen-savory 10oz = 30 דקות) והקצאתם ב-master recipe phases כמעט בלתי-אפשרית.
לטיפול בכך, ניתן להשתמש ב-generated setup matrix. הוא עובד לפי ה-classification של המוצר עצמו, והמערכת מייצרת את השילובים. אין צורך להקצות setup groups ל-routings/master recipes, כי המערכת קוראת את נתוני ה-classification לקביעת ה-setup group דינמית וגזירת ה-setup times מה-matrix.
דוגמה: מוצרים הדורשים setup time לפי שני characteristics — color ו-pack size. ל-COLOR ערכי BLACK, ‏WHITE, ו-RED. ל-PCKSIZE ערכי 50, 100, ו-500 גרם. לכל characteristic 9 transitions, ושני ה-characteristics יוצרים 81 שילובים (Figure 2.56).
ב-PP/DS נשיג את אותו matrix בצעדים:
1. **יצירת ה-classification ושילוב ל-PP/DS** — צרו characteristics/class מסוג material class (001), הקצו ל-material master, ושלבו דרך integration model. בדוגמה נוצר class S4PPDSCOLORPCKSIZE עם שני characteristics — S4PPDSCOLOR ו-S4PPDSPCKSIZE. ‏Figure 2.57 מציג חומר S4HANA_PPDS_001 בערך Black ו-50 Grams.
2. **הגדרת characteristic value matrix ב-PP/DS** — צרו שני characteristics value matrices קטנים לשילובי הצבעים והגדלים. השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CHARMAT או menu path: ‏Logistics • Advanced Planning • Master Data • Setup Group/Setup Matrix • Generate Setup Matrices • Maintain Setup Matrices for Characteristic Values. במסך הראשוני, לחצו execute (F8). לחצו New Entry. הזינו שם (Char. Value Matrix), תיאור (Setup Matrix Descr.), וה-characteristics (Figure 2.58). בדוגמה — 9 שילובים ל-S4PPDSCOLOR. שמרו, back (F3), לחיצה כפולה על השם, ולחצו Generate Setup Transitions. זה מייצר את כל השילובים. הזינו את זמני ה-changeover. בדומה ל-S4PPDSPCKSIZEVM.
**אזהרה:** ב-embedded PP/DS, עד שישה שילובי characteristics נתמכים ל-generated setup matrix. ככל שיותר characteristics וערכים, יותר שילובים — דורש יותר מקום ב-SAP liveCache.
3. **תחזוקת rules ליצירת ה-setup group** — בשונה מהיצירה הידנית ב-static, ה-generated process יכול לייצר את ה-setup groups עם השילובים. השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_GRPRULE או menu path: ‏... • Generate Setup Matrices • Maintain Rules for Generating Setup Groups. במסך הראשוני (Figure 2.59), הזינו location והריצו. לחצו New Entry. הזינו Location ושם ב-Setup Group Generation Rule. תחת Settings, הזינו Class Type (material class 001). ב-Generation Type, בחרו Generation from Characteristics Values (המערכת מייצרת לפי ערכי ה-characteristics) או Generation via BAdI (לוגיקת ABAP מותאמת). בשדה Prefix, תווים לקידום השמות (CP – color pack size). בשדה Separator, תו מפריד (-). הקצו את ה-characteristics (S4PPDSCOLOR ו-S4PPDSPCKSIZE). עד שישה characteristics.
4. **תחזוקת rules ליצירת setup matrices** — השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/MATRULE או menu path: ‏... • Maintain Rules for Generating Setup Matrices. במסך הראשוני, הזינו location. לחצו New Entry (Figure 2.60). הזינו Location ושם ב-Setup Matrix (S4PPDSCOLOR_PCK). תחת Settings, הזינו את ה-setup group rule (SetupGrp Rule, ‏S4PPDSGENRULE1). שדה Type of Formula קובע כיצד נקבעים זמני ה-setup: ‏Determine Cost and Duration Using Formula גוזר מה-characteristics value matrix; ‏Determine Duration and Costs Using BAdI מאפשר לוגיקת ABAP מותאמת (BAdI /SAPAPO/CDPS_MATGEN). שדה Formula: Durat. בעל שני ערכים: ‏Total יוסיף את כל הזמנים (black-white 60 דקות + 100g-50g 10 דקות = 70 דקות); ‏Maximum לוקח את המקסימום (= 60 דקות). תחת Characteristics Value Matrices, הזינו את ה-matrices.
5. **יצירה והצגת ה-setup matrix** — השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_MATGEN או menu path: ‏... • Generate Setup Matrices. הזינו Location ו-Setup Matrix (PPS2, ‏S4PPDSCOLOR_PCK) (Figure 2.61). ה-Flagged Setup Matrices checkbox מייצר/מחדש אם יש שינויים. לחצו execute. בהצלחה, תופיע הודעת success. ה-matrix ניתן להצגה מ-Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS_SETUP או menu path: ‏... • Display Setup Matrix. הזינו Location ו-Setup Matrix, והריצו.
