ה-global parameters וה-default values הם הפרמטרים בהם PP/DS משתמש כשאין הגדרה דורסת ב-master data או בכלי התכנון/תזמון. מסופקים כברירת-מחדל וניתנים לשינוי.
לפני הגדרתם, יש ליצור number range ל-PP/DS orders. בתכנון, ה-procurement elements (planned orders, ‏purchase requisitions) ישתמשו בו. בהעברה ל-S/4HANA, המספר מוקצה לפי ה-number range בצד S/4HANA ומועבר חזרה כחלק מה-key completion.
ליצירת ה-number range, השתמשו ב-menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Global Settings • Maintain Number Ranges for Orders. לחצו change Intervals (Figure 3.18), ואז Insert Line; הזינו Number Range No., ‏From No., ו-To Number; ושמרו.
הריצו Transaction /SAPAPO/RRPCUST1 או menu path: ‏... • Maintain Global Parameters and Defaults להצגה ושינוי (Figure 3.19).
‏Logging קובע את רמת המידע מכלי התכנון/תזמון:
• No Logging
• Only Errors Terminations and Warnings
• All Messages
ה-Only Errors Terminations and Warnings מומלץ למניעת מילוי מהיר של טבלאות ה-log.
ה-Use Number Range checkbox גורם ל-PP/DS להשתמש ב-number range ל-orders שטרם סונכרנו. אם לא נבחר, ה-receipt elements ייווצרו ללא מספר חיצוני.
ב-embedded PP/DS, רק ה-PDS זמין כ-source ל-in-house, לכן Production Data Structure Generated from R/3 נקבע כברירת-מחדל ל-Plan Explosion.
ה-Transfer to R/3 In-House Production ו-Transfer to R/3 Ext. Procurement קובעים את עיתוי ההעברה:
• **Don't Create Transfer Events** — ה-orders אינם מועברים. ל-in-house, אם אינם זמינים ב-S/4HANA, אין תכנון נוסף של רכיבים תלויים שאינם advanced planning.
• **Create Transfer Events from Conversion Indicator** — מועברים רק כשה-conversion indicator מוגדר (planned order→production order; ‏purchase requisitions→purchase orders).
• **Always Create Transfer Events (Default)** — נפוץ. תמיד מעביר ל-S/4HANA ביצירה או שינוי.
‏embedded PP/DS תומך ב-dynamic וב-fixed pegging. ‏pegging הוא הקשר בין receipt element (stocks, ‏planned/production orders, ‏purchase requisitions) לבין requirement element (sales orders, ‏PIRs). המערכת תמיד יוצרת dynamic pegging. עם dynamic pegging, כשהמצב משתנה, ה-requirement יכול להיות pegged ל-receipt חדש. ניתן לשנות ל-fixed pegging — אז ה-pegging המקורי נשמר כל עוד ה-supply element לא נמחק. כשה-supply elements fixed pegged וה-order מומר, ה-fixed pegging אובד. לשמירתו לאחר ההמרה, קבעו Activate Fixed Pegging (Retain Fixed Pegging for Product on Document Change). ניתן לדרוס ב-material master (Transaction MM02, לשונית Advanced Planning, Figure 3.20).
‏strategy profile הוא אוסף הגדרות לאופן תזמון order. לכלים בודדים יכולים strategy profiles משלהם, אך ב-global parameters תחת Schedule Orders: Strategy Profiles (Figure 3.19), מתוחזקים ברירות-מחדל. גם תהליכי background (העברת order מ-S/4HANA) משתמשים בהם.
בלשונית ATP Categories (Figure 3.21), ההגדרות ממפות אלמנטי ATP ספציפיים-S/4HANA (receipt ו-requirement) לאלמנטים ספציפיים-PP/DS. למשל, ‏planned order = category "PA" ב-S/4HANA. לחלק (planned orders, ‏purchase requisitions) המיפוי אינו ניתן לשינוי; לחלק ניתן למפות category שונה. ברוב המקרים המיפוי התקני מספיק.
**טיפ:** המיפוי המפורט ניתן להצגה מ-view /SAPAPO/V_ATP03 דרך Transaction SM30.

sections.title: Master Data Settings
sections.en: 3.2.6 Master Data Settings In embedded PP/DS, for master data specific to PP/DS, it’s possible to maintain the con- figuration settings that can be used by the integrated master data objects. However, because embedded PP/DS is an integrated system, most of the values for the master data fields are read or transferred from SAP S/4HANA to embedded PP/DS, and the set- tings available within embedded PP/DS are very limited. Most of the field values maintained in the PP/DS-relevant master data objects, such as material master, resources, and source of supplies, are defined in the SAP S/4HANA sys- tem and transferred to PP/DS. Material master and source of supplies (PDSs) are avail- able in PP/DS in display-only mode. So, all the master data settings are maintained in the SAP S/4HANA system. In this section, we’ll cover PP/DS-specific master data set- tings that can be assigned in the advanced planning view of the SAP S/4HANA material master or local maintenance of PP/DS data such as transportation lanes. Activate for Change Documents Master data objects such as locations, transportation lanes, and quota arrangements, which also can be maintained in the PP/DS transactions, can be activated for change documents. The activation of the change documents for these master data objects will log every change made. To activate the change documents in embedded PP/DS for such master data objects, you can use the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Location  Activate Change Documents. You’ll arrive at the screen shown in Fig- ure 3.22, where you select the checkboxes for the elements under the location master data, such as Header Data, Mapping, Location Text, and Location Address. The change documents can be activated for other master data objects as well, such as the transpor- tation lanes and quota arrangements. Figure 3.22 Activation of Change Documents for Location Master Data in PP/DS 3 Configuration 136 Create the Planner The product master in PP/DS includes the reference to the planner who is responsible for planning a specific product location displayed in the administration view of the product location master. This planner corresponds to the material requirements plan- ning (MRP) controller in SAP S/4HANA master data. The customizing data of the MRP controllers isn’t transferred to embedded PP/DS. If you want to use the planner field in the PP/DS transactions, the value help (F4) for this field doesn’t show the list of avail- able MRP controllers. You can create the person responsible in PP/DS Customizing under the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Specify Person Respon- sible (Planner). On the screen that appears, click the New Entries button, as shown in Figure 3.23, to arrive at the screen where you can maintain entries corresponding to the MRP controllers in SAP S/4HANA. Select the Prod. Planner checkbox to denote that the entry being created is for a production planner, enter a name for the production plan- ner in the Planner Name field, and enter a description of the name or the full name of the production planner in the Full name field. Figure 3.23 Maintaining the Person Responsible for a Product in PP/DS © 137 3.2 Basic Settings for Embedded PP/DS Tip Even without maintaining the PP/DS person responsible, the Planner field in the PP/DS transactions can be used, and the products associated can be found using the corre- sponding MRP Controller value defined in the material master. However, the MRP con- trollers aren’t visible in the value help (F4) for the Planner field in PP/DS transactions where this field is available as a selection option. Maintain Transportation Mode In the transportation lane master data, you can maintain the transportation mode (road, rail, or air) and also the means of transport (a specific transportation provider). The transportation mode can be maintained using the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Transportation Lane  Maintain Trans- portation Mode, and the means of transport can be maintained using the Customizing menu, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Master Data  Transportation Lane  Main- tain Means of Transport. Either way, the lead times for the transportation are main- tained in the master data of the transportation lane itself from Transaction /SAPAPO/ TL1, as described in Chapter 2, Section 2.5.2. In the Customizing shown in Figure 3.24, it’s possible to maintain additional modes and means of transport if required. Figure 3.24 Mode and Means of Transport Customizing for Transportation Lane Master Data 3 Configuration 138 Note In the means of transportation, the fields relevant to transportation scheduling aren’t used by PP/DS in the SAP S/4HANA system. Category Group In SAP S/4HANA, the planning strategy is assigned to the material in the material mas- ter MRP 3 view in the Strategy Group field. The planning strategy determines how the requirement elements of a material are treated in planning and how the forecast con- sumption happens in SAP S/4HANA. For the standard delivered requirement strategies in PP/DS, the system will automatically fill the Proposed Strategy when the corre- sponding strategy group is maintained in the MRP 3 view of the material master, as shown in Figure 3.25. SAP delivers standard requirement strategies in PP/DS such as 10 (MTS), 20 (planning with final assembly), and so on. In the SAP S/4HANA side, SAP also delivers standard equivalent planning strategies. Figure 3.25 Automatic Mapping of Proposed Strategy for PP/DS Customer-specific requirement strategies can be also created in PP/DS. It’s highly rec- ommended to copy an existing standard requirement strategy and only modify the category group to include additional requirement elements which should consume the forecast. For example, if you’re using the planning strategy 40 (planning with final assembly), in PP/DS, the corresponding requirement strategy is 20. This requirement strategy is © 139 3.2 Basic Settings for Embedded PP/DS assigned with the category group of K01, which consists of only the sales order demands. But if you want the forecast to be consumed by stock transfer requirements and sales orders, you’ll create a custom category group to include the stock transfer demand and create a custom strategy to include this new custom category group. To create a custom category group, follow the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Maintain Category Groups. In the initial screen, you’ll see all the category groups available in the system. Select a category group (in our example, we’re copying K01), and click on the Copy button. In the next screen, enter a name for the cat- egory group (CatGrp) and press (Enter). If prompted by the system, select the Copy All Entries option to copy the whole category group. As shown in Figure 3.26, select the newly created category group 1, and navigate to the Categories 2 folder. Here, click on the New Entries button, and enter the category group 3 and the new demand category you want to include in the category group 4. In this example, the category BH is added as the category representing stock transfer requirements. Figure 3.26 Creating a Custom Category Group in Embedded PP/DS Requirement Strategy After creating the category group, to create a requirement strategy, follow the Custom- izing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Specify Requirements Strate- gies. In the initial screen, you’ll see the requirement strategies available in the system. To create a new custom strategy, copy an existing strategy, enter a name for the requirement strategy (Requirement Str.), and assign the newly created category group (CatGrp) to the strategy, and save, as shown in Figure 3.27. 3 Configuration 140 Figure 3.27 Creating a Custom Requirements Strategy in Embedded PP/DS Check Mode The check mode is another configuration step that determines the assignment mode for the forecast consumption. The check mode can be accessed through the SAP Customiz- ing menu path SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Maintain Check Mode. In embed- ded PP/DS, the check mode can’t be maintained in the material master. The check mode in PP/DS corresponds to the requirement class assigned to the SAP S/4HANA planning strategy settings. For the forecast consumption to take place in PP/DS, the allocation indicator in the SAP S/4HANA requirement class, which is assigned to the planning strategy, and the assignment mode in the PP/DS check mode must match. As an example, for the SAP standard planning strategy 40 in SAP S/4HANA, as shown in Figure 3.28, the requirement class assigned for the customer requirements 1 is 50, and the corresponding allocation indicator (Allocation Indicat.) is 1 2. In PP/DS, for the Check Mode 50 3, the assignment mode is also set as 1, in the standard system. The check mode in PP/DS is saved in database table /SAPAPO/ATP06. In Figure 3.28, you can see that for check mode 50, the assignment mode (AMod) is set as 1 in the table 4. Check modes are delivered in the standard system, and if you’re introducing any custom © 141 3.2 Basic Settings for Embedded PP/DS requirement class in the SAP S/4HANA side, a new check mode with the same name as the requirement class needs to be created in PP/DS. Tip The SAP S/4HANA requirement classes can be checked using the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Cross-Application Components  Advanced Available-to-Promise (aATP)  Configuration Activities for Specific Document Types  Sales Orders and Deliv- eries  Configure Requirement Classes. The planning strategy can be accessed from SAP IMG Menu  Production  Production Planning  Demand Management  Planned Independent Requirements  Planning Strategy Define Strategy. Figure 3.28 SAP S/4HANA Requirement Class and Embedded PP/DS Check Modes Consumption Type The consumption type defines when the consumption of the PIRs are consumed by the incoming demand elements such as sales orders. To set the consumption mode, navi- gate to the SAP IMG menu, SPRO  Advanced Planning  Set Consumption Type. In this transaction, you have the following options to define the consumption type, as shown in Figure 3.29:  Online Consumption The consumption of the PIR happens immediately, along with the creation of the sales order in PP/DS.  Consumption with qRFC The consumption will be executed with a separate qRFC. When high volumes of sales orders are processed in the core interface, this consumption type helps with the per- formance of the sales order core interface queue processing because the consump- tion is decoupled from the sales order creation in PP/DS. 3 Configuration 142  Consumption in Background The PIR consumption isn’t executed automatically because a periodic background job with the ABAP program /SAPAPO/DM_ALLOCATION_BTC_RFC needs to be scheduled in the background. The execution of this job will perform the PIR con- sumption in PP/DS. Figure 3.29 Settings for the Consumption Type in PP/DS
sections.he:
ב-embedded PP/DS, ל-master data ספציפי-PP/DS, ניתן לתחזק הגדרות תצורה. אך מכיוון שזו מערכת משולבת, רוב הערכים נקראים/מועברים מ-S/4HANA, וההגדרות בתוך embedded PP/DS מוגבלות מאוד. ‏material master ו-source of supplies (PDSs) זמינים בתצוגה-בלבד. בסעיף זה — הגדרות master data ספציפיות-PP/DS הניתנות להקצאה ב-advanced planning view או בתחזוקה מקומית (transportation lanes).

**Activate for Change Documents:** אובייקטים כגון locations, ‏transportation lanes, ו-quota arrangements (הניתנים לתחזוקה גם בטרנזקציות PP/DS) ניתנים להפעלה ל-change documents — כל שינוי נרשם. השתמשו ב-menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Master Data • Location • Activate Change Documents (Figure 3.22). סמנו את האלמנטים (Header Data, ‏Mapping, ‏Location Text, ‏Location Address). ניתן גם ל-transportation lanes ו-quota arrangements.

**Create the Planner:** ה-product master כולל הפניה ל-planner האחראי על מיקום-מוצר. תואם ל-material requirements planning (MRP) controller ב-S/4HANA. נתוני ה-MRP controllers אינם מועברים. אם רוצים את שדה ה-planner, ה-value help (F4) לא יציג MRP controllers. צרו את האחראי ב-menu path: ‏... • Specify Person Responsible (Planner). לחצו New Entries (Figure 3.23), סמנו Prod. Planner, הזינו Planner Name ו-Full name.
**טיפ:** גם ללא תחזוקת האחראי, שדה ה-Planner שמיש, והמוצרים נמצאים לפי ה-MRP Controller ב-material master. אך ה-MRP controllers אינם גלויים ב-value help.

**Maintain Transportation Mode:** ב-transportation lane, ניתן לתחזק transportation mode (road, ‏rail, ‏air) וכן means of transport (ספק הובלה ספציפי). דרך menu path: ‏... • Transportation Lane • Maintain Transportation Mode, ו-Maintain Means of Transport. ה-lead times מתוחזקים ב-master data של ה-transportation lane (Transaction /SAPAPO/TL1, פרק 2, סעיף 2.5.2). ב-Customizing (Figure 3.24) ניתן לתחזק modes ו-means נוספים.
**הערה:** ב-means of transportation, השדות הרלוונטיים ל-transportation scheduling אינם משמשים את PP/DS.

**Category Group:** ב-S/4HANA, ה-planning strategy מוקצית ב-MRP 3 view בשדה Strategy Group. היא קובעת כיצד אלמנטי הדרישה מטופלים וכיצד מתבצע forecast consumption. ל-requirement strategies התקניים ב-PP/DS, המערכת תמלא אוטומטית את ה-Proposed Strategy כשה-strategy group המתאים מתוחזק (Figure 3.25). ‏SAP מספקת requirement strategies תקניים כגון 10 (MTS), ‏20 (planning with final assembly). בצד S/4HANA, ‏SAP מספקת planning strategies שווי-ערך.
ניתן ליצור requirement strategies מותאמים. מומלץ מאוד להעתיק strategy תקני קיים ולשנות רק את ה-category group לכלול אלמנטי דרישה נוספים שיצרכו את ה-forecast. למשל, ב-strategy 40, ה-requirement strategy המתאים הוא 20, המוקצה ל-category group K01 (רק sales order demands). אם רוצים שה-forecast ייצרך ע"י stock transfer requirements ו-sales orders, צרו category group מותאם. ליצירה, דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Maintain Category Groups. בחרו category group (K01), ולחצו Copy. הזינו שם (CatGrp) ולחצו Enter. בחרו Copy All Entries. בחרו את החדש (Figure 3.26), נווטו לתיקיית Categories, לחצו New Entries, והזינו את ה-category group ואת ה-demand category החדש (BH מייצג stock transfer requirements).

**Requirement Strategy:** ליצירה, דרך menu path: ‏... • Specify Requirements Strategies. העתיקו strategy קיים, הזינו שם (Requirement Str.), הקצו את ה-category group (CatGrp), ושמרו (Figure 3.27).

**Check Mode:** ה-check mode קובע את assignment mode ל-forecast consumption. דרך menu path: ‏... • Maintain Check Mode. ב-embedded PP/DS, אינו ניתן לתחזוקה ב-material master. תואם ל-requirement class המוקצה ל-planning strategy של S/4HANA. ל-forecast consumption, ה-allocation indicator ב-requirement class וה-assignment mode ב-PP/DS check mode חייבים להתאים. למשל, ל-strategy 40 (Figure 3.28), ה-requirement class ל-customer requirements הוא 50, ו-Allocation Indicat. = 1. ב-PP/DS, ל-Check Mode 50, ה-assignment mode = 1. נשמר בטבלת /SAPAPO/ATP06. ‏check modes מסופקים; אם מציגים requirement class מותאם, יש ליצור check mode חדש באותו שם.
**טיפ:** ה-requirement classes ניתנים לבדיקה דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Cross-Application Components • Advanced Available-to-Promise (aATP) • Configuration Activities for Specific Document Types • Sales Orders and Deliveries • Configure Requirement Classes. ה-planning strategy מ-Production • Production Planning • Demand Management • Planned Independent Requirements • Planning Strategy Define Strategy.

**Consumption Type:** קובע מתי ה-PIRs נצרכים ע"י אלמנטי דרישה נכנסים (sales orders). דרך menu path: ‏SPRO • Advanced Planning • Set Consumption Type (Figure 3.29):
• **Online Consumption** — מיד עם יצירת ה-sales order ב-PP/DS.
• **Consumption with qRFC** — בעזרת qRFC נפרד. בנפחים גבוהים, מסייע לביצועי עיבוד ה-queue (ה-consumption מנותק מיצירת ה-sales order).
• **Consumption in Background** — אינו אוטומטי; נדרש job תקופתי עם תוכנית ABAP‏ /SAPAPO/DM_ALLOCATION_BTC_RFC.

sections.title: Heuristics Configuration
sections.en: 3.3 Heuristics Configuration In this section, we’ll cover the details of the heuristics technical settings available in embed- ded PP/DS. Heuristics are algorithms that contain the logic for how a planning or schedul- ing problem is resolved by the system. Heuristics can’t be compared with the PP/DS optimizer because heuristics will execute the set algorithm once and produce the result, whereas the PP/DS optimizer tries to iterate the results to find the best possible result. In PP/DS, there are three types of heuristics:  Planning heuristics These heuristics are used to resolve supply and demand problems.  Scheduling heuristics These heuristics are used in resolving capacity problems and optimizing resource usage.  Service heuristics These heuristics don’t resolve any planning or scheduling problems, but they help to achieve the correct results for the planning or scheduling problems.
sections.he:
בסעיף זה נכסה את ההגדרות הטכניות של ה-heuristics ב-embedded PP/DS. ‏heuristics הם אלגוריתמים המכילים את הלוגיקה לאופן פתרון בעיית תכנון/תזמון. הם אינם ברי-השוואה ל-PP/DS optimizer — ה-heuristic מבצע אלגוריתם פעם אחת ומפיק תוצאה, בעוד ה-optimizer מנסה לאיטרציה למציאת התוצאה הטובה ביותר.
שלושה סוגי heuristics:
• **Planning heuristics** — לפתרון בעיות supply ו-demand.
• **Scheduling heuristics** — לפתרון בעיות קיבולת ומיטוב שימוש resource.
• **Service heuristics** — אינם פותרים בעיה, אך מסייעים להשגת תוצאות נכונות.

sections.title: Heuristic Settings
sections.en: 3.3.1 Heuristic Settings The planning heuristics in PP/DS are planning functions or algorithms that can be used to create receipt elements such as planned orders for in-house produced materials, purchase requisitions, and stock transfer requisitions for materials that are externally © 143 3.3 Heuristics Configuration procured. These heuristics can also be used for performing other planning tasks, for example, aligning the dates of the receipt and requirements elements to avoid delays. The scheduling heuristics operate on the resources, the orders, and operations objects. These heuristics can be used to schedule the operations on a specific resource by respecting the settings and constraints maintained in the heuristics and the strategy settings maintained in Customizing. The strategy settings are covered in Chapter 6. In this section, we’ll cover some of the important technical settings that are required in heuristics. The functionality and the operations of these heuristics will be covered in Chapter 5 and Chapter 6. You can use Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPSC11 or the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Heuristics  Maintain Heuristics, to access the Customizing settings for the PP/DS heuristics. As shown in Figure 3.30, the heuristics delivered by SAP are available in this Customiz- ing transaction. If you want to alter any settings of these heuristics, you can copy and create a heuristic by clicking on the Copy As button, entering a new name in the cus- tomer name space (starting with “Z” or “Y”), and changing any specific settings to meet your planning and scheduling needs. Figure 3.30 Heuristics Maintenance in Embedded PP/DS 3 Configuration 144 When you double-click and navigate to any of these heuristics, you’ll notice that the available settings are different for each one. These heuristic settings are customizable. But the logic of the algorithm is derived from the ABAP code and structures behind the algorithm assigned to the heuristics. Note You can also create a new custom heuristic with a customized algorithm by copying the template function group /SAPAPO/RRP_HEUR_TEMPLATE in ABAP programming, copy- ing the corresponding function modules, and adapting the code according to your requirements. Detailed instructions for this process are beyond the scope of this book. As an example, the commonly used MRP heuristics can be copied to a custom heuristic in the customer name space. As shown in Figure 3.31, the SAP_MRP_001 heuristic is copied into YSAP_MRP_001, and here all the settings can be changed. If you change the algorithm assigned to this copied heuristic, the available settings will be changed accordingly. Figure 3.31 Copying and Creating a New Heuristic with the SAP Standard Algorithm © 145 3.3 Heuristics Configuration
sections.he:
ה-planning heuristics הם פונקציות/אלגוריתמי תכנון ליצירת receipt elements (planned orders לחומרי ייצור-בית, ‏purchase requisitions ו-stock transfer requisitions לחומרים חיצוניים). משמשים גם למשימות נוספות (יישור תאריכי receipt ו-requirements למניעת עיכובים).
ה-scheduling heuristics פועלים על ה-resources, ה-orders, וה-operations. משמשים לתזמון operations על resource ספציפי תוך כיבוד ההגדרות וה-constraints (אסטרטגיות בפרק 6).
השתמשו ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPSC11 או menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Heuristics • Maintain Heuristics (Figure 3.30). ה-heuristics של SAP זמינים. לשינוי הגדרות, לחצו Copy As, הזינו שם ב-customer name space (מתחיל ב-"Z" או "Y"), ושנו.
בלחיצה כפולה על heuristic, ההגדרות שונות לכל אחד. ניתנות להתאמה, אך הלוגיקה נגזרת מקוד ABAP ומבנים מאחורי האלגוריתם.
**הערה:** ניתן ליצור heuristic מותאם עם אלגוריתם מותאם ע"י העתקת ה-template function group‏ /SAPAPO/RRP_HEUR_TEMPLATE ב-ABAP, העתקת ה-function modules, והתאמת הקוד. הוראות מפורטות מעבר להיקף הספר.
כדוגמה, ה-MRP heuristics הנפוצים ניתנים להעתקה (Figure 3.31; ‏SAP_MRP_001 הועתק ל-YSAP_MRP_001). אם משנים את האלגוריתם, ההגדרות הזמינות משתנות בהתאם.

sections.title: Heuristics Profiles
sections.en: 3.3.2 Heuristics Profiles Heuristics profiles are collections of heuristics that can be used in the planning and scheduling tools within PP/DS. In the interactive PP/DS planning tools, such as the detailed scheduling planning board, order views, and production planning table (which we’ll discuss later in this chapter), it’s possible to execute the heuristics depending on which tool is being used. For example, from the order views, the planning heuristics can be executed to resolve any demand and supply problems. In the detailed schedul- ing planning board and in the production table, which are used to monitor and manage scheduling problems, the scheduling heuristics can be executed. The heuristics that can be executed from these interactive planning tools are defined via the heuristics profiles. These heuristics profiles are assigned to the tool-specific overall profile. To create a heuristics profile, you can follow the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Heuristics  Maintain Heuristic  Profiles. You’ll arrive at the screen shown in Figure 3.32. The list of profiles is displayed in this transaction, and new profiles can be created by clicking on the New Entries button. Figure 3.32 Heuristics Profiles in PP/DS The heuristics are maintained in the heuristics profile, as shown in Figure 3.33. The Cus- tomizing ID field is used to differentiate a generic planning profile from the same one customized for a specific user. For example, if the value “user1” is entered in the Cus- tomizing ID field for heuristics profile ZSAP001, when the user named user1 launches a planning tool that has profile ZSAP001 in use, the settings from profile ZSAP001 with the Customizing ID user1 are loaded. For other users, the system will load the list of heu- ristics from profile ZSAP001 without any Customizing ID assigned. 3 Configuration 146 Figure 3.33 Maintaining a List of Heuristics in a Heuristics Profile
sections.he:
‏heuristics profiles הם אוספי heuristics לשימוש בכלי התכנון/תזמון. בכלים האינטראקטיביים (detailed scheduling planning board, ‏order views, ‏production planning table), ניתן להריץ heuristics לפי הכלי. למשל, מ-order views ניתן להריץ planning heuristics; ב-detailed scheduling planning board וב-production table, ‏scheduling heuristics.
ה-heuristics הניתנים להרצה מוגדרים דרך heuristics profiles, המוקצים ל-overall profile ספציפי-כלי. ליצירה, דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Heuristics • Maintain Heuristic Profiles (Figure 3.32). ניתן ליצור profiles חדשים בלחיצת New Entries.
ה-heuristics מתוחזקים ב-profile (Figure 3.33). שדה ה-Customizing ID מבדיל profile גנרי מאחד מותאם למשתמש ספציפי. למשל, אם "user1" מוזן ל-profile ZSAP001, כשהמשתמש user1 מפעיל כלי עם ZSAP001, ההגדרות עם Customizing ID user1 נטענות. למשתמשים אחרים, נטען ZSAP001 ללא Customizing ID.

sections.title: Planning Procedures
sections.en: 3.4 Planning Procedures In PP/DS, the planning procedures determine the reaction of the system when a planning- relevant event takes place. In this section, we’ll walk through the Customizing settings for planning procedures, before seeing how to configure the execution of a production planning run.
sections.he: ב-PP/DS, ה-planning procedures קובעים את תגובת המערכת כשמתרחש אירוע רלוונטי-תכנון. בסעיף זה נעבור על הגדרות ה-Customizing ל-planning procedures, ואז על תצורת הרצת production planning.

sections.title: Planning Procedure Settings
sections.en: 3.4.1 Planning Procedure Settings The planning procedure is assigned to the material master in the Advanced Planning view. SAP delivers standard planning procedures in embedded PP/DS. The planning procedure Customizing can be accessed from the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Maintain Planning Procedures. As shown in Figure 3.34, the list of available planning procedures is given here. The planning procedure definition has a heuristic assigned to it. The Confirmed (con- firmed quantity) column defines the quantity that is relevant for pegging. For customer requirements elements such as sales orders, there are two quantity fields available. One is the desired quantity, which is the quantity entered in the sales order and requested by the customer, and the other is the confirmed quantity, which is the quantity confirmed by the ATP process after checking the availability of the quantity against the defined check rules. In the planning procedures, if Confirmed (confirmed quantity) is selected, then the ATP confirmed quantities are considered by the planning procedure for peg- ging. The Fix. Pegging in SBC column isn’t relevant for embedded PP/DS. © 147 3.4 Planning Procedures Figure 3.34 Planning Procedure Customizing in PP/DS When you navigate by selecting one of the planning procedures and then clicking the Reaction to Events folder, you’ll see a list of events and the reaction of the system and corresponding systems. As shown in Figure 3.35, every planning procedure has the Reaction to Events area that contains a list of events and the corresponding Action, Reuse Mode, and SchedSttus (scheduling status) columns. The BOP PlngFIEntry column isn’t relevant in embedded PP/DS. Figure 3.35 Planning Procedures: Reaction to Events Let’s walk through each of the columns, as follows:  Event The Event signifies any planning-relevant changes, either triggered from SAP S/4HANA or a change made in embedded PP/DS directly. These events may include master data changes, transaction data creation/change/deletion (e.g., orders), forecast elements, stocks, and so on. 3 Configuration 148  Action The system reaction to the event is defined here. The following actions are available: – Do Not Carry Any Action The system doesn’t take any action for the specific event to which this action is assigned. – Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirements Immediately with Existing Receipts When a planned order is created that will create/change dependent requirements for the components used in the production, this action will try to cover the dependent demand created with the existing receipt elements in the system, such as existing orders or stock elements. If the system isn’t able to cover the dependent demand with an existing supply element, it will stop the creation of the original order. – Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirements Immediately If Possible This action is similar to the previous action, but the system will create a new sup- ply element to cover the dependent demand even if the dependent demand can only be covered with a delay. The original order will be created irrespective of the delay in the coverage of the dependent demand. – Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirement Immediately This action is similar to the previous action, but if the dependent demands can’t be covered by the existing or new receipts on time, the original order creation will be stopped. – Create Planning File Entries This action will add a checkbox to the planning file entry table. A planning file entry is a record in the PP/DS system that stores the planning relevance of the product/location and is evaluated during a planning run. – Start Product Heuristics Immediately With this action, the heuristics assigned to the material master data are executed immediately when the assigned event occurs in the system. – For all users of component Event ‘Plan Changed’ With this action, for relevant events such as the change of dependent require- ment related fields in the material master, the system will execute the event “Change of a plan (PPM, iPPE,PDS) in APO” for all the products which has this material as part of its PDS component list.  Reuse Mode The Reuse Mode determines how an existing receipt element, such as a planned order, purchase requisition, or stock transfer requisition, is treated when the action assigned to the event is triggered. The available options are as follows: – Use Suitable Receipt Elements With this reuse mode, any of the existing receipt elements can be reused if the receipt elements are in excess of the supply. A net requirements calculation is © 149 3.4 Planning Procedures made in which the receipt quantities and requirement quantities are netted out. If there are excess receipt elements that can be used to fulfill the new demand ele- ment, they will be reused with this mode. – Delete Unfixed Receipts With this reuse mode, the receipt elements that aren’t fixed are deleted and re- created to fulfill the demand. In PP/DS, it’s possible to fix or firm the receipt ele- ments manually or by using heuristics. These fixed receipts aren’t changed by the system automatically, for example, in a planning run. – Reexplode Plan This is similar to the Use Suitable Receipt Elements reuse mode except that all the receipt elements are reexploded irrespective of whether they are fixed or not fixed. Reexplosion is the process of rereading the corresponding PDS master data and adjusting the order data to align with the latest master data. For a change event in PDS data, this reuse mode can be used to update the orders with the new changes in the PDS data. – Delete Unfixed Receipts and Explode Fixed Receipts Again This mode is a combination of the previous two reuse modes. The receipts that aren’t fixed are deleted, and the fixed receipts will be reexploded to update the order with the latest PDS data. Note When the in-house manufacturing orders have the statuses of Released, Started, Par- tially or Finally Confirmed, or Date/Input Confirmed, these orders can’t be reexploded because the reexplosion of PDSs may result in a change in input components and dates. The order statuses are set by the system according to the processing stage of the manufacturing orders.  SchedSttus This column determines how the scheduling status of the order is set in case of an action related to in-house manufacturing orders. The in-house manufacturing orders (planned orders and production orders) have the following possible schedul- ing statuses: – Scheduled The order and all the operations are assigned with a resource, and the operations are already scheduled on a resource consuming the available capacity of the resource. – Deallocated These orders are created in the PP/DS system, and the operations have a resource assigned, although they aren’t yet dispatched or scheduled on the resource. These operations don’t consume any available capacity of the resource. 3 Configuration 150 – Retain Scheduling Status The system, depending on the value set in this Customizing for the event and action, can set the scheduling status as Scheduled or Deallocated. With the Retain Scheduling Status option, the same scheduling status is retained when the corre- sponding event is executed in the system. – Not relevant For all non-scheduling relevant objects such as stocks, sales orders, etc., the option Not relevant is set in the scheduling status.
sections.he:
ה-planning procedure מוקצה ל-material master ב-Advanced Planning view. ‏SAP מספקת planning procedures תקניים. ה-Customizing דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Maintain Planning Procedures (Figure 3.34).
להגדרת ה-planning procedure מוקצה heuristic. עמודת ה-Confirmed (confirmed quantity) מגדירה את הכמות הרלוונטית ל-pegging. לאלמנטי customer requirements (sales orders), שני שדות כמות: ה-desired quantity (שהוזנה ע"י הלקוח) וה-confirmed quantity (שאושרה ע"י תהליך ה-ATP). אם Confirmed נבחר, הכמויות המאושרות נחשבות ל-pegging. עמודת Fix. Pegging in SBC אינה רלוונטית ל-embedded PP/DS.
בבחירת planning procedure ולחיצה על תיקיית Reaction to Events, תראו רשימת events ותגובת המערכת (Figure 3.35). לכל procedure אזור Reaction to Events עם עמודות Action, ‏Reuse Mode, ו-SchedSttus (scheduling status). עמודת BOP PlngFIEntry אינה רלוונטית. העמודות:
• **Event** — כל שינוי רלוונטי-תכנון, מ-S/4HANA או ב-PP/DS ישירות (master data changes, יצירה/שינוי/מחיקת transaction data, ‏forecast elements, ‏stocks וכו').
• **Action** — תגובת המערכת:
– **Do Not Carry Any Action** — אין פעולה.
– **Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirements Immediately with Existing Receipts** — כש-planned order נוצר ויוצר/משנה dependent requirements לרכיבים, פעולה זו תנסה לכסות את ה-dependent demand עם receipts קיימים. אם לא ניתן, עוצרת את יצירת ה-order המקורי.
– **Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirements Immediately If Possible** — דומה, אך המערכת תיצור supply element חדש גם בעיכוב. ה-order המקורי נוצר ללא קשר.
– **Cover Dependent/Stock Transfer Requirement Immediately** — דומה, אך אם לא ניתן לכסות בזמן, יצירת ה-order המקורי נעצרת.
– **Create Planning File Entries** — מוסיף checkbox ל-planning file entry table. ‏planning file entry הוא רשומה השומרת את רלוונטיות התכנון של ה-product/location ומוערכת בריצת תכנון.
– **Start Product Heuristics Immediately** — ה-heuristics המוקצה ל-material מבוצע מיד באירוע.
– **For all users of component Event 'Plan Changed'** — לאירועים כגון שינוי שדות dependent requirement ב-material master, המערכת מבצעת "Change of a plan (PPM, iPPE, PDS) in APO" לכל המוצרים שלהם חומר זה כ-PDS component.
• **Reuse Mode** — כיצד receipt element קיים מטופל כשה-action מופעל:
– **Use Suitable Receipt Elements** — receipts קיימים ניתנים לשימוש-חוזר אם בעודף. חישוב net requirements.
– **Delete Unfixed Receipts** — ה-receipts שאינם fixed נמחקים ונוצרים-מחדש. ב-PP/DS ניתן fix/firm ידנית או ב-heuristics.
– **Reexplode Plan** — דומה ל-Use Suitable Receipt Elements אך כל ה-receipts מ-reexploded ללא קשר ל-fixed. ‏reexplosion = קריאה-מחדש של ה-PDS master data והתאמת ה-order. לאירוע שינוי ב-PDS, מעדכן את ה-orders.
– **Delete Unfixed Receipts and Explode Fixed Receipts Again** — שילוב. ה-unfixed נמחקים, וה-fixed מ-reexploded.
**הערה:** כשל-in-house manufacturing orders סטטוסי Released, ‏Started, ‏Partially/Finally Confirmed, או Date/Input Confirmed, לא ניתן ל-reexplode (עלול לשנות רכיבים ותאריכים).
• **SchedSttus** — כיצד נקבע scheduling status של ה-order. הסטטוסים האפשריים ל-in-house manufacturing orders:
– **Scheduled** — ה-order וכל ה-operations מוקצים ל-resource ומתוזמנים, צורכים קיבולת.
– **Deallocated** — נוצרים ב-PP/DS, ל-operations resource מוקצה אך טרם dispatched/scheduled. אינם צורכים קיבולת.
– **Retain Scheduling Status** — אותו סטטוס נשמר באירוע.
– **Not relevant** — לאובייקטים שאינם רלוונטי-scheduling (stocks, ‏sales orders).

sections.title: Settings for Production Planning Runs in PP/DS
sections.en: 3.4.2 Settings for Production Planning Runs in PP/DS In the PP/DS system, there are several ways to execute production planning runs. One of the options is to execute the MRP heuristics in production planning runs within PP/DS. This process will execute the product heuristics or a heuristic assigned to the MRP heu- ristics in all the bill of material (BOM) levels. There are Customizing settings related to the PP/DS planning run. The important Cus- tomizing settings to support the MRP planning in PP/DS are covered in the section. Planning groups are defined to execute the planning for all the products belonging to a specific group together. Planning groups are evaluated by all the heuristics in the pro- duction planning run. If there are multiple products assigned to one planning group, when any one of these products is selected in the production planning run, the plan- ning is executed for all products in the planning group irrespective of which defined materials are selected. The planning groups can be defined in the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  MRP Planning Run  Maintain Planning Groups. Click the New Entries button, and you’ll arrive at the screen shown on the top portion of Figure 3.36. Here, provide a name and a description. The planning group is then assigned to the material master by executing Transaction MM02 and navigating to the Advanced Plan- ning tab. Under the Proc./PPDS section, enter the Planning Group value, as shown on the bottom portion of Figure 3.36. Propagation ranges are used in the planning runs to determine which material location combinations are allowed apart from those defined in the selection criteria for the planning run. If MRP heuristics are executed for one material, and there are multiple dependent materials due to the BOM component structure, all of these dependent components should be part of the propagation range for the system to plan them. To maintain propagation ranges, you can follow the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  MRP Planning Run  Maintain Propagation Ranges. For pro- duction planning runs, the standard delivered propagation range (Prop.Range) “SAPALL” can be used. The SAPALL propagation range includes all product locations and resources. By using this propagation range, the materials defined in the selection © 151 3.4 Planning Procedures criteria are planned in MRP heuristics, along with all the dependent materials and all materials included in the planning run due to the linkage of the materials via planning groups. Figure 3.36 Creating and Assigning a Planning Group to the Material Master If you want to restrict the planning run per specific set boundaries of materials, loca- tions, or other characteristics of the material, a new propagation area can be defined, which can be used during the planning run. As shown in Figure 3.37, the defined propagation ranges are listed in this Customizing transaction, and custom propagation ranges can be defined by clicking on the New Entries button. When creating a new entry, a Prop.Range name and a Short Description are entered, as shown in Figure 3.38. Click on the Product Selectn button to bring up the Select Condi- tions popup window. 3 Configuration 152 Figure 3.37 Propagation Range Maintenance All the available options are listed on the right side of this popup window. Select and move the required entries from the Queue to the Selection side by clicking the arrow buttons, and then you’ll be prompted to enter the specific selection values for the selected fields. In the example shown in Figure 3.38, the Production Planner field is selected, and the value 001 is defined as the restricting criterion. Figure 3.38 Propagation Range: Creating New Entries © 153 3.4 Planning Procedures The planning runs are resource intensive in nature, and the number of materials and locations involved can make the runtimes longer. In a PP/DS planning run for MRP, it’s possible to set up parallel processing so that the system will package a certain number of materials and trigger multiple tasks to plan the materials in parallel. This will shorten the time required for the PP/DS planning run considerably. The package size is set and the parallel processing is activated in the heuristic settings, as shown in Figure 3.39 (see Chapter 5, Section 5.3.4, for more details). The number of parallel processes the system can use and the SAP application servers or the RFC group servers in which they can request these parallel tasks are defined in the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  MRP Planning Run  Maintain Destinations for Parallel Processing. Figure 3.39 MRP Heuristic Settings for Parallel Processing As shown in Figure 3.40, in this Customizing transaction, you select an RFC group or a list of allocation servers and then enter the number of parallel processes the system can use for MRP planning in parallel in the Nu… (number) field. 3 Configuration 154 Figure 3.40 Defining Destinations for MRP Parallel Processing in PP/DS
sections.he:
ב-PP/DS, מספר דרכים לבצע production planning runs. אחת — הרצת MRP heuristics בריצות ב-PP/DS. זה מבצע את ה-product heuristics או heuristic המוקצה ל-MRP heuristics בכל רמות ה-bill of material (BOM).
‏planning groups מוגדרים לביצוע תכנון לכל המוצרים בקבוצה יחד. מוערכים ע"י כל ה-heuristics בריצה. אם מוצרים מרובים מוקצים ל-group אחד, בבחירת אחד, התכנון מבוצע לכולם. הגדירו דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • MRP Planning Run • Maintain Planning Groups (Figure 3.36, חלק עליון). הזינו שם ותיאור. ה-group מוקצה ל-material master ב-Transaction MM02, לשונית Advanced Planning, תחת Proc./PPDS בשדה Planning Group.
‏propagation ranges קובעים אילו שילובי material location מותרים מעבר לקריטריוני הבחירה. אם MRP heuristics מבוצע לחומר אחד עם רכיבים תלויים רבים, כולם צריכים להיות חלק מה-propagation range. תחזקו דרך menu path: ‏... • Maintain Propagation Ranges. לריצות, ניתן להשתמש ב-propagation range התקני "SAPALL" (כולל כל ה-product locations וה-resources).
להגבלת הריצה לגבולות ספציפיים, ניתן להגדיר propagation area חדש (Figure 3.37). ביצירה (Figure 3.38), הזינו Prop.Range ו-Short Description. לחצו Product Selectn ל-Select Conditions popup. בחרו והעבירו רשומות מ-Queue ל-Selection בחיצים, ואז הזינו ערכים. בדוגמה, ‏Production Planner נבחר עם ערך 001.
ריצות התכנון עתירות-משאבים, ומספר החומרים/locations יכול להאריך זמני ריצה. בריצת PP/DS ל-MRP, ניתן להגדיר עיבוד מקבילי — המערכת אורזת מספר חומרים ומפעילה tasks מרובים. גודל החבילה והפעלת העיבוד המקבילי בהגדרות ה-heuristic (Figure 3.39; פרק 5, סעיף 5.3.4). מספר התהליכים והשרתים מוגדרים דרך menu path: ‏... • Maintain Destinations for Parallel Processing (Figure 3.40) — בחרו RFC group או allocation servers והזינו את מספר התהליכים בשדה Nu… (number).

sections.title: Order View Settings
sections.en: 3.5 Order View Settings In embedded PP/DS, planning results can be evaluated and planning runs can be trig- gered for the selected materials and locations in order views. In this section, we’ll cover the important settings required for using these transactions. The overall profile combines the individual settings and all the individual profiles that the order views use when the user launches an order view transaction. The commonly used order views and transactions are as follows:  Product view Found in Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3, the product view is similar to the stock requirements list in SAP S/4HANA. It lists all the receipts and requirements and allows you to navigate to the product master data and pegging relationships.  Receipts view Found in Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP4, the receipts view lists all the receipt elements, such as in-house and external procurement orders, for the given selection.  Requirements view Found in Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP1, the requirement view lists all the requirement elements, such as dependent demands, PIRs/forecast elements, sales order require- ments, and stock transfer requirements. When you execute one of these transactions the first time in embedded PP/DS, the sys- tem prompts you to set a variant that refers to an overall profile. As shown in Figure 3.41, the system prompts you to select the overall profile and save it as a variant for the user by entering a user value in the Save as User Variant field and a Variant Name. © 155 3.5 Order View Settings Tip To delete the assigned profiles to the users or to copy the user settings from one user to another for the PP/DS tools, you can use ABAP program /SAPAPO/PT_USER_ PARAMS_MAIN. Figure 3.41 Setting Up a Product View Variant from the Overall Profile The overall profile for the order views can be maintained from the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Order View  Define Overall Settings. The overall profile is assigned with an application, which determines the relevance of this overall profile to specific PP/DS tools. As the Customizing settings are specific to the PP/DS tools, there are different customization transactions available for the tools/ applications. From this Customizing transaction, it’s possible to maintain the overall profiles only for application RRP_ORD, which is the order view. As shown in Figure 3.42, multiple profiles are assigned to the selected overall profile SAP001. The standard delivered profiles can be copied to new profiles by clicking on the Copy As button, entering a name for the profile, and then entering the individual pro- file names in the Master Profile section of the screen (shown on the lower portion of Figure 3.42). 3 Configuration 156 Figure 3.42 Maintenance of Overall Profile for Order Views In the order view, one of the most often customized settings is the day’s supply setting and the calculation associated with it. Day’s supply is the value calculated as the num- ber of days until the current receipt elements can cover the demand elements for the product location, for example, if there is a quantity of 100 in available stock and a sales order requirement. In the day’s supply calculation, the order categories involved in this calculation are defined. SAP standard delivers two day’s supply types:  SAP1 – Day’s Supply This day’s supply calculation includes only the stock as the receipt element, and this quantity is netted against all the requirement elements and the day on which the netted quantity falls negative. The difference from the current date and the date on which the quantity falls negative is calculated as the day’s supply. © 157 3.5 Order View Settings  SAP2 – Receipt Day’s Supply This day’s supply calculation includes the stock and all the receipt elements, and this quantity is netted against all the requirement elements and the day on which the netted quantity falls negative. The difference from the current date and the date on which the quantity falls negative is calculated as the receipt day’s supply. Table 3.1 shows the difference between the SAP1 and SAP2 day’s supply calculation logic. Using the SAP1 day’s supply calculation, only the stock element with quantity 100 is considered as the supply element. The requirement elements (sales orders and depen- dent demands) are reduced from the stock quantity. As the net calculated quantity falls below zero on June 5th, 2023, the day’s supply is calculated as the difference between the June 1st, 2023, and June 5th, 2023, which is 4 days. Using the SAP2 day’s supply calculation, the stock quantity and the receipt quantities (from the planned order and production order) are netted against the requirement ele- ments (sales orders and dependent demand). Because the net requirement is negative after June 7th, 2023, the day’s supply is calculated as the difference between the current date (June 1st, 2023) and June 7th, 2023, which is 6 days. The day’s supply can be customized to suit the requirements. For example, in planning scenarios where the certainty of the dates in the purchase requisitions aren’t trusted until the purchase orders are created and sent to the supplier, the day’s calculation can be configured not to include the purchase requisitions in the day’s supply calculation. Thus, the planner is alerted to the supply situation depending only on the purchase order receipts expected. The day’s supply calculation customization can be accessed from the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Order View  Define Days’ Supply Date Receipt/ Requirement Element Quantity Net Calculated Quantity June 1st, 2023 Stock Stock 100 100 June 3rd, 2023 Requirement Sales order –100 0 June 5th, 2023 Requirement Sales order –10 –10 June 6th, 2023 Receipt Production order 50 40 June 7th, 2023 Requirement Dependent demand –120 –80 June 9th, 2023 Receipt Planned order 20 –60 Table 3.1 Day’s Supply Calculation Logic: Example 3 Configuration 158 Types, which takes you to the screen shown in Figure 3.43. You can copy the standard delivered day’s supply types and create your own types to include or exclude specific stock, receipts, requirements, and forecast elements. Figure 3.43 Customization of Day’s Supply Types As shown in Figure 3.43, the day’s supply types are displayed in this transaction. You can copy and create a new type by using the Copy As function. In the left side of the screen, navigate to the category list folders to add or remove the categories from the calculation of the day’s supply by checking or unchecking the boxes. After the custom- ization of the day’s supply is maintained, this can be assigned to the general profile of the order view, which is assigned to the overall profile. To customize the general profile of the order view, you can use the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Order View  Set Layout. As shown in Figure 3.44, the general profiles are listed under the Maintain General Settings folder section of this Customizing transaction. You can create your own by using the Copy As function © 159 3.5 Order View Settings and assigning the day’s supply type defined in the corresponding Days’ Supply Type fields. Figure 3.44 Assignment of Days’ Supply Type to the General Profile Different units of measurement of time can be used for the day’s supply such as hours, days, weeks, and so on. As PP/DS is a detailed scheduling tool, the day’s supply is calcu- lated in two decimal points from the exact time stamp of the current time and the time stamp of the first negative quantity. Tip When there is a change in the customization of the profiles of the overall order view profile or the profiles assigned to the overall profile, the user settings need to be refreshed using ABAP program /SAPAPO/PT_USER_PARAMS_MAIN for the changes to be reflected in the PP/DS transactions for the users. Similar to the day’s supply types creation and assignment to the general profile and then to the overall profile, you can copy other settings and assign them to the corre- sponding profile and then to the overall profile. 3 Configuration 160
sections.he:
ב-embedded PP/DS, ניתן להעריך תוצאות תכנון ולהפעיל ריצות לחומרים ו-locations נבחרים ב-order views. בסעיף זה — ההגדרות החשובות.
ה-overall profile משלב את ההגדרות וכל ה-profiles הבודדים בהם ה-order views משתמשים. הנפוצים:
• **Product view** — ‏Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3, דומה ל-stock requirements list ב-S/4HANA. מציג את כל ה-receipts וה-requirements ומאפשר ניווט ל-product master ו-pegging.
• **Receipts view** — ‏Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP4, מציג את כל ה-receipt elements (in-house ו-external procurement orders).
• **Requirements view** — ‏Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP1, מציג את כל ה-requirement elements (dependent demands, ‏PIRs/forecast, ‏sales order requirements, ‏stock transfer requirements).
בהרצה ראשונה, המערכת מבקשת לקבוע variant המפנה ל-overall profile (Figure 3.41) — הזינו ערך משתמש ב-Save as User Variant ו-Variant Name.
**טיפ:** למחיקת profiles מוקצים או העתקת הגדרות בין משתמשים, השתמשו בתוכנית ABAP‏ /SAPAPO/PT_USER_PARAMS_MAIN.
ה-overall profile מתוחזק דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Order View • Define Overall Settings. מוקצה ל-application הקובע את הרלוונטיות לכלים ספציפיים. מטרנזקציה זו ניתן לתחזק רק עבור application RRP_ORD (ה-order view). כפי שב-Figure 3.42, profiles מרובים מוקצים ל-overall profile SAP001. ניתן להעתיק עם Copy As.
בעריכה נפוצה — ה-day's supply וחישובו. ‏day's supply = מספר הימים עד שה-receipts הנוכחיים יכולים לכסות את הביקושים. שני סוגים תקניים:
• **SAP1 – Day's Supply** — כולל רק stock כ-receipt; נטו מול כל ה-requirements; ההפרש מהיום הנוכחי ליום שבו הכמות שלילית.
• **SAP2 – Receipt Day's Supply** — כולל stock וכל ה-receipt elements; נטו מול ה-requirements.
‏Table 3.1 מציג את ההבדל. עם SAP1, רק ה-stock (100) נחשב; הביקושים מופחתים; הכמות שלילית ב-5 ביוני 2023 → day's supply = 4 ימים (1 ביוני עד 5 ביוני). עם SAP2, ה-stock וה-receipts (planned ו-production order) נטו מול הביקושים; שלילי לאחר 7 ביוני → 6 ימים.

**Table 3.1 — לוגיקת חישוב Day's Supply (דוגמה):**

| תאריך | Receipt/Requirement | Element | Quantity | Net Calculated Quantity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| June 1st, 2023 | Stock | Stock | 100 | 100 |
| June 3rd, 2023 | Requirement | Sales order | –100 | 0 |
| June 5th, 2023 | Requirement | Sales order | –10 | –10 |
| June 6th, 2023 | Receipt | Production order | 50 | 40 |
| June 7th, 2023 | Requirement | Dependent demand | –120 | –80 |
| June 9th, 2023 | Receipt | Planned order | 20 | –60 |

ניתן להתאים את ה-day's supply. למשל, אם תאריכי ה-purchase requisitions אינם אמינים עד יצירת ה-purchase orders, ניתן לא לכלול אותם בחישוב. ההתאמה דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Order View • Define Days' Supply Types (Figure 3.43). ניתן להעתיק את הסוגים התקניים וליצור משלכם לכלול/להחריג stock, ‏receipts, ‏requirements, ו-forecast. בצד שמאל, נווטו לתיקיות ה-category list להוספה/הסרה. לאחר ההתאמה, מקצים ל-general profile.
להתאמת ה-general profile, השתמשו ב-menu path: ‏... • Order View • Set Layout (Figure 3.44). ה-general profiles תחת Maintain General Settings. צרו עם Copy As והקצו את ה-day's supply type בשדות המתאימים.
ניתן להשתמש ביחידות מידה שונות של זמן (hours, ‏days, ‏weeks). מכיוון ש-PP/DS הוא כלי detailed scheduling, ה-day's supply מחושב בשתי ספרות עשרוניות מה-time stamp המדויק.
**טיפ:** בשינוי התאמת ה-profiles, יש לרענן את הגדרות המשתמש בעזרת תוכנית ABAP‏ /SAPAPO/PT_USER_PARAMS_MAIN.

sections.title: Detailed Scheduling Planning Board
sections.en: 3.6 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board In PP/DS, the detailed scheduling planning board is a commonly used graphical board where various charts can be loaded to represent the stock levels, capacity consumption, orders, operations, and relationships between the orders and operations. As the detailed scheduling planning board has graphical objects, you can color-code different objects. You can also customize the available action buttons on the screen of the detailed scheduling planning board so that for frequently used actions, the user can easily perform those instead of navigating to the menu paths within this transaction. We’ll cover the important profiles required for selecting the data for the detailed sched- uling planning board and also how the color-coding and the toolbar options can be cus- tomized.
sections.he:
ב-PP/DS, ה-detailed scheduling planning board הוא לוח גרפי נפוץ שבו ניתן לטעון charts שונים המייצגים רמות מלאי, צריכת קיבולת, ‏orders, ‏operations, וה-relationships ביניהם.
מכיוון של-board אובייקטים גרפיים, ניתן לקודד אותם בצבע. ניתן גם להתאים את כפתורי הפעולה במסך כדי שלפעולות נפוצות, המשתמש יבצע בקלות במקום לנווט ב-menu paths. נכסה את ה-profiles החשובים לבחירת הנתונים ל-board וכיצד ה-color-coding וה-toolbar ניתנים להתאמה.

sections.title: Overall Profile
sections.en: 3.6.1 Overall Profile The detailed scheduling planning board is launched by executing Transaction /SAPAPO/ CDPS0 in embedded PP/DS. As shown in Figure 3.45, the Overall Profile is selected and that determines the Time Profile and Work Area. In addition, by clicking on Profiles in the menu bar, you can see all other profiles assigned to the overall profile, such as the Plng Board Profile, DS Strategy Profile, Heuristic Profile, and More Profiles, which are required to use the detailed scheduling planning board. Figure 3.45 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board: Initial Screen © 161 3.6 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board The overall profile can be customized to include other profiles that are customized. You can navigate to the customization of the overall profile using the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Detailed Scheduling  Maintain Overall Pro- files. As shown in Figure 3.46, the list of overall profiles is displayed here; you can create a new profile by copying an existing profile using the Copy As button in the menu bar. All the Subprofiles assigned to the overall profiles are visible by double-clicking on the overall profile, and the entries here can be changed with the required individual pro- files. The Planning Version can be defaulted by maintaining the same in the Specific Settings section. Figure 3.46 Customization of the Detailed Scheduling Planning Board Overall Profile
sections.he:
ה-detailed scheduling planning board מופעל ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS0. כפי שב-Figure 3.45, ה-Overall Profile נבחר וקובע את ה-Time Profile וה-Work Area. בלחיצה על Profiles בתפריט, רואים את כל ה-profiles האחרים (Plng Board Profile, ‏DS Strategy Profile, ‏Heuristic Profile, ‏More Profiles).
ניתן להתאים את ה-overall profile דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Detailed Scheduling • Maintain Overall Profiles (Figure 3.46). צרו profile חדש ע"י Copy As. כל ה-Subprofiles גלויים בלחיצה כפולה, וניתן לשנותם. ה-Planning Version ניתן לברירת-מחדל ב-Specific Settings.

sections.title: Time Profile
sections.en: 3.6.2 Time Profile The Time Profile determines the duration for the selection of objects for display in the detailed scheduling planning board, and the Planning Period determines the duration within which the objects loaded on the detailed scheduling planning board can be involved in a scheduling action. The display and planning periods, as shown in Figure 3.47, are calculated as relative dates as set in Customizing. You can use the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced planning  Detailed Scheduling  Maintain Time Profiles, to maintain the time profile. You’ll arrive at the top screen shown in Figure 3.47. Double-click on the entries in the list to navigate to the bottom screen, where the period profile customization can be set as a relative period or as absolute periods. 3 Configuration 162 Figure 3.47 Configuration of the Time Profile The start and end of the duration are defined. The Segments field defines the number of individual sections the display period can be split into for performance reasons. For example, if the total Display Period is six months, three segments are defined (two months per segment), only one month is displayed at launch, and then the system will process the data only for the first segment (two months). When the user scrolls through the time bar, the data is loaded for the next segments. This is purely a performance measure.
sections.he:
ה-Time Profile קובע את משך בחירת האובייקטים להצגה ב-board, וה-Planning Period קובע את המשך שבו אובייקטים שנטענו יכולים להיות מעורבים בפעולת scheduling. תקופות התצוגה והתכנון (Figure 3.47) מחושבות כתאריכים יחסיים. השתמשו ב-menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced planning • Detailed Scheduling • Maintain Time Profiles.
לחיצה כפולה על הרשומות מנווטת למסך התחתון, שבו ניתן לקבוע relative period או absolute periods. ה-start וה-end מוגדרים. שדה ה-Segments מגדיר את מספר החלקים שאליהם ניתן לפצל את תקופת התצוגה מטעמי ביצועים. למשל, אם תקופת התצוגה שישה חודשים ושלושה segments מוגדרים (חודשיים לכל אחד), רק חודש מוצג בהפעלה, והמערכת מעבדת רק את ה-segment הראשון. בגלילה, הנתונים נטענים ל-segments הבאים.

sections.title: Work Area
sections.en: 3.6.3 Work Area The work area is the preset selection of resources, products, and orders for the selection and display of objects on the detailed scheduling planning board. It can be customized to include a set of resources and products belonging to a manufacturing unit that a scheduling user is responsible for so that the user need not set the selection conditions every time the detailed scheduling planning board is launched because the conditions are preloaded. The work area can be customized under the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Detailed Scheduling  Maintain Work Areas. As shown in Figure © 163 3.6 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board 3.48, the work area can be created from this transaction, and the resources, orders, and products selections are defined under the Dialog Structure folders. Figure 3.48 Configuration of Work Areas For setting up the work area with resource selection, select the Resource View folder under the Dialog Structure panel on the left side of the screen 1. Select the entry from the Set column 2, and click on the Set button 3 to open the All Resources popup box. Here, click on the Choose Fields button 4, select the required fields from the Queue col- umn 5, move them to the Selection column, and press (Enter). The selected fields will appear in the All Resources popup, and you can enter the values for the selected fields, such as the Location and Resource. Click on the OK (green checkmark) button and then the Save button to save the data maintained. These steps can be repeated for the Order View and Product View as well, if you want to define the work area with respect to orders and products, respectively.
sections.he:
ה-work area היא הבחירה המוגדרת-מראש של resources, מוצרים, ו-orders לבחירה והצגה ב-board. ניתנת להתאמה לכלול resources ומוצרים השייכים ליחידת ייצור שהמשתמש אחראי עליה, כך שלא יצטרך לקבוע תנאים בכל הפעלה. ההתאמה דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Detailed Scheduling • Maintain Work Areas (Figure 3.48). ה-resources, ‏orders, ומוצרים מוגדרים תחת תיקיות ה-Dialog Structure.
להקמה עם resource selection, בחרו תיקיית Resource View, בחרו את הרשומה מעמודת Set, ולחצו Set ל-All Resources popup. לחצו Choose Fields, בחרו מ-Queue, והעבירו ל-Selection. השדות יופיעו, והזינו ערכים (Location, ‏Resource). לחצו OK ו-Save. חזרו ל-Order View ו-Product View לפי הצורך.

sections.title: Planning Board Profile
sections.en: 3.6.4 Planning Board Profile The layout, color-coding of objects in the detailed scheduling planning board, and the toolbar menu option customizations are grouped under the detailed scheduling plan- ning board profile. The detailed scheduling planning board profile customization can be accessed from the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Detailed Scheduling  Settings for the Detailed Scheduling Planning Board  Maintain Planning Board Profiles. As shown in Figure 3.49, you’ll see the list of the detailed scheduling planning board profiles in the initial screen and the list of settings associated with the profile on the left side of the screen in the Dialog Structure. You can create a new profile by copying an 3 Configuration 164 existing entry using the Copy As button. Double-clicking on any profile will take you to the details of the basic color settings of the detailed scheduling planning board. The set- tings made in this screen are valid for the detailed scheduling planning board layout itself and the individual Charts that can be displayed in the detailed scheduling plan- ning board. The color-coding of the Graphical Objects and the Toolbar: Displayed Func- tions are configured by navigating to the corresponding folders in the dialog structure. Marking Color and Color of Guide are configured in the detailed scheduling planning board profile too, as shown in Figure 3.49. The marking color is the color used when an object on the detailed scheduling planning board is clicked on or selected. When drag- ging and dropping an object within the detailed scheduling planning board for resched- uling, the guidelines help the user determine the position of the timeline in the board. Figure 3.49 Customization of the Detailed Scheduling Planning Board Profile In Figure 3.50, the different elements of the detailed scheduling planning board are marked so that you’ll be able to follow the significance of the Customizing settings under the detailed scheduling planning board profile that affect its display. After the selection is entered and executed in the initial screen of the detailed scheduling plan- ning board in Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPS0, the transaction will take you to the screen shown in Figure 3.50. The details of the detailed scheduling planning board selection screen are covered in Chapter 6. The type of charts allowed, the objects displayed on the charts, and the color-coding of the individual objects and buttons displayed in the task- © 165 3.6 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board bar are driven by the Customizing of the detailed scheduling planning board profile. Note the following items in Figure 3.50: 1 Taskbar with actions 2 Guidelines 3 Selected object (in Marking Color) 4 Order objects with color-coding Figure 3.50 Objects in the Detailed Scheduling Planning Board The allowed charts and the graphical objects are customized under the detailed sched- uling planning board profile. We’ve already covered the guidelines and the marking color configuration in the profile. The order of the charts and elements operations is displayed in the chart, and the shape and color of the elements are configured in this step. To configure the decision table for the graphical objects, double-click on the Chart folder in the Dialog Structure panel on the left side of the screen. Select the Resources Chart by setting the checkbox in the Chart column, and double-click on the Decision Table for Graphical Objects folder under the Dialog Structure. This will open the screen shown in the bottom of Figure 3.51, which shows the list of decision groups. Here, you can identify the graphical object ID in the Then column. In the decision table, you can define conditions to identify an object from its properties in the If column and define the reaction for the condition in the Then column. In this example, the decision is defined as the assignment of Obj OPR_DEF_1 for the standard operation objects by default without any special conditions. 3 Configuration 166 Figure 3.51 Configuration of Detailed Scheduling Planning Board Graphical Objects Now, go to the Graphical Objects dialog structure, where the graphical object with ID OPR_DEF_1 is defined in the example shown in Figure 3.52. Figure 3.52 Configuring the Graphical Elements © 167 3.6 Detailed Scheduling Planning Board Select the graphical object by setting the selection checkbox in the Object ID column, and double-click the Graphical Elements folder. This will take you to the screen dis- played in the bottom of Figure 3.52. sections.title: Application Logs for PP/DS
sections.en: 3.7 Application Logs for PP/DS When a planning run is executed in embedded PP/DS based on a log level set in the PP/DS global settings and defaults, as covered in this chapter, application logs are generated for information, warning, error, and termination exceptions, depending on the log level, and then saved in the system. These application logs are useful to identify the rea- sons for materials not correctly planned in the planning run or discrepancies in the planning results, such as unexpected quantities or dates. In the configuration for the application logs in PP/DS, it’s possible to create exception groups so that the application log messages are grouped under the exception groups. This makes it easy to filter the application log messages in PP/DS application log mon- itoring Transaction /SAPAPO/RRPLOG1. For example, in the planning run, you may see an information message such as /SAPAPO/ RRP 013 - No transportation lane/procurement relationship for prod, or warning messages such as /SAPAPO/RRP338 Order 4060251/10/1 with source created late on 30.10.2022 20:41:30; desired date 20.06.2022 02:00:00. If you want to filter down these two mes- sages easily in the log monitoring transaction, an exception group can be created for these two messages. To create the exception groups, follow the Customizing menu path, SAP IMG Menu  Advanced Planning  Application Logs for PP/DS Maintain Exception Groups. As shown in Figure 3.54, in this transaction, click on the New Entries button, and enter a name (Excptn Grp) and a description (Short Description) for the exception group. Select the group, and double-click on the Exception Messages folder. In this screen, click on the New Entries button to add the application log message class 1 and the mes- sage number 2 to the exception group 3. The No EM column 4 denotes that if it’s checked on for any of the messages in the exception group, the specific log message won’t be generated by the system during the planning runs. Figure 3.54 Configuring Exception Groups for Application Logs in PP/DS © 169

כשריצת תכנון מבוצעת ב-embedded PP/DS לפי log level שנקבע ב-global settings, נוצרים application logs ל-information, ‏warning, ‏error, ו-termination, ונשמרים. שימושיים לזיהוי סיבות לחומרים שלא תוכננו נכון או discrepancies (כמויות/תאריכים בלתי-צפויים).
ניתן ליצור exception groups כך שהודעות ה-log מקובצות תחתם — מקל על סינון ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/RRPLOG1. למשל, ‏/SAPAPO/RRP 013 - No transportation lane/procurement relationship for prod, או /SAPAPO/RRP338 Order ... with source created late. ליצירה, דרך menu path: ‏SAP IMG Menu • Advanced Planning • Application Logs for PP/DS Maintain Exception Groups (Figure 3.54). לחצו New Entries, הזינו Excptn Grp ו-Short Description. בחרו את ה-group, ולחיצה כפולה על Exception Messages. לחצו New Entries להוספת message class ו-message number. עמודת No EM — אם מסומנת, ההודעה לא תיווצר.

sections.title: PP/DS Optimizer Settings
sections.en: 3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings This can be useful if you want to suppress specific information messages from the application log, but you want other information message logs to be generated by the system. In the ExM Prio column 5, you can set a priority for the application log mes- sage. Value 1 holds the highest priority, and value 99 holds the lowest priority. In the functionality to display the log for the last planning run, which can be accessed by using Transaction /SAPAPO/POV1 and selecting the Planning Run Info., as shown in Figure 3.55, the message with the highest priority set in the exception group will be dis- played in the Exception Message column. If the value Create a Database Alert is set in the DB Alert column (refer to Figure 3.54 6), the system will also generate an alert for the Alert Monitor and will save this alert message in database table /SAPAPO/ALERT_HP. We’ll cover the details regarding alerts in Chapter 7. Figure 3.55 Display of the Highest Priority Exception Message in the Planning Run Info Warning Don’t set the DB Alert option in the exception messages in the exception group unless you have specific requirements. This may lead to performance bottlenecks in the PP/DS planning runs. 3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings In this section, we’ll cover the technical setup of the PP/DS optimizer. The setup of opti- mizer profiles and other application settings that are used to optimize the production plan and the production schedule will be covered in Chapter 5 and Chapter 6 during our discussion of production planning topics and detailed scheduling topics, respectively. In embedded PP/DS in SAP S/4HANA 2022, there are two optimizer engines available in the standard system:  Production Planning Optimizer The Production Planning Optimizer is a functionality that was introduced in SAP S/4HANA 2020 and continues to evolve with new features and functionalities. The Production Planning Optimizer (also called the Production Planning Solver) is a cost-based optimization engine used to create an optimal production plan. The opti- mizer considers costs such as manufacturing/capacity, procurement, transporta- tion, storage costs and penalties for late fulfillments, and violations of safety stock requirements. 3 Configuration 170  Detailed Scheduling Optimizer The Detailed Scheduling Optimizer has existed from the initial release of embedded PP/DS, and it’s also available in the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization solu- tion as well. The Detailed Scheduling Optimizer is also a cost-based optimization engine, which will optimize the production schedule and optimal resource utiliza- tion of manufacturing resources. It considers various costs such as setup/change- over costs, delay costs, and mode costs (i.e., costs incurred by specific resources) to execute the production. In addition, you can combine the production planning and detailed scheduling optimi- zation in a single run to arrive at an optimal plan, which the Production Planning Opti- mizer calculates and that will be further optimized by the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer for an optimal production schedule. When an optimizer run is executed, the master data and relevant transaction data is read from the SAP S/4HANA database tables and SAP liveCache. Along with this data, the constraints defined in the optimizer profile are sent to the optimizer server. Then, the optimizer server will execute the optimization program based on the data and the parameters supplied. The output of the Production Planning Optimizer will be new procurement elements, and the output of the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer will be changed dates and times. The optimizer server will call the SAP S/4HANA system to cre- ate the procurement elements and the updates to the existing orders in SAP liveCache. This process is shown in Figure 3.56. Figure 3.56 Technical Data Flow in the Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Schedul- ing Optimizer Engines and SAP S/4HANA Embedded PP/DS Optimizer Server RFC (TCP/IP connection) RFC (TCP/IP connection) Create/change orders in PP/DS and SAP liveCache PP/DS transaction data (manufacturing orders; procurement orders, including planned orders and purchase requisitions; stocks; demand elements, such as forecasts, sales orders, deliveries; etc.) Execute Production Planning Optimizer program Execute Detailed Scheduling Optimizer program PP/DS master data (materials, resources, setup matrix, cost data from materials and resources, safety stock penalties, delay penalties, etc.) © 171 3.8 PP/DS Optimizer Settings The optimizer is an optional component of embedded PP/DS. The Production Planning Optimizer and the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer are installed on a separate server with standalone SAP Gateway installed. Another option is to install the optimizer in the same server as the SAP application server for the SAP S/4HANA system. The usual deployment method is to have a standalone server for the PP/DS optimizer that is sized according to the workload expected to be handled by the Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling Optimizers and not sharing the load with any other applications. In the PP/DS optimizer server, it’s possible to install more than one optimizer software instance because the same PP/DS optimizer server can be used by multiple systems, including the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization system. The same PP/DS opti- mizer server may contain the software executables for supply network planning, capable- to-match (CTM), and so on. The Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Schedul- ing Optimizer installed executables can be used by embedded PP/DS. After the Production Planning Optimizer and Detailed Scheduling Optimizer execut- ables and the required SAP Gateway components are installed in the standalone server, an RFC destination of type TCP/IP is created in the SAP S/4HANA system. For the Produc- tion Planning Optimizer, the path of the corresponding optimizer executable for the Pro- duction Planning Optimizer is maintained in the technical settings of the RFC destination, as shown in Figure 3.57. Embedded PP/DS technically uses the SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization supply network planning (SNP) optimizer engine. So, in the Program path, you’ll notice that program is pointing to the SNP optimizer executable in the optimizer server. Figure 3.57 RFC Destination Settings for the Production Planning Optimizer 3 Configuration 172 Similarly, for the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer, the program path should refer to the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer Program file in the optimizer server, as shown in Figure 3.58. Figure 3.58 RFC Destination Settings for the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer Note For further information, refer to the installation guide for the SAP SCM optimizer found at http://s-prs.co/v495100. To create the RFC destination, execute Transaction SM59, and click on the Create but- ton. Enter a name for the destination in the RFC Destination field, and select the Con- nection Type as T – TCP/IP Connection. Under the Technical Settings tab, select the Start on Explicit Host option under Activation Type. Enter the Target Host, which is the server in © 173

ב-embedded PP/DS ב-S/4HANA 2022, שני optimizer engines תקניים:
