sections.title: Target Stock Level and Safety Stock Methods
sections.en: 5.2.5 Target Stock Level and Safety Stock Methods In embedded PP/DS, various target stock level methods and safety stock methods are delivered in the standard solution. We’ll discuss the details of those methods in this section. Target Stock Level Target stock is the inventory level you want to achieve in a planning run. The target stock can be set as an absolute quantity on a periodic basis, or it can be maintained as the number of days in the future within which the inventory should be built ahead to cover the requirement. Next are the target stock level methods supported by embedded PP/DS. These can be maintained in the Targt Stk Lvl Method field in the Advanced Planning tab of the mate- rial master:  Blank: Target day’s supply from product master With this method for the target stock level, the target day’s supply is maintained in the Target Day’s Supply field in the material master, as shown in Figure 5.14. In this 5 Production Planning 236 example, the target day’s supply is maintained as 10 days 1, and the target stock method is maintained with a blank value 2. During the planning run with the stan- dard lots heuristics, when the first receipt element (planned order) is created (in our example, 25.12.2022), the system considers the demand elements up to the next 10 days in the future, which is 04.01.2023 3, and creates the planned order for this quantity (130 quantity). Whenever the net quantity goes negative in the future (on 10.01.2023) and the planning run is creating another planned order, it will add the demand elements for the next 10 days (till 20.01.2023) 4, and the planned order is created accordingly. Figure 5.14 Target Day’s Supply from Product Master: Example  1: Target day’s supply (time-dependent maintenance) With this target stock level method, the target day’s supply can be maintained in a time-dependent manner. For example, from the current date till the end of June 2023, the target day’s supply is 10 days, and from June 2023 till the end of the time stream (31.12.9999), the target day’s supply is 25 days. The system considers these time-dependent target stock levels during planning with standard lost heuristics and creates the receipt elements to meet the target stock levels. © 237 5.2 Basic Functions in PP/DS Planning The time-dependent master data for target stock and safety stock are maintained via Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS. In the initial screen shown in Figure 5.15, enter the prod- uct number and the location for which the data needs to be created or changed. Click on the Create button 1. In the next screen, the materials entered in the selection are listed. Here, enter the required time-dependent safety stock or target stock level val- ues. The first row will be defaulted with the current date as the start date, and the end of calendar 31.12.9999 will be defaulted as the end date, which is also defaulted in the initial screen 2. To add a new row for different date ranges in the next empty row, enter the material number and the date from which the new value is to be effective. In the example shown here, 01.06.2023 is entered, and the Target Days is entered as 3 (days). Once you press (Enter), the initial row will be set with an end date (31.05.2023) of one day before the new date entered (01.06.2023). Finally, save the transaction. Figure 5.15 Maintenance of Time-Dependent Safety Stock and Target Stock Data The Target Day’s Supply (time-dependent maintenance) target stock level method also works like the Target Day’s Supply method from the product master, but it respects the time-dependent data maintained and calculates the receipt element quantities. In this example, till 31.05.2023, the system considered 5 days 1 for calcu- lating the target stock, and after 01.02.2023, it considered 3 days 2, as shown in Fig- ure 5.16. 5 Production Planning 238 Figure 5.16 Target Stock Level Method: Target Day’s Supply (Time-Dependent Maintenance)  Target stock level (time-dependent maintenance) With this target stock level method, an absolute stock value (instead of the day’s sup- ply) is maintained in the time-dependent maintenance. Whenever the system needs to create a receipt element for any demand, it will make sure that an inventory of the quantity that is defined in the master data is achieved. In this example shown in Fig- ure 5.17, the target stock of 100 1 is maintained till 31.05.2023, and the target stock of 200 2 quantity is maintained till 31.12.9999. So, in the planning using the standard lots heuristics, the system ensures that till 31.05.2023, a target stock of 100 3 is achieved, and after that, a target stock of 200 4 is achieved. The target stock quantity is added to the first receipt element 5 created. When the target stock level changes to 200 from 01.06.2023, the system adds the delta (between 200 and 100) and adds the 100 quanti- ties to the first receipt element 6 created in the new period (after 01.06.2023). When time-dependent target stock is maintained in Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS, the same is also displayed in the product view in the TargetStk column 7. © 239 5.2 Basic Functions in PP/DS Planning Figure 5.17 Target Stock Level Method: Target Stock Level (Time-Dependent Maintenance)  7: No target stock level With the no target stock level method, irrespective of the time-dependent target stock or target day’s supply being defined, the system doesn’t consider any target stock levels during planning. Safety Stock Methods Safety stocks are additional inventory held at the plants or at the warehouses to pre- vent out-of-stock situations due to unforeseen challenges such as machine break- downs, supplier delays, and so on In embedded PP/DS, both static safety stock methods and time-dependent safety stock methods are supported. The safety stock is maintained in the material master for the static safety stock methods; the time-dependent data is maintained in Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS for the time-dependent safety stock methods. The safety stock and safety time fields maintained in the MRP 2 view of the material master are also considered by PP/DS. So, in the Advanced Planning tab, you can use the Sfty Stk Meth Determination checkbox to control whether the system should determine the safety stock method automatically from the safety stock and safety time maintained in the MRP view or 5 Production Planning 240 should respect the settings made in the Advanced Planning tab for the safety stock cal- culations. As shown in Figure 5.18, in the MRP 2 view of the material master, the safety stock of 100 quantities 1 is maintained. In the Advanced Planning tab, the Sfty Stk Meth Determina- tion checkbox 2 (safety stock method determination) is selected. Therefore, the sys- tem automatically determined the safety stock method SB (safety stock from location product master) 3. In addition, when this checkbox 2 is selected, the Safety Stock Method field 3 in the Advanced Planning tab becomes noneditable. Figure 5.18 Safety Stock Determination between MRP Views and the Advanced Planning View of the Material Master With the safety stock method determination selected in the Advanced Planning view of the material master, the system applies the following rules to automatically determine the safety stock method:  When the Safety Stock value is filled in the MRP 2 view, the safety stock method SB- Safety Stock from Location Product Master is used in PP/DS.  When the Safety Time in days is filled in the MRP 2 view, the safety stock method SZ- Safety Day’s Supply from Location Product Master is used in PP/DS. © 241 5.2 Basic Functions in PP/DS Planning  When both the Safety Stock and Safety Time in days are maintained in the MRP 2 view, the safety stock method SM - Max.of Safety Stock and Safety Day’s Sup. from Loc.Prod.Master are used in PP/DS. The following are the safety stock methods available in embedded PP/DS:  SB: Safety Stock from Location Product Master With this safety stock method 1, as shown in Figure 5.19, the safety stock value is read from the Safety Stock field 2 in the MRP 2 view of the material master. The safety stock will appear with the current date in the product view 3. For planning purposes, the safety stock is considered an additional demand element, and the sys- tem will create receipt elements 4 to cover the demand generated by the safety stock. Because the safety stock is a virtual element in PP/DS, no pegging is created 5. Figure 5.19 Safety Stock Method: SB Note In embedded PP/DS, only virtual safety stocks are supported. Virtual safety stocks aren’t saved in SAP liveCache, so they can’t participate in pegging. During planning, receipt elements are created to cover the safety stock demand. But these receipt 5 Production Planning 242 elements aren’t dynamically pegged to the safety stock demand element. So, function- alities such as optimization of delays in the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer can’t con- sider the safety stock elements because there is no pegging between the safety stock and the corresponding planned order.  SZ: Safety Day’s Supply from Location Product Master This safety stock method uses the safety day’s supply maintained in the MRP 2 view of the material master. With this safety stock method, the demand dates are brought backward virtually by the number of days maintained as the safety day’s supply during the planning run. As shown in Figure 5.20, the safety stock method is SZ 1, and the Safety Time is 5 days 2. In planning, the system created receipt elements 5 days before the demand dates. In this example, demand elements are created every day from 10.01.2023 to 13.01.2023 3. Using the standard lots heuristics, the system has created receipt elements by considering the demand days are 5 days ahead of the actual dates of those elements. So, the receipts are created every day from 05.01.2023 to 08.01.2023 4. Figure 5.20 Safety Stock Method: SZ  SM: Max. of Safety Stock and Safety Day’s Supply from Location Product Master With this safety stock method, both the SB and SZ safety stock methods are exe- cuted. In the material master, the safety stock and safety day’s supply are main- tained. During planning, the system first determines the safety stock value from the © 243 5.2 Basic Functions in PP/DS Planning material master, and then virtually brings backward the dates of the demand ele- ments by the number of days maintained in the safety day’s supply field. As shown in Figure 5.21, the Safety Stock of 50 1 is maintained and the Safety Time is maintained as 5 days 2, along with the Safety Stock Method of SM 3. During plan- ning, the system considered the safety stock and created a receipt element to cover it 4. In addition, for the other demands, it has virtually brought the dates backward by 5 days and created the receipt elements 5 days early 5. Figure 5.21 Safety Stock Method: SM  MB: Safety Stock (Time-Dependent Maintenance) With this safety stock method set in the material master Advanced Planning view, the time-dependent safety stock needs to be maintained in Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS. As shown in Figure 5.22, time-dependent safety stock is maintained 1 as 50 from 26.12.2022, 175 from 01.01.2024, and 25 from 01.06.2024. In the product view, you can see that the first safety stock element is for 50 quantities on 26.12.2022 2, and the second safety stock demand element on 01.012024 is created for 125 quantities. This is because with existing safety stock of 50 and the safety stock master data set in Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS as 175, the system offsets the existing 50 quantity with the 175 quantity and creates the safety stock demand element for the 125 quantity 3. Similarly, the safety stock is reduced to 25 from 01.06.2024, so the system offsets the 5 Production Planning 244 existing safety stocks of the 175 quantity with the 25 quantity and created a safety stock receipt element (positive quantity) for the 150 quantity 4. When time- dependent safety stocks are maintained, it’s also displayed in the product view (Transaction /SAPAPO/RRP3) in the Safety Stk column 5. Figure 5.22 Safety Stock Method: MB  MZ: Safety Day’s Supply (Time-Dependent Maintenance) With this safety stock method, the time-dependent day’s supply is maintained in Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS. In the example shown in Figure 5.23 1, 2 days of safety day’s supply is maintained from 26.12.2022, 5 days is maintained from 01.01.2024, and 10 days from 01.06.2024. So, during planning, the system will virtually bring backward the demand date by the number of days maintained as the safety day’s supply for the corresponding period, and the receipt elements are created accord- ingly. For the demand on 10.01.2023, 2 days of safety day’s supply is considered, and the receipt is created on 08.01.2023 2; for the demand on 10.01.2024, 5 days is con- sidered, and the receipt is created on 05.01.2024 3; and for the demand on 20.06.2024, 10 days is considered, and the receipt is created on 10.06.2024 4.  MM: Maximum of MB and MZ (Time-Dependent Maintenance) With this safety stock method, both the time-dependent safety stock and the safety day’s supply are considered. © 245 5.2 Basic Functions in PP/DS Planning Figure 5.23 Safety Stock Method: MZ Combination of the Target Stock Level Methods and the Safety Stock Methods All the target stock methods can work with all the safety stock methods. For example, as shown in Figure 5.24, the target stock method (Targt Stk Lvl Method) is maintained as a blank value (target day’s supply from product master) 1 with 10 days of Target Day’s Supply 2 maintained in the material master, along with the safety stock method of SZ - Safety Day’s Supply from Location Product Master 3 and the Safety Time as 5 days 4. Figure 5.24 Combining Safety Stock Method SZ and Target Stock Method “Safety Day’s Supply from Location Product Master” 5 Production Planning 246 During planning, on the first date of demand, the system considers the demand for the next 10 days (in this example, from 02.04.2023 to 12.04.2023 for a 110 total demand quantity 5), respecting the target stock level method. The system virtually brings the demand backward by 5 days, respecting the safety stock method, and creates the receipt element planned order on 28.03.2023 6 (5 days before 02.04.2023).
sections.he:
ב-embedded PP/DS, שיטות target stock level ו-safety stock רבות מסופקות.

**Target Stock Level:** ‏target stock = רמת המלאי הרצויה בריצה. ניתן לקבוע ככמות מוחלטת תקופתית או כמספר ימים לבנייה-מראש. השיטות (שדה Targt Stk Lvl Method ב-Advanced Planning):
• **ריק: Target day's supply from product master** — ה-target day's supply ב-Target Day's Supply (Figure 5.14; בדוגמה 10 ימים). בריצה, ביצירת ה-receipt הראשון (25.12.2022), המערכת מתחשבת בדרישות עד 10 ימים קדימה (04.01.2023) ויוצרת planned order לכמות זו (130).
• **1: Target day's supply (time-dependent maintenance)** — ניתן לתחזק time-dependent. למשל, עד סוף יוני 2023 = 10 ימים, ומיוני 2023 עד 31.12.9999 = 25 ימים. ה-master data ה-time-dependent ל-target ו-safety stock מתוחזק ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS (Figure 5.15) — הזינו product, ‏location, ולחצו Create; הזינו ערכי target/safety stock time-dependent.
• **Target stock level (time-dependent maintenance)** — ערך stock מוחלט (במקום day's supply) ב-time-dependent. בדוגמה (Figure 5.17), ‏target stock 100 עד 31.05.2023 ו-200 עד 31.12.9999. ה-target נוסף ל-receipt הראשון. בשינוי ל-200, ה-delta (100) נוסף. מוצג ב-product view בעמודת TargetStk.
• **7: No target stock level** — המערכת אינה מתחשבת בכל target.

**Safety Stock Methods:** ‏safety stocks = מלאי נוסף למניעת out-of-stock. ב-embedded PP/DS, נתמכות שיטות static ו-time-dependent. ה-static ב-material master; ה-time-dependent ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS. שדות ה-safety stock ו-safety time ב-MRP 2 view גם נחשבים. ב-Advanced Planning, ‏Sfty Stk Meth Determination checkbox שולט אם המערכת קובעת אוטומטית מה-MRP view או מכבדת את ה-Advanced Planning.
כפי שב-Figure 5.18, ‏safety stock 100 ב-MRP 2; ‏Sfty Stk Meth Determination מסומן → המערכת קבעה אוטומטית SB. כשמסומן, שדה ה-Safety Stock Method הופך לא-ניתן-לעריכה. כללי הקביעה האוטומטית:
• ‏Safety Stock ב-MRP 2 → ‏SB-Safety Stock from Location Product Master.
• ‏Safety Time בימים → ‏SZ-Safety Day's Supply from Location Product Master.
• שניהם → ‏SM - Max.of Safety Stock and Safety Day's Sup.
השיטות:
• **SB: Safety Stock from Location Product Master** — (Figure 5.19) הערך מ-Safety Stock ב-MRP 2. מופיע עם התאריך הנוכחי ב-product view. נחשב demand נוסף, והמערכת יוצרת receipts לכיסוי. מכיוון שווירטואלי, אין pegging.
**הערה:** ב-embedded PP/DS, רק virtual safety stocks נתמכים. אינם נשמרים ב-SAP liveCache, ולכן אינם משתתפים ב-pegging. בתכנון, ‏receipts נוצרים לכיסוי, אך אינם dynamically pegged. לכן מיטוב עיכובים ב-Detailed Scheduling Optimizer אינו יכול להתחשב בהם.
• **SZ: Safety Day's Supply from Location Product Master** — (Figure 5.20) משתמש ב-safety day's supply ב-MRP 2. תאריכי הדרישה מובאים אחורה וירטואלית במספר הימים. בדוגמה, ‏Safety Time 5 ימים; ‏receipts נוצרים 5 ימים לפני הדרישות.
• **SM: Max. of Safety Stock and Safety Day's Supply** — (Figure 5.21) שניהם מבוצעים. המערכת קובעת safety stock ואז מביאה אחורה את הדרישות.
• **MB: Safety Stock (Time-Dependent Maintenance)** — (Figure 5.22) ה-time-dependent safety stock ב-Transaction /SAPAPO/TDS. בדוגמה, ‏50 מ-26.12.2022, ‏175 מ-01.01.2024, ‏25 מ-01.06.2024. המערכת מקזזת קיים מול חדש (50 מול 175 → 125; ‏175 מול 25 → receipt חיובי של 150). מוצג בעמודת Safety Stk.
• **MZ: Safety Day's Supply (Time-Dependent Maintenance)** — (Figure 5.23) time-dependent day's supply ב-/SAPAPO/TDS. המערכת מביאה אחורה לפי הימים לתקופה.
• **MM: Maximum of MB and MZ (Time-Dependent Maintenance)** — שניהם נחשבים.

**שילוב Target Stock ו-Safety Stock:** כל ה-target methods עובדים עם כל ה-safety methods. בדוגמה (Figure 5.24), ‏target = ריק (target day's supply from product master) עם 10 ימים, ו-safety = SZ עם 5 ימים. בריצה, המערכת מתחשבת ב-10 ימי ביקוש (target) ומביאה אחורה 5 ימים (safety) — ‏planned order ב-28.03.2023.

sections.title: Source Determination
sections.en: 5.2.6 Source Determination When the time and the quantity are determined by the netting considering the demand elements, including safety stocks, target stock levels, and procurement quan- tity calculation processes, the next step is to determine the source of supply for the receipt element. Depending on the type of procurement, whether it’s in-house pro- duced material or externally procured material, the source determination process will determine either a valid PDS to produce the material or a valid external procurement relationship to procure the material. For in-house produced materials, the system considers the available PDSs, and the PDS that can produce the material with the minimum delay is selected by the system to cre- ate the receipt element. In interactive planning, if the heuristics setting allows this, the user can select the source of supply manually from a ranked list of all the available sources. For externally procured materials, the rankings of the source of supplies are calculated per the procurement priority, the procurement costs assigned to the procurement rela- tionships, and the quota. The system will look for the least cost and highest priority source that can fulfill the demand without any delay. For PP/DS source determination in general, on-time delivery is the driving principle in selecting the source of supply.
sections.he:
כשהזמן והכמות נקבעים ע"י ה-netting (כולל safety stocks, ‏target stock levels, ו-procurement quantity), הצעד הבא — קביעת ה-source of supply. לפי סוג הרכש (ייצור-בית או חיצוני), התהליך יקבע PDS תקף לייצור או external procurement relationship תקף לרכש.
לחומרי ייצור-בית, המערכת מתחשבת ב-PDSs הזמינים, ובוחרת את זה שיכול לייצר בעיכוב המינימלי. בתכנון אינטראקטיבי, אם ה-heuristics מאפשר, המשתמש יכול לבחור ידנית מרשימה מדורגת.
לחומרים חיצוניים, הדירוג מחושב לפי procurement priority, ‏procurement costs, ו-quota. המערכת מחפשת את ה-source הזול והעדיף שיכול למלא ללא עיכוב. ל-source determination בכלל, ‏on-time delivery הוא העיקרון המנחה.

sections.title: Leveraging Planning Heuristics
sections.en: 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics In embedded PP/DS, the planning of a material can be executed in multiple ways, includ- ing MRP Live planning, PP/DS background planning runs, and interactive planning from the PP/DS planning tools. All these methods of executing the planning end up calling a planning heuristic, and the heuristic settings, along with the various profiles used by dif- ferent planning tools, determine the planning results. In this section, we’ll discuss the features offered by the commonly used production planning heuristics. The planning heuristics have an algorithm that can determine a shortage quantity and create a receipt to cover the shortage quantity. The algorithm is an ABAP function mod- ule that is designed to execute the specific planning task. The screens and the available settings in the heuristics Customizing are also part of the algorithm definition. Any of the production planning heuristics can be called in the MRP heuristic, which offer a mechanism to determine the BOM structure and execute the heuristics assigned to the MRP heuristic or the product heuristics following the low-level code of the material. © 247 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics Note Irrespective of the heuristics type (planning, scheduling, or service heuristics), it’s always recommended to create a copy of the heuristics and make the required changes to enable options and functionalities offered by the specific heuristics.
sections.he:
ב-embedded PP/DS, תכנון חומר ניתן לביצוע במספר דרכים — ‏MRP Live planning, ‏PP/DS background runs, ותכנון אינטראקטיבי. כולן קוראות בסופן ל-planning heuristic, וההגדרות וה-profiles קובעים את התוצאות. בסעיף זה — התכונות של ה-heuristics הנפוצים.
ל-planning heuristics אלגוריתם הקובע כמות חוסר ויוצר receipt לכיסוי. האלגוריתם הוא ABAP function module. המסכים וההגדרות גם חלק מהגדרת האלגוריתם. כל heuristic ניתן לקריאה ב-MRP heuristic, המספק מנגנון לקביעת מבנה ה-BOM והרצת ה-heuristics לפי ה-low-level code.
**הערה:** ללא קשר לסוג ה-heuristics (planning, ‏scheduling, ‏service), מומלץ תמיד ליצור עותק ולבצע שינויים.

sections.title: Planning of Standard Lots
sections.en: 5.3.1 Planning of Standard Lots Planning of standard lots is the most commonly used planning heuristic to fulfill uncov- ered demands. The standard heuristics are delivered with the name SAP_PP_002 and the standard algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_PLAN_STANDARDLOTS assigned to the heuristic. The planning of standard lots heuristic executes the standard net requirements calcula- tion and calculates the procurement quantity per the lot sizing definition from the mate- rial master or from the heuristic itself. Then, it executes source of supply determination per the standard logic. After the dates, quantities, and sources are determined, the receipt elements are created by this heuristic. When creating the planned orders for in-house produced materials, these planned orders need to be scheduled on the resources belong- ing to the PDS selected. Therefore, this heuristic provides options to control the schedul- ing parameters via the scheduling strategy assignment in the heuristic setting. Figure 5.25 Net Requirements Calculation Settings for the Planning of Standard Lots Heuristic 5 Production Planning 248 This heuristic can respect the characteristics values during net requirements calcula- tion to evaluate the characteristics values of the requirement and receipt elements during the netting process. The shelf-life data, such as maturation time and minimum remaining shelf life, is also considered by this heuristic if the heuristics setting is made accordingly (see Chapter 8, Section 8.1). To access this heuristic, execute Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPSC11, and double-click on the SAP_PP_002 heuristic in the list displayed. You’ll arrive at the screen shown in Fig- ure 5.25. The basic settings of the Planning of Standard Lots heuristic has several areas, which we’ll explore in the following sections. Net Requirements Calculation As just shown in Figure 5.25, in the Net Requirements Calculation section of the heuris- tics Customizing, the Procedure for the net requirements calculation is set. The Group Past Requirements checkbox can be used to cumulate all the requirement elements in the past (older than current date) and the requirements within the PP/DS time fence together and consider this as one demand element so that the procurement quantity calculation, including the lot sizing, is applied on this cumulated quantity. It makes sense to use this checkbox in planning situations where past demands are always pres- ent that weren’t fulfilled on time and need to be fulfilled immediately. Grouping them together will reduce any excess quantities procured due to lot sizing restrictions. For the consideration of the shelf-life restrictions, such as maturity time and the mini- mum required shelf life, the Plan with Shelf Life checkbox needs to be selected. In addi- tion, the corresponding products must have the Plan with Shelf Life checkbox activated in the Advanced Planning tab of the material master. In planning scenarios where the shortages outside the PP/DS horizon need to be planned within the PP/DS horizon, the Consider Shortages Outside the PP/DS Horizon option can be used. With this option, the system temporarily brings in the require- ments outside of the PP/DS horizon for the duration defined under the Period Outside the PP/DS Horizon section. If there are shortages, then receipt elements will be created inside the PP/DS horizon. Create New Receipt Elements As shown in Figure 5.26, the order of the new receipt creation and the reuse mode is defined for the heuristics. The Sort Procedure has two options:  Chronological Order When the heuristic needs to create several orders due to the dates, netted quantities, and lot sizing procedures, they are created in the order of the earliest order first.  Order Priority, Chronological The orders with higher priorities are created first and then the earliest order within the priority is created next. Along with the scheduling profiles assigned to the © 249 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics planning of standard lots heuristic, this setting can help ensure that the higher- priority orders are created and scheduled first before other orders are created. Figure 5.26 Settings for New Receipt Creation in Planning of Standard Lots Heuristic The Reuse Mode within the heuristics setting controls how the existing fixed and unfixed receipt elements are treated during the execution of this heuristic. We covered the details of the reuse modes in Chapter 3, Section 3.4.1, where we discussed the PP/DS planning procedure customization. When the Reuse Mode is set to Use Suitable Receipt Elements, the system also leverages the settings under the Reuse section. The Reuse Strategy defines how the existing receipt elements are used by this heuristic to cover open requirements. Following are the available options:  Use Earliest Receipts (first in first out) Irrespective of the requirement date, use an existing receipt in chronological order (FIFO) when there is a shortage. This may lead to requirement elements covered too early or too late, as well as earliness and lateness alerts for pegging.  Use Timely Receipts The system searches for a timely receipt within the reuse interval defined per the Maximum Earliness of a Receipt and Maximum Lateness of a Receipt fields. If there are no suitable receipt elements available within the reuse interval, this heuristic will propose a new receipt to be created. 5 Production Planning 250 Settings for New Explosion As shown in Figure 5.27, the Settings for New Explosion section is relevant for the stan- dard lot heuristics when the Reuse Mode is set to Re-explode Plan. With this reuse mode, the source of supply is re-exploded. When this happens for an in-house manu- facturing planned order, this may lead to changes in the modes/dates and thus the resources used by the order. To ensure that the heuristics retain the same mode (and the resource) during a re-explosion of the PDS triggered by the planning of standard lots heuristic, the Retain Mode checkbox can be selected. Figure 5.27 Settings for Re-Explosion, Components, and Interactive Planning in the Planning of Standard Lots Heuristic Note If the mode is no longer available due to a change in the PDS, or the validity date of the mode is no longer under the validity of the order, a mode change can happen irrespec- tive of the Retain Mode checkbox value. A re-explosion of an in-house manufacturing planned order may lead to a rescheduling of the order, and, thus, the operation dates may get changed in this process. To retain © 251 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics the operation date as it appeared before the re-explosion, you can use the Retain Oper- ation Dates checkbox. When this is selected and the scheduling direction is set as back- ward scheduling, the operation end date is derived from the operation of the order before it’s re-exploded. When the scheduling direction is set as forward scheduling, the operation start date is derived from the operation of the order before the re-explosion is triggered. (The details of the scheduling direction are covered in Chapter 6, Section 6.2.2.) However, because a finite scheduling strategy will lead to a change in the opera- tion dates, it’s generally recommended to perform the production planning run in PP/DS without finite scheduling. Planning of Components Creating new receipts by the planning of standard lots heuristic will create dependent demand for the components of the material being planned. According to the planning procedure set for the component materials, when the dependent demand is created or changed, the system reacts accordingly (no action, planning run immediately, create planning file entry, etc.). But if you want to override the planning procedure action and always create a planning file entry for the materials for which the dependent demand is created, you can select the Create Planning File Entry for Components checkbox in the heuristic settings. If the component material has a planning procedure with Don’t Carry Out Any Action defined as the Action, then no planning file entry will be created (see Chapter 3, Section 3.4.1). Interactive Planning The Interactive Planning section (refer to Figure 5.27) determines how the system behaves when the planning of standard lots heuristic is called from an interactive plan- ning tool, such as the product view or order view. During interactive planning, you can change the lot size definition for just that heuristic execution in the planning tool; to allow this, select the Lot Size Dialog Box checkbox in the heuristic settings. With this setting, a dialog box with the current lot sizing procedure per the values from the mate- rial master or the values from the heuristics is defaulted on the screen, and the user has an option to change them manually. To understand the planning elements the system has considered during the interactive execution of the planning of standard lots heuristic, you can select the Generate Evalu- ation checkbox in the heuristic settings. The evaluation contains the information of all the requirement elements, the fixed receipts, the receipts the heuristics has deleted, and the planning file entries created during the execution of the planning of standard lots heuristic in interactive mode. In addition, you can select the Interactive Sourcing checkbox to manually select the source of supply for the external procurement receipts being generated by this heuris- tic. When there are more orders than the value defined in the Max. num. of proposals, the interactive sourcing isn’t enabled. 5 Production Planning 252 Lot Sizes The Lot Sizes tab of the heuristic settings has the same lot sizing settings that can be set from the material master MRP 1 and Advanced Planning views (as you saw in Section 5.2.4). But if you want to override the lot size data maintained in the material master and use the one defined in the heuristic settings, select the Use Lot Size Settings from Heuristic checkbox, as shown in Figure 5.28. Figure 5.28 Heuristic-Specific Lot Sizing Overriding Material Master Lot Size Data Strategy As shown in Figure 5.29, the Strategy tab of the heuristic settings determines the sched- uling parameters to be used for scheduling the receipt elements created by the plan- ning of standard lots heuristic. The scheduling strategy options within the planning of standard lots heuristic are controlled, so that the heuristic can execute and created orders. For example, only the infinite scheduling strategy is available within the heuris- tics setting for the scheduling mode. The following scheduling strategies are available in the Sched. Mode dropdown: © 253 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics  Infinite Scheduling  Search for Bucket with Free Capacity During planning in PP/DS, most of the planning heuristics only offer infinite schedul- ing modes. You can only finitely schedule on such resources with the scheduling mode Search for Bucket with Free Capacity with bucket capacity being used in the resource master data. So, you should execute a planning run with a planning heuristic such as the MRP heuristic, which may in turn execute the product heuristics such as the stan- dard lots heuristics, and execute a scheduling heuristics or the Detailed Scheduling Optimizer to finitely schedule the orders on the resources with finite capacities. Figure 5.29 Scheduling Strategy for Planning of Standard Lots Heuristic
sections.he:
‏planning of standard lots הוא ה-heuristic הנפוץ ביותר למילוי דרישות לא-מכוסות. נשלח בשם SAP_PP_002 עם האלגוריתם /SAPAPO/HEU_PLAN_STANDARDLOTS.
מבצע net requirements calculation תקני ומחשב את כמות הרכש לפי ה-lot sizing (מ-material master או מה-heuristic). אז מבצע source of supply determination. לאחר קביעת התאריכים, הכמויות, וה-sources, ה-receipts נוצרים. ביצירת planned orders לחומרי ייצור-בית, אלו צריכים להיות מתוזמנים על ה-resources של ה-PDS הנבחר. לכן ה-heuristic מספק אפשרויות לשליטה בפרמטרי ה-scheduling דרך הקצאת scheduling strategy.
ה-heuristic יכול לכבד ערכי characteristics ב-net requirements calculation. נתוני shelf-life (maturation time, ‏minimum remaining shelf life) נחשבים אם ההגדרה מתאימה (פרק 8, סעיף 8.1).
לגישה, הריצו Transaction /SAPAPO/CDPSC11 ולחצו כפולה על SAP_PP_002 (Figure 5.25). ההגדרות באזורים:

**Net Requirements Calculation:** (Figure 5.25) ה-Procedure נקבע. ה-Group Past Requirements checkbox מצטבר את כל הדרישות בעבר ובתוך ה-PP/DS time fence כדרישה אחת. שימושי כשדרישות עבר תמיד נוכחות. ל-shelf-life, ‏Plan with Shelf Life checkbox (וגם ב-material master). ל-shortages מחוץ ל-horizon, ‏Consider Shortages Outside the PP/DS Horizon מביא זמנית את הדרישות למשך המוגדר תחת Period Outside the PP/DS Horizon.

**Create New Receipt Elements:** (Figure 5.26) סדר היצירה ו-reuse mode. ה-Sort Procedure:
• **Chronological Order** — המוקדם נוצר ראשון.
• **Order Priority, Chronological** — בעדיפות גבוהה ראשון, ואז המוקדם בתוך העדיפות.
ה-Reuse Mode שולט בטיפול ב-receipts (פרק 3, סעיף 3.4.1). כש-Use Suitable Receipt Elements, ה-Reuse Strategy:
• **Use Earliest Receipts (FIFO)** — receipt קיים בסדר כרונולוגי בעת חוסר (עלול לכיסוי מוקדם/מאוחר מדי).
• **Use Timely Receipts** — חיפוש receipt בתוך ה-reuse interval (Maximum Earliness/Lateness of a Receipt). אם אין, מציע חדש.

**Settings for New Explosion:** (Figure 5.27) רלוונטי כש-Reuse Mode = Re-explode Plan. ה-source of supply מ-re-exploded; ל-in-house planned order זה עלול לשנות modes/dates ו-resources. לשמירת ה-mode (וה-resource), ‏Retain Mode checkbox.
**הערה:** אם ה-mode לא זמין עוד או מחוץ לתוקף, mode change יכול לקרות ללא קשר ל-Retain Mode.
‏re-explosion עלול לתזמן-מחדש. לשמירת תאריך הפעולה, ‏Retain Operation Dates checkbox (backward → end date; ‏forward → start date; פרק 6, סעיף 6.2.2). אך מומלץ לבצע ריצה ללא finite scheduling.

**Planning of Components:** יצירת receipts יוצרת dependent demand לרכיבים. לפי ה-planning procedure, המערכת מגיבה. לדרוס ולתמיד ליצור planning file entry, סמנו Create Planning File Entry for Components (אך לא אם הרכיב עם Don't Carry Out Any Action; פרק 3, סעיף 3.4.1).

**Interactive Planning:** (Figure 5.27) כיצד המערכת מתנהגת בקריאה מכלי אינטראקטיבי. לשינוי ה-lot size רק לאותה הרצה, ‏Lot Size Dialog Box checkbox. להבנת האלמנטים שנחשבו, ‏Generate Evaluation checkbox. לבחירת source ידנית ל-external procurement, ‏Interactive Sourcing checkbox (לא מאופשר כשיש יותר orders מ-Max. num. of proposals).

**Lot Sizes:** (Figure 5.28) אותן הגדרות כמו material master. לדריסה, ‏Use Lot Size Settings from Heuristic checkbox.

**Strategy:** (Figure 5.29) פרמטרי ה-scheduling. רק infinite scheduling זמין. ה-Sched. Mode:
• Infinite Scheduling
• Search for Bucket with Free Capacity
רוב ה-heuristics מציעים רק infinite. ניתן finitely schedule רק עם Search for Bucket with Free Capacity (עם bucket capacity). לכן יש להריץ planning heuristic (כגון MRP heuristic) ואז scheduling heuristics או Detailed Scheduling Optimizer ל-finite scheduling.

sections.title: Reorder Point Planning
sections.en: 5.3.2 Reorder Point Planning The reorder point planning heuristic is delivered in the standard embedded PP/DS sys- tem with the name SAP_PP_007 – Reorder Point Planning and with the algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_REORDER_POINT_PLAN. The reorder point maintained in the material master MRP 1 tab is considered by this heuristic for refilling the stock up to the reorder point if the current stock level is below the reorder level maintained in the material master. 5 Production Planning 254 The net requirements calculation for this heuristic only considers the current stock level, the receipt elements, and the reorder point defined in the material master. No other requirement elements are considered for the net requirements calculation, which may lead to excess supply or supply shortage; therefore, this heuristic should be used for materials that are truly procured based on reorder point planning. In general, for such materials, advanced planning isn’t necessary, and they can be planned in MRP Live in SAP S/4HANA. If such materials are produced in-house on a bottleneck resource, then those materials can be activated for advanced planning, and the reorder point planning heuristic can be assigned as the product heuristic for those products. The heuristics settings for the reorder point planning heuristic are shown in Figure 5.30. In the Basic Settings tab, the Delete Non-Fixed Receipt Elements option will delete all the nonfixed receipt elements and re-create them if the net requirements calcula- tion determines a shortage. If the Delete Non-Fixed Receipt Elements checkbox isn’t selected, the excess nonfixed receipt elements won’t be deleted by this heuristic. Figure 5.30 Reorder Point Planning Heuristic Basic and Lot Size Settings The example for the treatment of the nonfixed receipt elements is depicted in Table 5.1 and Table 5.2. Table 5.1 shows the current planning situation with a reorder point of 70 maintained in the material master. Date Time Element Number Receipt/Requirement Quantity 05.07.2023 0:00:00 Stock Stock 10 24.07.2023 12:00:00 Forecast requirement –50 02.08.2023 17:00:00 Purchase requisition 10140086/00 100 Table 5.1 Example of the Current Planning Situation © 255 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics This situation would look the same without the Delete Non-Fixed Receipt Elements option selected. Because the nonfixed receipt element (purchase requisition) isn’t deleted, the total available receipts (stocks + purchase requisition) quantity (10 + 100) is more than the reorder point defined in the material master (70). However, with the option selected, the situation would look like Table 5.2 after the reor- der point planning heuristic. As you can see, the nonfixed purchase requisition with quantity 100 is deleted, and a new purchase requisition is created with quantity 60 to balance the reorder point quantity of 70: stock quantity 10 + new purchase requisition quantity 60 = 70 (reorder point). Referring back to the settings shown in Figure 5.30, the Fill to Maximum Stock Level checkbox will create a receipt element to fill up to the maximum stock level main- tained in the MRP 1 view of the material master when the net requirements calculation warrants the creation of a receipt element by the system. Note When maintaining the maximum stock level and reorder point in the MRP 1 tab of the material master, the system will raise a warning or an information message saying the MRP procedure doesn’t make use of these fields. But with advanced planning, PP/DS uses these fields when the reorder point planning heuristic is executed. The Lot Size settings in the reorder point planning heuristic (shown on the lower area of Figure 5.30) only provide the option to define the maximum and minimum lot sizes because other settings, such as lot sizing procedure, aren’t relevant for the reorder point planning scenario and are ignored by this heuristic. The Strategy tab is like the planning of standard lots heuristic where the heuristic only has infinite scheduling modes available in the heuristic settings.
sections.he:
‏reorder point planning heuristic נשלח בשם SAP_PP_007 – Reorder Point Planning עם האלגוריתם /SAPAPO/HEU_REORDER_POINT_PLAN.
ה-reorder point ב-material master MRP 1 נחשב למילוי ה-stock עד ה-reorder point אם המלאי מתחת לרמה. ה-net requirements לזה מתחשב רק במלאי הנוכחי, ב-receipts, וב-reorder point. אין דרישות אחרות (עלול לעודף/חוסר); לכן יש להשתמש לחומרים המתוקצרים באמת לפי reorder point. בכלל, לחומרים כאלו advanced planning אינו נחוץ (ניתן MRP Live). אם מיוצרים בבית על bottleneck, ניתן להפעיל advanced planning ולהקצות את ה-heuristic.

sections.title: Planning of Standard Lots in Three Horizons
sections.en: 5.3.3 Planning of Standard Lots in Three Horizons The planning of standard lots in three horizons heuristic is delivered in the SAP stan- dard system with the name SAP_PP_004 and the standard algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_ PEGID_PERIODIC_LOT. Date Time Element Number Receipt/Requirement Quantity 05.07.2023 0:00:00 Stock Stock 10 24.07.2023 12:00:00 Forecast requirement –50 02.08.2023 17:00:00 New purchase requisition 10140086/00 60 Table 5.2 Planning Situation after Reorder Point Planning (with the Delete Nonfixed Receipts Option) 5 Production Planning 256 The planning of standard lots in three horizons is the same as the planning of standard lots heuristic, except for the lot sizing procedure defined in the heuristic settings. The basic settings and the strategy settings are the same as the planning of standard lots heuristic. This heuristic offers up to three different lot sizing procedures that can be used in certain periods. For example, week 1 is planned in the lot-for-lot lot sizing pro- cedure, week 2 to week 5 are planned using a daily (periodic) lot sizing procedure, and week 6 to the end of the PP/DS horizon are planned with a weekly (periodic) lot sizing. As shown in Figure 5.31, the Lot Size tab of this heuristic offers the flexibility to enter three different lot sizes for different time horizons. The Short-Term Horizon starts from the date of the heuristics execution until the duration defined as the short-term hori- zon, and the Medium-Term Horizon starts at the end of the short-term horizon and runs for the duration defined in the heuristics setting. Because the mid-term horizon is defined as 30 days in Table 5.5, and the daily lot sizing procedure is used, the planned order is created by combining the requirement quanti- ties (12 and 25) of the same day in one planned order with quantity 37. sections.title: MRP Heuristic
sections.en: 5.3.4 MRP Heuristic The MRP heuristic in PP/DS is an enabling heuristic that can execute a production plan- ning heuristic assigned to the heuristics or the product heuristics assigned to the mate- rial in the Advanced Planning view of the material master. It’s delivered in the standard PP/DS system with the name SAP_MRP_001 and with the standard algorithm /SAPAPO/ HEU_MRP_PLANNING. The MRP heuristic is classified as an enabling heuristic because it can’t perform plan- ning (net requirements calculation, procurement quantity determination, and source determination) on its own. However, because it can be used for executing planning heuristics, we’re covering the details of the MRP heuristic in this section. In embedded PP/DS, planning can be executed for advanced planning materials via MRP Live (Transaction MD01N) or the PP/DS planning run (Transaction /SAPAPO/ Date Element Quantity 27/07/2023 Forecast requirement –12 27/07/2023 Forecast requirement –25 27/07/2023 Planned order 37 Table 5.5 After the Planning of Standard Lots in Three Horizons Heuristic Execution: Mid- Term Horizon 30 Days, Lot Sizing Daily (Periodic) Date Element Quantity 10/9/2023 Forecast requirement –30 11/9/2023 Forecast requirement –25 12/9/2023 Forecast requirement –10 10/9/2023 Planned order 65 Table 5.6 After the Planning of Standard Lots in Three Horizons Heuristic Execution: Long- Term Horizon, Lot Sizing Weekly (Periodic) © 259 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics CDPSB0). When executing planning using the PP/DS planning run, the MRP heuristic can be leveraged. The MRP heuristic settings are very limited, as shown in Figure 5.32, to the extent of a few heuristics parameters and the technical settings for parallel processing to improve the performance of the PP/DS planning run. Figure 5.32 Settings for the MRP Heuristic The Heuristic section of the settings determines if the MRP heuristic will execute the product heuristic or another heuristic assigned in the heuristic settings. If there is no product heuristics assigned in the material master, the system will read the configura- tion settings of the PP/DS planning procedure and get the heuristics assigned to the planning procedure. If the product heuristics in the material master are left empty and also the heuristics in the planning procedure are empty, the system will raise an error message as it’s not able to determine any heuristics for planning. 5 Production Planning 260 The heuristics parameters are the same as the planning of standard lots heuristic for the Reuse Mode and Create Planning File Entry for Component. The Sort Low-Level Codes in Descending Order setting will change the direction of the planning from the lowest level component to the top-level finished product. This can be useful when exe- cuting other service heuristics via the MRP heuristic to realign the higher-level require- ment with the lower-level supplies. However, in a production planning run (using a planning heuristic), this checkbox must be deselected to avoid adverse impacts in the planning results. The Maximum Package Size is relevant when Parallel Processing is selected for the MRP heuristic. The production planning runs handles a large data volume, and even with the power of SAP liveCache in the PP/DS, the performance can still be a concern. To reduce the runtime of the MRP heuristic, parallel processing can be activated in the heuristic settings. The technical setup of parallel processing for the MRP heuristic is covered in Chapter 3, Section 3.4.2. The package size determines the number of material locations included in one package, which is dispatched to a parallel process to execute the heuristics. Note When the MRP heuristic is executed, if one of the materials in a planning package ends up with a termination, the planning of all the materials in the package is rolled back. Therefore, it’s important to have a small number as the package size to reduce the impact and avoid one material in the package making the whole package fail.

sections.title: Demand Propagation Heuristic
sections.en: 5.3.5 Demand Propagation Heuristic This heuristic is delivered in standard embedded PP/DS with the name SAP_PP_022 and the algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_DEMAND_PROPAGATION. It can be used in external procurement scenarios where stocks are transferred between locations. This heuristic identifies all the locations that supply material to the material location for which the heuristic is being executed, and it propagates the demand to the supplying locations by creating procurement elements such as stock transport requisitions. This heuristic can execute multilevel demand propagation according to the heuristic settings. As shown in Figure 5.33, when the Multilevel checkbox is set, it executes the heuristic across all locations of the material. The Reuse Mode and the Create Planning File Entry for Component function similar to the settings available in the planning of standard lots heuristic (refer to Section 5.3.1). © 261 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics Figure 5.33 Demand Propagation Heuristic: Available Settings

‏demand propagation heuristic נשלח בשם SAP_PP_022 עם האלגוריתם /SAPAPO/HEU_DEMAND_PROPAGATION. משמש בתרחישי רכש חיצוני שבהם stocks מועברים בין locations. מזהה את כל ה-locations המספקים חומר ל-location ומפיץ את הביקוש ע"י יצירת אלמנטי procurement (stock transport requisitions).
יכול הפצה רב-שלבית (Figure 5.33; ‏Multilevel checkbox — מריץ על-פני כל ה-locations). ה-Reuse Mode וה-Create Planning File Entry for Component דומים ל-planning of standard lots (סעיף 5.3.1).

sections.title: Quota Heuristic
sections.en: 5.3.6 Quota Heuristic The quota heuristic is delivered in the standard system with the heuristics name SAP_ PP_Q001 and the algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_PLAN_QUOTA. When inbound quota arrangements are maintained for in-house or external procurement receipts for mate- rials, this heuristic reads and respects the quota arrangement master data maintained for the material and creates the receipts accordingly. As shown in Figure 5.34, the quota arrangement heuristics doesn’t have any special settings. Figure 5.34 Quota Heuristics 5 Production Planning 262 For the uncovered requirements, the quota arrangement heuristic determines the pro- curement type (in-house or external procurement) and source of supply. The product heu- ristics determines the lot sizes and other parameters used to create the receipt elements. While all the quota master data settings are considered by this heuristic, the maturity time and shelf-life data defined in the material master isn’t considered by this heuristic.
sections.he:
‏quota heuristic נשלח בשם SAP_PP_Q001 עם האלגוריתם /SAPAPO/HEU_PLAN_QUOTA. כשמתוחזק inbound quota arrangements ל-receipts (in-house או external), ה-heuristic קורא ומכבד את ה-quota arrangement master data ויוצר receipts בהתאם. אין הגדרות מיוחדות (Figure 5.34).
לדרישות לא-מכוסות, ה-quota heuristic קובע את סוג הרכש ואת ה-source. ה-product heuristics קובע lot sizes ופרמטרים. כל הגדרות ה-quota נחשבות, אך ה-maturity time וה-shelf-life אינם נחשבים.

sections.title: Planning of Standard Lots for Co-Products
sections.en: 5.3.7 Planning of Standard Lots for Co-Products Co-products are additional output products resulting from the manufacturing of the finished products. The co-products scenario is commonly used in chemical industries. The co-product materials can be set with the Co-product indicator in the material mas- ter MRP 2 view or in the BOM item 1, as shown in Figure 5.35. In addition, in the BOM, the co-product is maintained with a negative quantity 2. With these settings in the BOM, when the PP/DS PDS is generated, the co-product will be created as a nonprimary output 3 material and with an offset relationship of End-End 4. Figure 5.35 Co-Products in BOM and in PDS The plan standard lots for co-products heuristic is leveraged in scenarios where there are independent requirements such as sales orders, forecasts, or dependent require- ments available in the system. In the standard system, this heuristic is delivered with the name SAP_PP_017 and the algorithm /SAPAPO/HEU_PLAN_COPRODUCTS. During the execution of this heuristic for co-product materials, the system evaluates the demand (sales orders, forecasts, etc.) and the receipts (the nonprimary output from the finished product’s planned orders). If there is uncovered demand, this heuristic creates planned orders for the finished material in such a quantity that it produces enough co- product material to cover its uncovered demand. © 263 5.3 Leveraging Planning Heuristics In the example shown in Figure 5.36, the planned order 1 exists for the finished mate- rial. As the co-product is also an output of this planned order, in the product view of the co-product, you can see the receipt from the planned order 2. The receipt quantity isn’t editable 3 in the co-product product view, as the planned order is originating from the finished material. In addition, you can see a forecast demand for the co-product pres- ent in the system 4. Figure 5.36 Co-Product Receipts in Product View When the plan standard lots for co-products heuristic is executed for the co-product, the system creates a planned order for the finished material for a quantity, as shown in Figure 5.37 1, which ensures that the uncovered demand for the co-product is covered by the resulting output 2 from the finished material planned order. Figure 5.37 Planning Using the Plan Standard Lots for Co-Products Heuristic 5 Production Planning 264
